node.description:
One of the major antagonists of the series, Medusa is a powerful witch and the middle sibling among the three Gorgon Sisters.

She is the mother of Crona, who is also the crown jewel in her master plan: the destruction of the current world order to get the planet back on track. Lacking empathy for others, along with possessing a twisted sense of love for those who are like her in personality, Medusa views everyone as a potential specimen to experiment on or as a tool to suit her purpose.

name.native: スピリット=アルバーン

node.description: He is the Shinigami’s current weapon and Maka’s father. He is very protective of Maka and is ready to jump to her aid any time she’s in trouble (he is always stopped by the Shinigami). His wife is Maka’s mother but they are divorced now due to his constant flirting with other women. Even though he visits clubs, he is still insanely loyal to his ex-wife and daughter. He usually runs yelling about much he loves Maka and her mother (he calls Maka’s mother Mama). He is extremely sad that his daughter hates him but he still tries to be a good father by looking out for her in his own silly way. He used to be Dr. Franken’s partner before partnering up with "Mama" who later became his wife (which obviously lead to the divorce); he still suffers nightmares about Dr. Franken trying to dissect him and still has memories from college when he and Stein were roommates. His old name was Spirit.

Mifune, known by the epithet "God of the Sword", is an infamous samurai and bodyguard who acts as a guardian to the little witch, [Angela Leon](https://anilist.co/character/13712/Leon-Angela). He is later blackmailed into the service of Arachnophobia by its head, [Arachne Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Gorgon-Arachne). He becomes involved in a somewhat one-sided rivalry with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) after the latter encounters him on a mission.

The Death Scythe in charge of Europe. Dressed in a priestly garb and earphones, Justin is devout in his services to the Shinigami. Justin is the youngest in the DWMA's history to become a Death Scythe at the age of thirteen, all without the aid of a partner. His weapon form, the guillotine, fits his title of "executioner". Justin has the ability to read lips but due to his constant use of earphones and the fact that the Shinigami wears a mask, he cannot understand the Shinigami. He tends to pray and give thanks to God for everything, and also tends to speak loudly due to his constant use of headphones. He travels by means of a dune buggy with a coffin on wheels connected to it. In the manga, he is colored with blonde hair and his hairstyle is a tonsure cut, usually worn by monks from European temples.

The first-generation Kishin and one of the Great Old Ones whose affinity to madness resides in fear. He formerly served as one of the Warlords of the Eight Reaper Legions, being its most powerful member until he betrayed the group and became a Kishin, killing innocents to gain power through their souls and even consuming his own demon weapon partner, as well as two other Great Old Ones. After his betrayal he was sealed away by [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami), and remained sealed until his revival by [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924)'s Faction.

__Manga:__

~!He is later revealed to be Death's eldest son and the older brother of [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455/Death-the-Kid), specifically created as a fragment containing all of Death's fear in order for Death to become the God of Absolute Order.!~

~!After Asura's battle with [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn), [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) and Death the Kid, [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona) seals both Asura and themselves inside the moon to keep his madness locked away from the world. Asura gleefully asserts that this method will not last, and that one day he will return to terrorize the world again.!~

Eruka Frog is a frog-themed witch who serves under Medusa Gorgon. Like many other witches, Eruka craves destruction and enjoys the fact that she was born a Witch. However, she is extremely cowardly, preferring to flee rather than fight, and never hesitates begging for mercy when cowed. She can also be considered clingy to her partner, Free, even becoming needy and docile. Despite her malicious intent, Eruka has an earnest disposition with other Witches, including Mizune, with whom she is close friends with. She can be demeaning to those whom she considers inferior, though.         Magic:            Transform: Eruka transforms into a frog. She can still talk in this form.          Egg Bombs: Tadpole-like black balls with frog faces that can hop towards their target before detonating.          Arithmetic Magic (Magic Calculation): Used as a 'place maker' for high level spells so they are more precise.    (wikipedia)

A popular EAT-Class Meister partnered with twin weapons, Fire and Thunder. He is considered one of the top three student fighters in the DWMA, and is good friends with [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford) and [Kim](https://anilist.co/character/14063/Kim-Diehl). Rather hot blooded and direct, with a fiery soul and enough compassion to put his own life on the line for his friends.

The Death Scythe formerly in charge of Oceania. However, after the resurrection of [Asura](https://anilist.co/character/15840/Asura), her duties were reassigned to [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/15770/Yumi-Azusa).

She is currently partnered with [Stein](https://anilist.co/character/8446/Franken-Stein) and is an instructor at the DWMA. Tends to feel glum about her lack of success in marriage, but is a kind and genuine woman. Stein was her old crush when they were students at the DWMA, but she still seems to hold feelings towards him in some capacity.

__Anime:__

~!After Stein is overwhelmed by madness and [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon) manipulates him into joining her side, Marie goes to save him alongside [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona), using her healing wavelength to bring him back to his senses.!~

__Manga:__

~!Marie's former betrothed, [Joe Buttataki](https://anilist.co/character/16944/Joe-Buttataki), is murdered during an internal investigation of the DWMA. Stein is framed for the murder due to his onset of madness at the time, orchestrated by Medusa, but Marie sets out with him to find the real killer, who is later revealed to be [Justin Law](https://anilist.co/character/14019/Justin-Law), a death scythe and a traitor to the DWMA.!~

~!In the final chapter, it is revealed that Marie and Stein are officially in a relationship, with Marie also being pregnant with his child.!~

Arachne Gorgon was the head of Arachnophobia who conspired to replace Death Weapon Meister Academy's position as a world power using madness with her in charge. She was also the eldest of the Gorgon Sisters, a former associate of both Death and Eibon of some sort, and considered the darkest blemish in the history of the Witch Order.

Ragnarok, also known as the Demon Sword, is the weapon partner of Crona. Born a normal demon weapon, it was melted by Medusa in a vat of Black Blood while in its weapon form and mixed into Crona's blood.

A Werewolf and the last of the Immortal Clan, imprisoned by the Witch Order for stealing Witch Queen Maba's left eye. After being freed by Eruka Frog on Medusa Gorgon's orders, he renames himself in honor of his freedom and joins her group, acting as one of her operatives.

A three-star meister partner to Mira Naigus, instructor of Death Weapon Meister Academy, and a high-ranking member of the DWMA Central Intelligence Agency. Though killed in action by Shaula Gorgon—youngest of the three Gorgon sisters—he is later resurrected as a zombie by Franken Stein.

sampleCharacters.description: The demon sword [Ragnarok](https://anilist.co/character/11921/Ragnark)'s meister and the biological child of the witch [Medusa Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon). They're driven by their [mother](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon)'s aim to turn them into a Kishin.

sampleCharacters.native: フランケン・シュタイン
sampleCharacters.description: The eccentric yet incredibly talented doctor and meister who is hailed as the DWMA's strongest graduate in history. He later joins the academy as an instructor. While he is intimidating due to the greater-than-typical amount of madness within him, he is highly relied upon by [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami) and is well-liked by his students. Formerly partnered with [Spirit Albarn](https://anilist.co/character/8462/Spirit-Albarn), he is now partnered with [Marie Mjolnir](https://anilist.co/character/15769/Marie-Mjolnir).

sampleCharacters.name: Blair
sampleCharacters.description: A playful cat with powerful magic that Soul and Maka initially confused for a regular witch. Her life seems to largely revolve around doing whatever she deems fun at any given time, ranging from working as a hostess at Chupa♡Cabra's to aiding the DWMA's plans - however, she's also very sensitive to others' feelings, often comforting those in need out of kindness. She's also shown to enjoy long baths and exhibitionism, being very proud of her human form's body and often looking for opportunities to make others feel embarrassed. Her magic abilities are themed around pumpkins, and she also keeps a hat monster named Zwan (ズワン) as her familiar. Due to being a cat, she has nine lives, which is how she managed to survive her initial defeat at the hands of Soul and Maka. Additionally, her charms seem to transcend gender-altering magic, with her male form being able to seduce a succubus within the Book of Eibon.

node.description:
__Height:__ 147 cm

Menma is a ghost girl who suddenly appears several years after her death to [Jinta](https://anilist.co/character/40591/Yadomi-Jinta) and asks him to reunite their group of friends so her wish can be granted. Yet, she does not seem to remember what is her wish, but she knows she has to reunite her friends in order to remember. Despite being "dead", she is a very positive, energetic and lively person. According to Jinta, she is quite selfless and cries very often for others when they are hurt or upset, but not for herself.

Jinta calls her "the beast of the summer" as he relates her to being a manifestation of his stress instead of a ghost girl.

~!Matsuyuki admitted his love to her on the day that she died; however, she didn't return his confession in favor of chasing after Jinta. It is hinted that she has feelings for Jinta, and only Jinta is able to see her. This is confirmed when Menma wrote a letter for Jinta, which read, " _I love you, Jin-tan. It's the "I want to marry you!" type of "I love you."_"  Menma is able to reveal her presence to her friends by carrying objects, flickering the lights, etcetera. She is also able to communicate with them by writing in her diary. She seems to think that her wish was to send a rocket to Heaven with a note to Jinta's mother, so the reunited Super Peace Busters attempt to create one. Menma also wishes to be reincarnated after passing on so she can be in the world again, back with her friends. Without her, Menma's family is falling apart. Her mother is unable to move on from her death. Her father, who is hinted at being abusive, wants their family to overcome the grief. He does this by hiding all of Menma's possessions, yet it does her mother very little good. Her younger brother barely remembers her but wishes that their family could move on. He feels neglected by his mother since she is still stuck on Menma.!~

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Naruko is a childhood friend of [Jinta](https://anilist.co/character/40591/Yadomi-Jinta) and [Menma](https://anilist.co/character/40592/Honma-Meiko). While she displays a cold attitude towards Jinta, she is secretly concerned for him. She is perhaps the closest to him at present and is enrolled the same school (although Jinta stopped attending school). [Chiriko](https://anilist.co/character/40595/Tsurumi-Chiriko) comments that Naruko has not changed over the years: she is still easily persuaded by everyone around her. Naruko seems to be popular in high school and gets along well with girls that Chiriko deems "sluts."

While they have grown apart, Naruko seems cares deeply about her childhood friends. She works at a video game store and has a large collection of manga and video games herself. Because of this collection, she started reconnecting with Jinta and [Poppo](https://anilist.co/character/40596/Hisakawa-Tetsudo).

Naruko Anjou is left handed

~!Naruko admits that, when she was a child, she was jealous of Menma. Insecure of her glasses and curly hair, she desperately wanted to have flowing hair like Menma. Moreover, she was jealous of Jinta's affection towards Menma. Naruko secretly had a crush on Jinta, which is why she asked him whether he had feelings for Menma. She blames herself for Menma's death, because her question ultimately precipitated in Menma's death. Presently, it is shown that Naruko still has lingering feelings for Jinta.

Naruko is involved in a scandal when an older boy, whom she was hanging out with, tries to force her into a love hotel. When she wouldn't agree to have sex with him, he attempts to force her into the hotel to rape her; however, Matsuyuki protects her. Despite this, the rumor that Naruko had sex with this man reaches her high school. Naruko has to face the judgments of her fellow students until she decides to stop going to school in favor of working full-time to get the money to build the rocket.

She feels slighted when Jinta focuses on Menma and continues to ignore her, even after they reunited. Matsuyuki, who feels similarly since Menma is denying him, asks Naruko out. However she later tells Chiriko on the bridge that she loves only Jinta and that he is irreplaceable.!~

__Height:__ 165 cm

Jinta is the main character of the series. In the past, Jinta was an energetic, young boy and the leader of his group, the Super Peace Busters. When [Naruko](https://anilist.co/character/40593/Anjou-Naruko) asked him if he had a crush on [Menma](https://anilist.co/character/40592/Honma-Meiko), he said, "Why would I be in love with such an ugly—?" He had plans to apologize to her the next day, but she died later that night in a drowning accident.

Unable to forgive himself, Jinta spent the next years of his life in a constant state of gloominess. He became withdrawn and eventually became a hikikomori, or a shut-in. He currently lives with his father. While he is enrolled at the same high school as Naruko, he stopped attending.

~!Jinta now lives a life of exclusion and wears a disguise (consisting of a pair of glasses and a beanie) in order to comfortably leave his house. He has also shown to be socially awkward amongst strangers.  Perhaps Jinta's defining attribute is his ability to see Menma. While no one else can see her, Jinta can communicate with her as well as touch her. Menma says that Jinta needs to fulfill her wish, although neither he nor she can remember what this wish is; however, they do know that it has something to do with their entire childhood group. For Menma's sake, Jinta has been trying to reconnect and reunite with his old friends.!~

Poppo is the first friend that Jinta reconnects with. As a child, Poppo was uncontrollably energetic and friendly and was always loyal to Jinta recognizing him as the leader of the group. These  traits have not changed. Presently, Jinta reunited with him when he was searching for Menma. He visited their old clubhouse and found that Poppo was living there. Poppo explains that he works part-time jobs to earn money. When he makes enough, he goes on trips around the world. Because of this, Poppo has not attended school in several years.  Poppo seems to have questionable interests: Jinta found several pornographic magazines upon entering the clubhouse. Poppo also seems to have an obsession for foreign girls, especially Vietnamese girls. Overall, he has a lewd personality.   ~!One evening, Poppo saw Menma in the forest. He was the second reported person to have seen Menma after her death. Because of this, he decides to gather the old group of friends in order to fulfill Menma's wish.  The reason he travels so much is due to the fact that he had seen Meiko's dead body drifting away in the river. He travels in an attempt to escape the past and get away from the clubhouse, the river, and the memory of Meiko's death. Despite his attempts to escape his past he finds himself always returning to the clubhouse and living there between trips.  Upon fulfilling Meiko's wish Poppo is able to come to terms with his past. He returns to living a healthy life and begins studying and working part-time.!~

__Height:__ 181 cm (5' 11")

Atsumu is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. In the present, Atsumu holds a condescending attitude towards Jinta. He becomes agitated when Menma is mentioned and is still distraught over her death. He, together with Chiriko, attend the same high school, which Jinta failed the entrance exams to enter. Atsumu and Chiriko were once mistaken as a pair.   ~!Atsumu is still in love with Meiko despite her death and keeps one of her sundresses in his closet. He buys hair scrunchies and other trinkets to place at her grave. He revealed that he is able to see Menma too. But in the end of episode 4, it's been proven that he is a crossdresser and tried to fool everyone. Once they got him, Atsumu confessed his love for Meiko and that he felt guilty for her death. In episode 5, Atsumu seems to have a kind of interest for Naruko, asking her to go out with him and if she is a virgin.!~

As a child, Chiriko was a shy girl and a member of the Super Peace Busters. Now, she is enrolled at an elite school with Matsuyuki. Currently, she is ranked fourth in her class. She is serious, stoic, and cocky. Upon meeting with Naruko, Chiriko insults both her and her friends; however, she has since made amends with Naruko. While the other members of the Super Peace Busters have fallen apart, Chiriko and Matsuyuki have remained friends after Menma's death.   ~!Chiriko is shown to have feelings for Matsuyuki; however, he does not reciprocate her affection. Matsuyuki's heart belongs to Menma. He asks Naruko out, although the current status of their relationship is unknown. Chiriko overhears this conversation and is devastated.!~
Jinta's father. A funny and gentle old man, he likes calling things cute.
Jinta's mother. She was hospitalized before Menma died.   ~!She also made a promise with Menma that she'd help make Jinta cry.!~
Menma's brother.

Meiko Honma's mother.   In the story, she has hatred towards Yadomi group, the "Super Peace Busters".  ~!She is also found that she is stuck in the past and was unable to move forward until Yadomi's group made a move.!~
A friend and classmate of Naruko.
One of the two friends that Naruko hangs out with at school.
Appears in episode 6. It's revealed that she has feelings to Matsuyuki.
He was in charge of making the fireworks. He helped Yadomi in making the firework.
Menma's father.

node.description:
__Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night)

A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

__Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night)

Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber.

Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a perfectionist. She is perceptive, resourceful and avidly competitive.

~!Rin is [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older sister, but the two were forced to live apart by their father, Tokiomi. Rin once had a good relationship with Sakura before their separation, evident by a ribbon Sakura always kept. Rin later convinced herself that Sakura was living a happier life with the Matou family than she was living as the Tohsaka family heir, and this delusion blinded her to the knowledge that Sakura was only barely keeping her own sanity in check while constantly suffering. Rin went as far as to try to preserve Shirou's life for what she thought was entirely Sakura's sake. Rin had also decided that she would kill Sakura in the events of the Holy Grail War if it came down to it. However, ultimately, she could not bring herself to do it and took the blow without harming her.!~

name.native: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン

node.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

__Height:__ 182 cm

Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. 

Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot.

His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059).

__In Fate/Zero:__
~!
Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. 

In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body and is reincarnated in the world. !~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Within the World of Fate/strange Fake, Servant Archer Gilgamesh was previously summoned in the Fourth Fuyuki Holy Grail War and participated in the Fifth Fuyuki Holy Grail War. But the Servant summoned in the False Holy Grail War is a new Servant without any memories of the Fuyuki Holy Grail Wars. 

He is the first Servant summoned in the True and False Holy Grail War as the "False" Archer-class Servant of [Thine Chelc](https://anilist.co/character/87307/).
!~

__Height:__ 175 cm
__Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets

[Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire.

During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou.

Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi.

Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fate/Zero.   

~!It is hinted at in certain parts of Fate/stay night and confirmed in its prequel Fate/Zero that Kiritsugu is in fact [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s biological father, making Shirou and her step-siblings.!~

__Height:__ 212 cm
__Master:__ [Waver Velvet](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Waver-Velvet)
__Catalyst:__ Mantle once worn by Iskandar himself 
__Holy Grail War No.:__ 4th Holy Grail War  

In Fate/Zero
~!Rider was originally meant to be summoned by Lord Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald, but due to some circumstances, he ended up being Waver Velvet's servant. Iskandar, or how he refers to himself, the King of Conquerors is a noble and courageous man, who prefers to conquer his enemies by winning without killing and controlling without humiliating. He is known as a marvelous ruler who once almost conquered the whole known world. He is not pragmatic, but is a person who lets history run its course and acts according to his impulses. While he is wild and somewhat inconsiderate to others, his greed ultimately resulted in the happiness of the people he ruled over.  In the new era, Rider is mostly amazed by ordinary modern things, and usually spends his free time exploring modern war vehicles and machinery.!~

__Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night)

~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another.

Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

name.native: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン

node.description:
**Height:** 133 cm
**Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20

A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__
~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
~!185 cm (As Lord El-Melloi II)!~

Waver Velvet is a nineteen year old student at Clock Tower, an institute of the Magus Association, and mage with a recognized magical lineage of three generations. While he is talented, he is not recognized by his peers or lecturers.

An intelligent young man, Waver came up with the revolutionary concept that a mage's power could be increased through effort, experience, and knowledge rather than increasing magical potential through that of a mage's heirs. His idea is dismissed by his lecturer, the nobleman [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028), who tears up Waver's manuscript without another thought.

~!The Fourth Holy Grail War drastically changed his life, and before he realized it, he was suffering under the weight of the El-Melloi family’s mantle as one of the twelve Lords that rule and manage the Clock Tower, and the current head of the El-Melloi family. He wears his long hair straight, but it is kept quite well.!~
~!He also became a famous lecturer in the Clock Tower. Despite being hopeless as a magus, his skill as a lecturer dominates the rest, and is the best person at detecting the hidden talent of others and training it. There are no magi that were his students that hadn't obtained the rank of Grand, and it's even been said that if he gathered his students together, the power chart in the Clock Tower would change.!~

name.native: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン

node.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  

Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

name.native: ディルムッド・オディナ

node.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm
__Master:__ [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028/Archibald-El-Melloi-Kayneth)

__In Fate/Zero:__ 

~!Lancer is the Servant of Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi during the 4th Holy Grail War. Lancer is generally even-tempered, and absolutely loyal to his Master. He is known for his chivalry and sense of honor, in contrast to the arrogant personality of Kayneth. He shares a bond of mutual respect with rival Servant Saber, his greatest wish being to face her in fair combat.  

Lancer is summoned by Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi in the 4th Holy Grail War, who originally intended to summon Rider-class Servant, Iskandar. Because his pupil Waver Velvet stole the artifact he had meant to use as a catalyst, Kayneth summoned Diarmuid Ua Duibhne in Iskandar's stead. Lancer's contract with Kayneth is unique in that, while Kayneth holds the Command Spells, the energy to materialize the Servant is maintained by Sola-Ui, Kayneth's fiancée.

His true identity is Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the son of Donn, foster son of Aengus Óg and a warrior of the Fianna. Known as Diarmuid of the Love Spot, the appellation resulted from an encounter with Gráinne, a woman who caused a magical love spot to appear on his head. Any woman who looked upon his face would instantly fall in love with him.!~

__Height:__ 191 cm   
__Weight:__ 81 kg  

In Fate/Zero
    ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants.
Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight.  Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 173 cm

Kariya Matou is the uncle of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501), and the first scion of his family to be born with magical potential in several generations. Despite this, he grew disgusted with his family, particularly [Zoken Matou](https://anilist.co/character/16030), and cut all ties with them more than ten years prior to the 4th Holy Grail War. Disappointed with the lack of magical abilities in Shinji, Zoken resented Kariya for allowing the family's magical lineage to decline, especially since a Matō with magical powers was necessary to act as a Master during the Holy Grail Wars.

Kariya maintained contact with his childhood friend and love interest [Aoi Zenjou](https://anilist.co/character/16018), though he had willingly given up trying to pursue her affections after she married [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017). Aoi would later have two daughters, [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500), who were both fond of Kariya.

~!On the last day of the 4th Holy Grail War, [Berserker](https://anilist.co/character/12732) faces off against [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497), culminating in a battle so ferocious that Berserker draws more mana than Kariya can provide. His Servant killed, Kariya survives long enough to make his way back to the Matou estate, where he is approached by Sakura. He tells her that he has come to rescue her, but collapses at her feet soon after. Kariya dies with a satisfied smile, comforted by dreams of escaping with Aoi, Sakura, and Rin and starting a family together. !~

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: ナタリア・カミンスキー

node.description: A freelance mercenary who sold information concerning Noritaka and his research on vampires. She rescues a young Kiritsugu and takes him as her apprentice. During her last mission, she is able to successfully kill a Dead Apostle,  ~!but dies when Kiritsugu shoots down the plane she is on to prevent the infected passengers from infecting others when the plane landed. Kiritsugu's last words to her reveal that he viewed her as his mother.!~

__Height:__ 196 cm  


In Fate/Zero
~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners.  Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist humans into contraptions for his Master's entertainment, such as turning a girl into a pipe organ. 
In his past life, he was a French nobleman who was once a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne of Arc. He first introduces himself to his Master as Bluebeard, which is the name of a fictional character based on Gille himself.!~

__Height:__ 161 cm

A young woman who acts as [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu)'s assistant during the fourth Holy Grail War. She is cold and professional, which makes it easier for Kiritsugu to act as he needs to.

Little is known about her history, save that Kiritsugu had rescued her from a war-torn land many years ago. When Maiya was a child, she was forced into the army and trained to be a soldier. She later reveals to [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164/von-Einzbern-Irisviel), Kiritsugu's wife, that she had been raped by other soldiers and later lost her child. After rescuing her, Kiritsugu became Maiya's mentor and taught her his way of life.

Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old.

Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella.
She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

__Height:__ 174 cm
__Weight:__ 65 kg

The master of Caster, Ryuunosuke is a serial killer who summons Caster after murdering a family and using their blood as a component in the summoning ritual. Though he is not a magus, he was selected by the Holy Grail to fulfill the war's requirement of seven Masters and seven Servants. Ryuunosuke knows nothing about magic or the fourth Holy Grail War; his involvement in the war is simply to watch Caster kill people in unique and thrilling ways to relieve boredom.  (source: Type-Moon Wiki)

__Height:__ 177cm

The father of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/), two of the heroines from Fate/stay night. 

As a member of the Tohsaka family, he entered the Fourth Holy Grail War as the Master of Archer ([Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/)). [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/) identifies Tokiomi as one of the two most threatening magi involved in the war after assessing all the Masters involved. 

Tokiomi is an arrogant and manipulative man who strives, as all-powerful magi do, to reach Akasha, or "the root of all knowledge". Although he cares for his daughters and his wife, he appears to be oblivious to the problems and pain they face due to his decisions.

One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect and the 19th who took the name of Hassan-i-Sabah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain.

This particular individual suffered from Multiple Personality Disorder which he utilized to compartmentalize his abilities. This gave his Noble Phantasm the ability to manifest his different personalities as separate and autonomous entities. Though they differ in terms of build and sex, the different personas share similar characteristics: they have dark brown skin, purple hair (for those who have it) and wear white skeletal masks. 

Like all other Hassan-i-Sabah, he can be summoned only in the Assassin Class with the class itself acting as a catalyst.

__Personas:__
• Asako (アサ 子)
• Big Assassin (でかアサシン)
• Child Assassin (ちびアサシン)
• Macour the Quick (迅速のマクール)
• Strange Arm Gozour (怪腕のゴズール)
• Zayd the Base (基底のザイード)
• more...

__In Fate/Zero__

~!
Assassin serves as the Servant of Kirei Kotomine in the 4th Holy Grail War being mainly occupied with reconnaissance duties. The main personality that interfaces with Kirei is a young woman by the name of Asako.!~

__Height:__ 160 cm   

Aoi Tohsaka is the childhood friend of Kariya Matou, and became the wife of Tokiomi Tohsaka, adopting his surname. She is the mother of Tokiomi's two daughters, Rin and Sakura.  Aoi is a passive and loyal woman who does not interfere with her husband's affairs, described by Kirei Kotomine as the ideal version of a traditional wife. She accepted Tokiomi's proposal with full knowledge of what it meant to marry a mage. While Kariya loved her as well, he peacefully gave up pursuing her affections because she seemed happy accepting Tokiomi's proposal. It is implied that Aoi and Kariya remained in touch, given that her daughters, especially Sakura, were fond of Kariya's company.

node.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

A nobleman and a renowned mage from the Magus Association, Kayneth was a prodigy among magi, possessing exceptional magical potential and skills. He held the title of Euryphis lecturer within the Clock Tower, a notable mage academy, despite his young age. His magical lineage, going back nine generations, further enhanced his status. His magical abilities were attributed to wind and water, and he is proficient in the magical arts of summoning, alchemy, and spiritual evocation. He is also a teacher of Waver Velvet's, and was responsible for rejecting and tearing up Waver's radical thesis concerning magical potential. This act was in turn directly responsible for driving Waver to, in retaliation, enter the fourth Holy Grail War by stealing a valuable artifact from Kayneth.

Lord El-Melloi is, with regard to magical ability, arguably the most skilled Master in the Fourth Holy Grail War. He excels in magic involving mercury, which he employs to create a variety of attack and defence forms, such as barriers strong enough to resist point blank Claymore Mine blasts and flying blades capable of slicing through stone walls. Lord El-Melloi's mastery is great enough such that his enchanted mercury can react without his conscious control, automatically forming shields against surprise attacks. Kiritsugu Emiya initially regards Kayneth as one of the two most threatening magi involved in the war alongside Tokiomi Tōsaka, though neither are considered the most dangerous to be involved.

He's engaged to Sola-Ui Nuada-Re Sophia-Ri, the daughter of the head of the spiritual evocation division, through an arranged marriage. While Kayneth is in love with her, Sola-Ui despises Kayneth, considering him a coward for not attacking opposing Masters face to face.

Kayneth is the Master of Lancer in the Fourth Holy Grail War. His participation in the War is merely a bid to increase his own prominence within the Magus Association. His initial base of operations was located at the Fuyuki Hyatt Hotel, and protected by twenty-four layers of barriers, numerous summoned monsters, various traps, and mystical spatial alterations in the lobby.

A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

sampleCharacters.name: Kirei Kotomine
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night) ~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another. Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Diarmuid  Ua Duibhne
sampleCharacters.native: ディルムッド・オディナ
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 184 cm __Master:__ [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028/Archibald-El-Melloi-Kayneth) __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Lancer is the Servant of Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi during the 4th Holy Grail War. Lancer is generally even-tempered, and absolutely loyal to his Master. He is known for his chivalry and sense of honor, in contrast to the arrogant personality of Kayneth. He shares a bond of mutual respect with rival Servant Saber, his greatest wish being to face her in fair combat. Lancer is summoned by Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi in the 4th Holy Grail War, who originally intended to summon Rider-class Servant, Iskandar. Because his pupil Waver Velvet stole the artifact he had meant to use as a catalyst, Kayneth summoned Diarmuid Ua Duibhne in Iskandar's stead. Lancer's contract with Kayneth is unique in that, while Kayneth holds the Command Spells, the energy to materialize the Servant is maintained by Sola-Ui, Kayneth's fiancée. His true identity is Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the son of Donn, foster son of Aengus Óg and a warrior of the Fianna. Known as Diarmuid of the Love Spot, the appellation resulted from an encounter with Gráinne, a woman who caused a magical love spot to appear on his head. Any woman who looked upon his face would instantly fall in love with him.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Lancelot
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 191 cm __Weight:__ 81 kg In Fate/Zero ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants. Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight. Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Kariya Matou
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm Kariya Matou is the uncle of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501), and the first scion of his family to be born with magical potential in several generations. Despite this, he grew disgusted with his family, particularly [Zoken Matou](https://anilist.co/character/16030), and cut all ties with them more than ten years prior to the 4th Holy Grail War. Disappointed with the lack of magical abilities in Shinji, Zoken resented Kariya for allowing the family's magical lineage to decline, especially since a Matō with magical powers was necessary to act as a Master during the Holy Grail Wars. Kariya maintained contact with his childhood friend and love interest [Aoi Zenjou](https://anilist.co/character/16018), though he had willingly given up trying to pursue her affections after she married [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017). Aoi would later have two daughters, [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500), who were both fond of Kariya. ~!On the last day of the 4th Holy Grail War, [Berserker](https://anilist.co/character/12732) faces off against [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497), culminating in a battle so ferocious that Berserker draws more mana than Kariya can provide. His Servant killed, Kariya survives long enough to make his way back to the Matou estate, where he is approached by Sakura. He tells her that he has come to rescue her, but collapses at her feet soon after. Kariya dies with a satisfied smile, comforted by dreams of escaping with Aoi, Sakura, and Rin and starting a family together. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Natalia Kamiński
sampleCharacters.native: ナタリア・カミンスキー
sampleCharacters.description: A freelance mercenary who sold information concerning Noritaka and his research on vampires. She rescues a young Kiritsugu and takes him as her apprentice. During her last mission, she is able to successfully kill a Dead Apostle, ~!but dies when Kiritsugu shoots down the plane she is on to prevent the infected passengers from infecting others when the plane landed. Kiritsugu's last words to her reveal that he viewed her as his mother.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Gilles de Rais
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 196 cm In Fate/Zero ~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners. Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist humans into contraptions for his Master's entertainment, such as turning a girl into a pipe organ. In his past life, he was a French nobleman who was once a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne of Arc. He first introduces himself to his Master as Bluebeard, which is the name of a fictional character based on Gille himself.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise [Yuuichirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou) during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior. She is sarcastic and enjoys teasing others, especially Yuuichirou. 

Her Demon Weapon is Shikama Douji (Four-Scythe Child), a manifestation-type demon weapon which takes the form of a large scythe, but can be condensed into a pen-like object. She can call out the demon, which she fondly addresses as "Shi," inhabiting it out of the weapon to attack an enemy. Her primary ability is to detect anything that comes within the attack radius of her scythe.

Despite being a member of the distinguished Hiiragi family, Shinoa is uninterested in their internal power struggle. Moreover, due to her sister's legacy, she is generally shunned by the upper echelon of the army. However, she is loyal to Guren and to the members of her squad. 

A childhood lacking in familial warmth left Shinoa with little understanding of the importance of friendship and camaraderie. She is moved by Yuuichirou's unwavering loyalty to the members of his squad, who he considers his family, and wants to foster the same feelings for them herself.

__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

The deuteragonist of the Owari no Seraph series. He is an incomplete vampire and a servant of Third Progenitor [Krul Tepes](https://anilist.co/character/88899/Tepes-Krul). He was human until Krul Tepes forced him to drink her blood. He, along with [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou), possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End."

He wields a red colored sword. When he orders it to drink his blood, it sprouts thorny vines that pierce his hand. His strength grows in proportion to the amount of his blood the sword drinks.

__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Race:__ Human
__Section:__ Moon Demon Squad 
__Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon 
__Demon:__ Mahiru-no Yo

He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company.

Guren would become a wise leader who values teamwork, co-operation and friends, and determined those were necessary to ensure the survival of the human race from demons and vampires. Sometimes pretending to be lazy, in truth, he really works hard. He keeps many secrets to himself, and has no difficulty lying about them. When enduring hardships in battle, he will focus on winning and take the most direct path to that.

__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Yuuichirou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hiragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He, along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End".

Yuuichirou seems to be an excellent swordsman, as he was trained by Guren himself. He is also a "seraph of the end" with 1/10th of him being not human; he may have been experimented on by the Hyakuya, but this is unclear since the adults in charge of him were killed minutes after he arrived at the orphanage.

__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Krul Tepes is a third progenitor among the vampires and the former vampire queen of Japan. 

Just like all other vampires, she views the humans as nothing more than livestock. She sees them as foul and endlessly greedy creatures who will do anything for their own personal gain. When [Ferid Bathory](https://anilist.co/character/88990/Bathory-Ferid) slaughters the Hyakuya Sect orphans she carefully hid in Sanguinem and protected as livestock, she becomes enraged because he fatally wounded one of the seraph and allowed another to escape. She never mentions a word about the orphans and displays no interest in them.

She saves [Mika](https://anilist.co/character/87287/Hyakuya-Mikaela)'s life against his will by turning him into a vampire, but this appears to have been done for her own personal interests. He refuses to drink human blood, so she gives her blood to him in exchange for making him dependent on her. Even so, she is the only vampire who shows him kindness, and there are several moments when she hugs him or treats him gently.

After developing a close bond with Mika, she shows concern for his family member, [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou). She claims to like both Mika and Yu. However, it is uncertain if this is due to her close relation with Mika and concern for Mika's sake or if this is because she wants to use the seraph for her own purposes. She also appears to trust Mika, and only she and Mika appear to know Krul's true goals.

__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Race:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Japanese Imperial Demon Army
__Section:__ Moon Demon Squad
__Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon Series
__Demon:__ Byakomaru

A Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Although he has a high capacity for spellcraft since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable with being with the Hiiragi Family. Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by [Seishirou](https://anilist.co/character/89785/Hiiragi-Seishirou). 

He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality. Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as [Guren](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren). He is also very observant and perceptive, and easily grasps Guren's emotions.

name.native: フェリド・バートリー

node.description:
He is a seventh progenitor among the vampires. He is the one who killed Yuuichirou's family, thus fueling his desire for revenge against all vampires.

On the outside, Ferid acts kind and polite. However, he keeps many secrets which he has ready to deploy, and tells equally as many lies, similarly to use as and when they are best served. Extremely sadistic, Ferid will go to lengths to prepare, and then carry about murderous acts on a whim. A sense of pleasure appears to be gained in patiently manipulating others in order to torment them. Preferring the blood of beautiful boys and girls, he has kept many mansions filled with them over the centuries. Once he loses interest in one to the point of forgetting the child's name, Ferid kills him or her.

Chatty, Ferid strikes up conversations with other vampires, and will speak calmly even in tense scenarios where he has the air of very much being in control of a situation.

The demon into the black series demon blade used by [Yuuchirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou).

It often warns Yuuchirou about how humans are dangerous and can't be trusted.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Race__: Human
__Affiliation__: Japanese Imperial Demon Army
__Section__: Moon Demon Squad
__Demon Weapon Series__: Black Demon Series
__Demon__: Gekkouin

He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.

Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality. This gives him a strong mental balance against his demon, who takes the form of his sister. He lacked passion to kill vampires and fight and avenge his sister originally, but as he got to know his new "family", he began to see the reason that he was there. Yoichi does dislike conflict amongst friends, but conflict on the battle field doesn't bother him anymore. As time passed, Yoichi is shown to be much more confident with his skills, sniping down three Horsemen at ease by himself.

Yoichi is usually the peace maker around Shinoa's Squad. Yuichiro and Kimizuki are usually fighting, and Yoichi often ends up in the middle of it. He has developed a love for his "family" that impacted his personality greatly. He used to get very nervous and stutter a lot, but the closer he got to the Squad, the more confident he got. He doesn't question his self-worth as much as before, and instead focuses more on protecting his new "family".

name.native: クローリー・ユースフォード

node.description:
Crowley is a Thirteenth Progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. However, he hides his strength under Ferid's orders and is actually equal in strength to a Seventh Progenitor.
Crowley is calm and brave which makes him a patient vampire who enjoys fighting any opponent. Even when he is in a tight spot, he remains calm with a pleasant smile.

Despite sticking to Ferid, he appears to be emotionally detached from him, such as throwing the latter out of the bus as "revenge". Crowley also appears to be quite unimpressed with Ferid half of the time, calling his antics "stupid" and even sympathizing for the children getting dragged into the mess that Ferid created. He also doesn't appear to trust Ferid and is not afraid to be blunt to him for it.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Race__: Human

Kimizuki is a serious and diligent person. He is competitive against Yuuichirou Hyakuya. He earned the highest test scores in their class, and he is angry when Yuuichirou appears out of nowhere and may earn Cursed Gear before him. He is hot-headed and tends to get in fights with both Mitsuba and Yuuichirou.

sampleCharacters.name: Krul Tepes
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") Krul Tepes is a third progenitor among the vampires and the former vampire queen of Japan. Just like all other vampires, she views the humans as nothing more than livestock. She sees them as foul and endlessly greedy creatures who will do anything for their own personal gain. When [Ferid Bathory](https://anilist.co/character/88990/Bathory-Ferid) slaughters the Hyakuya Sect orphans she carefully hid in Sanguinem and protected as livestock, she becomes enraged because he fatally wounded one of the seraph and allowed another to escape. She never mentions a word about the orphans and displays no interest in them. She saves [Mika](https://anilist.co/character/87287/Hyakuya-Mikaela)'s life against his will by turning him into a vampire, but this appears to have been done for her own personal interests. He refuses to drink human blood, so she gives her blood to him in exchange for making him dependent on her. Even so, she is the only vampire who shows him kindness, and there are several moments when she hugs him or treats him gently. After developing a close bond with Mika, she shows concern for his family member, [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou). She claims to like both Mika and Yu. However, it is uncertain if this is due to her close relation with Mika and concern for Mika's sake or if this is because she wants to use the seraph for her own purposes. She also appears to trust Mika, and only she and Mika appear to know Krul's true goals.

Although he has a high capacity for spellcraft since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable with being with the Hiiragi Family. Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by [Seishirou](https://anilist.co/character/89785/Hiiragi-Seishirou). He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality. Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as [Guren](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren). He is also very observant and perceptive, and easily grasps Guren's emotions.

sampleCharacters.name: Ferid Bathory
sampleCharacters.native: フェリド・バートリー
sampleCharacters.description: He is a seventh progenitor among the vampires. He is the one who killed Yuuichirou's family, thus fueling his desire for revenge against all vampires. On the outside, Ferid acts kind and polite. However, he keeps many secrets which he has ready to deploy, and tells equally as many lies, similarly to use as and when they are best served. Extremely sadistic, Ferid will go to lengths to prepare, and then carry about murderous acts on a whim. A sense of pleasure appears to be gained in patiently manipulating others in order to torment them. Preferring the blood of beautiful boys and girls, he has kept many mansions filled with them over the centuries. Once he loses interest in one to the point of forgetting the child's name, Ferid kills him or her. Chatty, Ferid strikes up conversations with other vampires, and will speak calmly even in tense scenarios where he has the air of very much being in control of a situation.

sampleCharacters.name: Ashuramaru
sampleCharacters.description: The demon into the black series demon blade used by [Yuuchirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou). It often warns Yuuchirou about how humans are dangerous and can't be trusted.

sampleCharacters.name: Yoichi Saotome
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Race__: Human __Affiliation__: Japanese Imperial Demon Army __Section__: Moon Demon Squad __Demon Weapon Series__: Black Demon Series __Demon__: Gekkouin He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality. This gives him a strong mental balance against his demon, who takes the form of his sister. He lacked passion to kill vampires and fight and avenge his sister originally, but as he got to know his new "family", he began to see the reason that he was there. Yoichi does dislike conflict amongst friends, but conflict on the battle field doesn't bother him anymore. As time passed, Yoichi is shown to be much more confident with his skills, sniping down three Horsemen at ease by himself. Yoichi is usually the peace maker around Shinoa's Squad. Yuichiro and Kimizuki are usually fighting, and Yoichi often ends up in the middle of it. He has developed a love for his "family" that impacted his personality greatly. He used to get very nervous and stutter a lot, but the closer he got to the Squad, the more confident he got. He doesn't question his self-worth as much as before, and instead focuses more on protecting his new "family".

sampleCharacters.name: Crowley Eusford
sampleCharacters.native: クローリー・ユースフォード
sampleCharacters.description: Crowley is a Thirteenth Progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. However, he hides his strength under Ferid's orders and is actually equal in strength to a Seventh Progenitor. Crowley is calm and brave which makes him a patient vampire who enjoys fighting any opponent. Even when he is in a tight spot, he remains calm with a pleasant smile. Despite sticking to Ferid, he appears to be emotionally detached from him, such as throwing the latter out of the bus as "revenge". Crowley also appears to be quite unimpressed with Ferid half of the time, calling his antics "stupid" and even sympathizing for the children getting dragged into the mess that Ferid created. He also doesn't appear to trust Ferid and is not afraid to be blunt to him for it.

She is also someone who can't be honest with herself and having difficulty to be more straightforward. Among the sisters, Itsuki is the most familiar with [Uesugi](https://anilist.co/character/128063)'s family members and circumstances. Note: Based on the character file in volume 14, Itsuki’s actual birthday is on May 6th as she was born at midnight. She celebrates her birthday on May 5th and prevents others from looking into it too deeply.

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

Third sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. She is a silent and reserved girl. Miku tends to have a pessimistic attitude and little confidence regarding herself. Due to [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou)'s influence, she's the first among the sisters who open up to him.

Miku likes Japanese History (especially Generals from Sengoku Period) and greatly influenced by their philosophies, to the point of affecting her real-life behavior.

**Height:** 159 cm (5'2")

Second sister of the Nakano quintuplets. She usually acts as the mother of the family, she cooks for them and takes care of their medical needs. Among the five sisters, she is the one who has the highest hostility towards [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou) and often rebels against him.

Nino has a sharp tongue and talks bluntly when confronting the others, even if the other party is her sister. She has an outgoing attitude and is socially aware, resulting in her having many friends. She is a scheming person and doesn't hesitate to use underhanded methods to achieve her goals.

**Height:** 159 cm (5'2")

She is the fourth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets, and one of the main characters of the Quintessential Quintuplets series. Having a cheerful and energetic personality, she has a strong tendency of helping people out. Yotsuba is an active and easygoing girl. She is a type of person who can't say no to people who need help. She is also very physically fit, and is capable of tasks that her sisters can not do. She has excellent endurance and is great at sports. She's the only sister with excellent eyesight. She has a good sense of smell and a green thumb. Though she's great at physical activities, she has the lowest score out of all of her sisters.

Yotsuba is the only sister who accepts [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063) since the beginning and wholeheartedly supports him in everything.

__Height__: 159 cm (5'2")

First sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Despite the negligible age difference among them, she took the role of the eldest sister properly. She is also trusted enough to act as their confidant and leader. Ichika aspires to become an actress. She likes to tease [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063).

__Height:__ 178 cm  (5'10'')

Fuutarou is the main protagonist of the 5-toubun no Hanayome series.

He is a student of the Asahiyama High School. He lives with his father, Isanari Uesugi, and younger sister, Raiha Uesugi, in a small apartment. He is a serious and hardworking high school student and a prodigy at the top of his grade. Because of his family's perpetual poverty, he takes up the offer to tutor the Nakano quintuplets.

Fuutarou is noted to have a big ego and high confidence. He is straightforward, tactless, and rude; but is actually capable of holding back his emotions. Despite that, Fuutarou could momentarily lose his composure when agitated and faced with unfavorable circumstances. He also initially did not like getting involved with other people's problems, finding them to be troublesome. Despite his tactlessness and crudeness, he is knowledgeable enough in knowing what to say in specific situations when thrown at him; rarely giving up when trying to achieve a specific objective.

Despite his egotistical nature, Fuutarou is very hardworking and has a very high amount of patience; especially when getting the attention of the quintuplets and tutoring them despite various amounts of failures and setbacks. He later on shows a sense of duty strong enough to help the quintuplets in their studies despite them not paying him immediately, even though the money that came with tutoring was the initial reason he accepted the job. He also begins valuing their relationship to the point where he would do things outside of their tutor-student relationship which would later on bloom into a bond where they mutually support each other with little question.

Fuutarou's cheerful younger sister. Being the only female and the most family-conscious she is effectively the head of the small household. Her cute facial expressions will often sway others' hearts. Appreciating the hard work Fuutarou does for their family, she sometimes delays the supper until his late return home so she can prepare his favourite meal.
Father of [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Fuutarou-Uesugi) and [Raiha](https://anilist.co/character/130111/Raiha-Uesugi).
Stepfather of the Nakano Quintuplets after their mother remarried, several years before the series begins. He runs a large hospital and is also a doctor.

Student of the Asahiyama High School.
Before the school camping trip, Maeda asked Ichika Nakano to see him in a class where he would ask her to dance with him at the bonfire dance.    ~!This came out as a failure. Later he went with another girl at the bonfire dance. Five years later, the pair showed up at Fuutarou's wedding, already married and she is pregnant.!~
She is a student of the Asahiyama High School and friend of [Nino Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/126372/).

She is the captain of the Basketball Club. Yotsuba would constantly assist the the Club, Due to her inability to say no. Hongo would even ask her if she wanted to join the club, to which Yotsuba refuses.

Despite his tactlessness and crudeness, he is knowledgeable enough in knowing what to say in specific situations when thrown at him; rarely giving up when trying to achieve a specific objective. Despite his egotistical nature, Fuutarou is very hardworking and has a very high amount of patience; especially when getting the attention of the quintuplets and tutoring them despite various amounts of failures and setbacks. He later on shows a sense of duty strong enough to help the quintuplets in their studies despite them not paying him immediately, even though the money that came with tutoring was the initial reason he accepted the job. He also begins valuing their relationship to the point where he would do things outside of their tutor-student relationship which would later on bloom into a bond where they mutually support each other with little question.

sampleCharacters.name: Raiha Uesugi
sampleCharacters.description: Fuutarou's cheerful younger sister. Being the only female and the most family-conscious she is effectively the head of the small household. Her cute facial expressions will often sway others' hearts. Appreciating the hard work Fuutarou does for their family, she sometimes delays the supper until his late return home so she can prepare his favourite meal.

sampleCharacters.name: Isanari Uesugi
sampleCharacters.description: Father of [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Fuutarou-Uesugi) and [Raiha](https://anilist.co/character/130111/Raiha-Uesugi).

sampleCharacters.name: Maruo Nakano
sampleCharacters.description: Stepfather of the Nakano Quintuplets after their mother remarried, several years before the series begins. He runs a large hospital and is also a doctor.

sampleCharacters.name: Maeda

Before the school camping trip, Maeda asked Ichika Nakano to see him in a class where he would ask her to dance with him at the bonfire dance. ~!This came out as a failure. Later he went with another girl at the bonfire dance. Five years later, the pair showed up at Fuutarou's wedding, already married and she is pregnant.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Oda
