Keima Katsuragi is a 17-year-old high school student attending Maijima High School Academy. At an early age, he acquired an obsessive interest in video games; now he is known as "The Capturing God (Otoshi-gami)" in the gaming world for his legendary skills in "capturing" any girls in dating sims.

name.native: エリュシア・デ・ルート・イーマ

node.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (with bun)
__Job:__ Private Household Demon
__Class:__ 2-B

Elsie is a shinigami who was assigned to capture evil spirits that have escaped from hell and is the Deuteragonist of the story. She is shown to have a very sweet, pure and innocent personality and often tries to please [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s expectations as a "little sister" though often fails due to the cultural differences between them.

Her feather cloth (the floating scarf she is always seen with) can change the appearance of an object, create disguises, or hide people in plain sight. She is left-handed and is rarely seen without her broom, which she had for 298 years, as it was from her original role as a cleaner for hell. Ironically, despite being a demon, she is shown to have an incredible fear of ghosts and the dark.  

To stay close to Keima, she tells [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/22308/Katsuragi-Mari), Keima's mother, that she is an illegitimate child of Keima's father (nearly getting his parents divorced), and ends up living in the Katsuragi household as well as attending the same class in school.

name.native: ハクア・ド・ロット・ヘルミニウム

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
__Job:__ Domestic Genius

Haqua is a fellow Spirit hunter and friend of [Elsie](https://anilist.co/character/14015/de-Lute-Ima-Elucia). A 300 year old demon, she is an outstanding honor student and the District Chief of Area 32 in Nagumo City. As a child, she always tried to be the best in everything she does hence her perfect record.

__Class:__ 2-B 
__Height:__ 158 cm   

A friend of [Ayumi Takahara](https://anilist.co/character/15636/Takahara-Ayumi). Chihiro is a girl who tries to confess to a boy immediately after she thinks that he is handsome and attractive. However, she has confessed to many boys without positive results. [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) describes Chihiro as a "mob character" using visual novel argot. 

~!While even though she forgets the conquest, it is later shown that Chihiro actually has a crush on Keima. She later helps Keima bring out the goddess out of Ayumi during Goddess Arc. It is hinted in Chapter 189 that she is Keima's first love.!~

~!Keima eventually chooses Chihiro, and it is revealed she is the only girl that fell in love with him before the conquests.!~

__Height:__ 161 cm

Kanon is the most popular teen idol around for her beauty and singing talents. She was also in [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) and [Elsie](https://anilist.co/character/14015/de-Lute-Ima-Elucia)'s class but had not been in school because of her idol status. However, she returns one day.

She is constantly worried about the acknowledgment of her existence by others; this fear was so extreme and demonstrated when she attacked Keima with a stun gun after he said that he did not know her. Kanon hopes that her song would "resound in everyone's hearts."

~!She becomes the target of Fiore of Vintage which causes Kanon to be paranoid to the point that she reveals to Keima she still remembers him and confesses her love to him in front of their class. But before Keima can do anything, [Apollo](https://anilist.co/character/37193/Apollo) takes over and runs away but is soon stabbed by Fiore with a enchanted cursed dagger. Kanon is currently in a coma where Apollo's powers are keeping her alive for at least one week. Blaming himself for not being quick to rescue her, Keima vows to find the other Goddesses to save Kanon/Apollo's lives and has Elsie, a big fan of Kanon, disguises herself as Kanon to avoid a commotion in public.!~

__Class:__ 2-C 
__Height:__ 157 cm   

Shiori is a quiet girl who loves to read books. She is the librarian of the enormous collection of books in the school. [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) immediately catches her attention and anger by saying that books are useless. Shiori finally brings herself to shout out at Keima after he abused, marked, and tore some books.

~!Keima describes her character archetype as 'liberal art girl', who never speaks out loud, but thinks twice more than average person.!~

__Class:__ 2-B
__Height:__ 158 cm

A girl in [Keima Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s class at school, Ayumi is a member of the school's track team. She is an exceptional runner and quite likely the best on the team. However, she was bullied by the upperclasswomen in her team.

__Height:__ 149 cm
__Class:__ 2-A

She is known as the rich girl of Maishima Academy. However, her father passed away over a year ago and has been living in an run down apartment since then. She is the second heroine to appear in the series.

~![Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) describes her as tsundere, based on her appearance; cat eyes, light hair colour, visible forehead and pigtails. He also claims that he has seen character like her 300 times in games. She seems to have some sadistic nature towards Keima.!~

__Height:__ 170 cm  
__Class:__ 2-B    

A born sadist, Nikaido is [Keima Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s homeroom and Japanese teacher. She has been ignoring Keima ever since he told her that there are 5012 games that are more fun than her lessons.  Nikaido is also a school senior of [Jun Nagase](https://anilist.co/character/22307/Nagase-Jun).

~!In the later chapter, she was revealed to be one of the partner of demon called 'Akari'. This might have been foreshadowed from the start of the series, as she always had collar around her neck like Keima.

Although she is a human and apparently borrowing all her abilities of capturing from [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/36075/Kurakawa-Akari), she is shown to be extremely powerful. She was able to capture level 4 spirit without a single difficulty even though it was not able to be handled by entire run-away spirit squad from the district.!~

__Height:__ 168 cm 

[Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s mother resembles a typical shoujo manga-style mother; optimistic, ditsy, and loving. However, when she is angry, Mari removes her glasses and lets her hair down and changes her personality completely. Keima claims that she used to be a part of a biker gang.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dokurou Skull is hell's branch chief of "counter measures". She assigned Elsie to capture spirits in the human world and sent Keima Katsuragi the contract letter.    ~!She is suspected of being a member of Vintage.!~

__Job:__ Loop Art Club Member 
__Height:__ 160 cm   

Heroine of "Kureyon - Sora no Art", Atelier Lilith's game for PFP that can't be cleared because of the bugs.

~!In the end, [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) ends up conquring Sora without ever even knowing it.!~

**Class:** 2-B  

A second-year Maijima High School Academy student enrolled in Class 2-B. Miyako is a close friend of Ayumi and Chihiro. She has a long hair and freckles on her cheeks. Track-and-field club member.  After Chihiro Arc, she became a member of Chihiro's band. Responsible for the keyboard (KORG X50).

Keima's 10,000th target captured in galge.    

(Source: AniDB)

Maijima High's English teacher and the Head of Arts Clubs. Kodama's personality is similar to that of Nikaido and he has a tendency to deny students from doing what they enjoy, such as denying the creation of a Light Music Club for Chihiro's band unless they all manage to achieve 100 percent in the oncoming test. Kodama has an insidious nature against Keima, because he cannot do anything about Keima playing games in his class due to the fact that Keima was able to ace all of the tests given out by Kodama.
Yuri is the former member of Citron and an old friend of Kanon.
Lime is the former leader of Citron and an old friend of Kanon.
Kanon's manager.
The chairman of the Library committee.

node.description: A girl whose cool indifference won’t allow others to get close. As the Saint of Gunpowder she uses guns and bullets in battle.
A young boy who calls himself the strongest man in the world. He fights with a mastery of various secret weapons.
A strange man who mimics a cat as he talks. He fences with an unworldly and peculiar skill.

node.description:
Though she is the princess of the large kingdom Piena, she is a wild and free girl, full of mischief. She is the Saint of Blades.

~!She was the seventh brave who activated the barrier around the temple.!~
An extremely serious and intellectual woman. She serves as the leader of the Saints and is the Saint of Mountains.
A proud girl who is called the most powerful warrior of the current age. She is the Saint of Swamps.

name.native: ゴルドフ・アウオーラ

node.description: A young knight completely devoted to Nashetania, he wields a giant spear.
Tgurneu is one of the three Kyouma leaders along with Dozzu and Cargikk.

name.native: ロロニア・マンチェッタ

node.description:
Rolonia Machetta is one of the Six Flowers, and also, Saint of Fresh Blood. She meets with the Six Flowers, around the end of first volume of LN, or in the last episode of the anime. She has a timid personality. She uses a whip for weapon, and has healing abilities. She can analyze any blood by tasting it.

She was just a servant who washed clothes at the temple of the God of Fresh Blood. After being selected as the Saint of Fresh Blood, [Mora Chester](https://anilist.co/character/89080) guided and helped her. Mora has sent her next to Atro Spyker for training and education. This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm. 

~!He was Humanity's representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~
The God of destruction and one of the principal deities of Hinduism.

Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

~!Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

~!Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

Heracles is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with [Buddha](https://anilist.co/character/175945/Buddha) and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity.

~!Heracles is the Gods' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.
Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms. ~!Humanity's vanguard and representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Hrist is the second of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Kojirou Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/140646/Kojirou-Sasaki) during the third round of Ragnarok.!~
Supreme god of Nordic.
Eve is the wife of Adam, who was falsely accused by The Serpent of eating the apple from the Tree of Knowledge.
The watchman of the apocalypse.

__Species__: Demigod

Reginleif is the seventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/140637/Adam) during the second round of Ragnarok.!~
Ares is the 6th of the 12 Gods of Olympus and the Greek God of War.

__Species__: Demigod

Randgriz is the fourth of the Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Lü Bu](https://anilist.co/character/140645).!~
Muninn is one of the pair of ravens that accompany Odin.
Chen Gong is a strategist from the Lu Bu's army. Like the rest of the Lu Bu's men, he is very loyal and passionate about him.

__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

**Height:** 164 cm

Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.  Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne.

~!In the Charlemagne Legend, he is the son of an English king, and one of [Charlemagne](https://anilist.co/character/259823/Charlemagne)'s twelve faithful Paladins. He is beautiful beyond all compare, but he is also a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on until those involved lose all rationality. His conversations, through no ill intent on his part, have a way of meandering toward maximum social awkwardness. His hobby of adventuring gets himself mixed up in an assorted amount of mischief due to him constantly popping up everywhere. He states that his hair ornaments, which seem like something a princess would wear, are an "irresistible proof of friendship" that he uses to restore peace to his depressively mad boon ally, [Orlando](https://anilist.co/character/286219/Roland).!~

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__
~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
~!185 cm (As Lord El-Melloi II)!~

Waver Velvet is a nineteen year old student at Clock Tower, an institute of the Magus Association, and mage with a recognized magical lineage of three generations. While he is talented, he is not recognized by his peers or lecturers.

An intelligent young man, Waver came up with the revolutionary concept that a mage's power could be increased through effort, experience, and knowledge rather than increasing magical potential through that of a mage's heirs. His idea is dismissed by his lecturer, the nobleman [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028), who tears up Waver's manuscript without another thought.

~!The Fourth Holy Grail War drastically changed his life, and before he realized it, he was suffering under the weight of the El-Melloi family’s mantle as one of the twelve Lords that rule and manage the Clock Tower, and the current head of the El-Melloi family. He wears his long hair straight, but it is kept quite well.!~
~!He also became a famous lecturer in the Clock Tower. Despite being hopeless as a magus, his skill as a lecturer dominates the rest, and is the best person at detecting the hidden talent of others and training it. There are no magi that were his students that hadn't obtained the rank of Grand, and it's even been said that if he gathered his students together, the power chart in the Clock Tower would change.!~

Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. 

He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance.

Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

Lancer of Red is the Lancer-class Servant of Shirou Kotomine of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Originally summoned by one of the five puppet Masters of the Red Faction, he later becomes one of the Servants of Shirou.

~!Lancer's identity is Karna, Son of the Sun God, the invulnerable hero of the Indian epic Mahabharata. Karna was born between a human mother Kunti and the Sun God Surya. As proof of being the son of Surya, he was given a golden armor that granted invulnerability. Karna was born to become a great hero. However, Kunti abandoned Karna and became the queen of King Kuru. Not knowing who his mother was, Karna grew up with a low social status. However, he soon made his existence known to the world by becoming the honored guest of the Royal House Kauravas, who were hostile to King Kuru. Karna participated in the wars around the borders and fought on an equal footing with Arjuna, son of Kunti and Thunder God Indra. Karna eventually fell in battle after being robbed of his golden armor by Indra, suffering many curses, and losing all of his allies. He died in the hands of his half-brother Arjuna. However, he did not hate anyone and accepted his death.!~

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

alternative: Assassin of Red (赤のアサシン‚ Aka no Assassin)

node.description:
Servant of Shirou as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Assassin's identity is Semiramis, Wise Queen of Assyria (アッシリアの賢女王), a legendary queen who reigned over the empire of Assyria. Since her childhood, she has studied a wide range of disciplines such as cosmetics, hairdressing, dancing, clothing, music, astronomy, and her beautiful face has captivated many men. A very enthusiastic person, she indulges in luxury and decadence. Her passion has led her to start a war to possess a single man, and to poison her husband, the king, for politics. But her abilities as a queen are indisputable, as she has led many expeditions, as seen on walls and the Ishtar Gate. She uses poison as her weapon.

(Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

__Height:__ 163 cm 
__Servant type:__ Caster

~!An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!~

node.description:
Archer of "Red" is the Archer-class Servant of [Rottweil Berzinsky](https://anilist.co/character/232918/Berzinsky-Rottweil) of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. [Shirou Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/35603/Amakusa--Shirou-Tokisada) assumes command over her before she even meets her Master, and through his machinations, he later officially becomes Archer's Master.

Archer's True Name is Atalanta, a famous huntress known as the Chaste Huntress that appears in Greek Mythology. She is a huntress who is famous for her swift feet in Ancient Greek legend. She became famous after being the first one to drive an arrow into the Calydonian Boar during its extermination. Also, she is included as a member of the Argonauts, which assembled brave heroes from all over Greece. She has the tragic past of being born as the daughter of a king of a certain country and yet being abandoned in the mountains by her father.

~!Atalanta was born as the daughter of King Iasus of Arcadia. However, although she was born in and as the princess of the natural paradise, Atalanta ended up being abandoned in the forests and on the mountains immediately she was born as she was shunned by her father - who desired a son. But she survived thanks to the divine protection from Artemis, a virgin goddess who felt pity for her. Artemis sent and made a female bear, a sacred beast of the goddess, nurture the girl by giving her milk and raising her up. In gratitude, Atalanta is a fervent follower of Artemis!~

~!During the final battle in Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha, Atalanta faces [Ruler](https://anilist.co/character/67769/dArc-Jeanne) who she still blames for the death of the children that make up [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/55951/Jack-the-Ripper). She activates her personal Noble Phantasm, Agrius Metamorphosis, which not only transforms her into a monstrous version of herself, but increases her physical abilities. Ruler expresses pure disgust at Atalanta for discarding her heroic side and reducing herself to a rabid monster.!~

node.description:
Morgan le Fay is the sister of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497) and mother of [Gawain](https://anilist.co/character/138357), [Agravain](https://anilist.co/character/220186), [Gaheris](https://anilist.co/character/302881), [Gareth](https://anilist.co/character/239525) and [Mordred](https://anilist.co/character/55977).
 Morgan was the daughter of Tintagel, the fae child conceived by Igraine, the progeny of the British Isles... and later, Artoria's stepsister, as Morgan's mother Igraine wed King Uther.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__ 

~![Kairi Sisigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397) has dreams of Mordred's past showing how Morgan encouraged her to join the Knights of the Round Table, and later revealed to Mordred that she was King Arthur's son and encouraged her to turn against Arthur.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Cosmos in the Lostbelt:__ 

~!She established an authoritarian monarchy in the Lostbelt Britain and has made the fairies suffer under her oppressive rule for 2000 years. As the highest-ranking fairy, she is a genius sorcerer who has mastered Rhongomyniad, the Lance that Shines to the Ends of the World, as a form of Magecraft.!~

__Height:__ 187 cm

Sir Bedivere was among the first Knights of the Round table, and he remained faithful to the [King](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) until the end. 

Although he was the one who closest guarded the King, he never saw her smile nor learned of her identity as a woman. After attending the King's death he found himself initially unable to return Excalibur to the [Lady of the Lake](https://anilist.co/character/333146/Vivian), for that would signal Artoria was truly gone. Though sad the hard work of his King was not properly rewarded, he understood her Fate could not be changed and finally returned the Sword, hoping she would find a peaceful slumber.

__In Fate/Grand Order Divine Realm of the Round Table:__

~!In this version of History he was unable to return Excalibur, making it impossible for Artoria to pass away and reach Avalon. He has been wandering the Earth for 1500 years, wrought with guilt, trying to finally complete the task the King assigned him!~

name.native: フランケンシュタイン

node.description:
Berserker is Frankenstein, Frankenstein's monster, the homunculus created by Victor Frankenstein appearing in Mary Shelley's novel. Into the Great Holy Grail War Berserker is summoned by Caules Forvedge Yggdmillennia with Victor Frankenstein's plans for a "perfect human" as a catalyst

~!Berserker's True Name is Frankenstein (フランケンシュタイン, Furankenshutain), the Frankenstein's monster (フランケンシュタインの怪物, Furankenshutain no Kaibutsu). Based upon the artificial life created by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's novel "Frankenstein: or the Modern Prometheus". Victor sought to recreate the original couple described in the bible -- Adam and Eve. Due to the limitations of man, he first built Eve, intending for her to give birth to the counterpart. What started as a patchwork of lifeless flesh was given life by the energy harnessed from lightning. Unfortunately, what awoke was not the ideal woman that Victor envisioned, but an abomination with the mind of an infant. Having no developed capacity for expression, her sense of morality was completely absent. After presenting the entrails of a slain dog as a gift for the master, she was branded a failure and disassembled, before being abandoned completely.!~

name.native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー

Densetsu no Shiriaru Kiraa (伝説の連続殺人鬼)

node.description:
Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha.

She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

alternative: Shirou Kotomine (シロウ・コトミネ)

node.description:
The Master of [Assasin of Red](https://anilist.co/character/35596/Semiramis), Shirou was dispatched by the Church as one of the Masters of the Red Faction. 

~!He is actually a Ruler-class Servant of the [Einzbern Master](https://anilist.co/character/286211/Einzbern-Master)‎‎ in the Third Holy Grail War. He was later materialized due to having come into contact with the Greater Grail and managing to receive flesh.!~

He wants to make use of the Holy Grail War to fulfill his own wish. He has no connection to [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) of the [Fate/stay night](https://anilist.co/manga/30715/Fatestay-night/) timeline.

__Height:__ 191 cm   
__Weight:__ 81 kg  

In Fate/Zero
    ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants.
Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight.  Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

__In Fate/Stay Night:__
~!The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!~

Sieg was created by Yggdmillennia as one of their many homunculi suited to various purposes. Initially kept in a prana supply tank devised by Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia to grant energy for Servants, he was one of many allowed to be used by Caster of Black for usage as harvesting materials for his golems. Due to his unexpectedly high quality Magic Circuits, he was thought to be a good choice for Caster's Golem Keter Malkuth.

Sieg comes into consciousness without anything to form a personality. He is scared of everything but himself, believing to be nothing. He calls himself transparent and colorless because he possesses nothing and had received nothing from his birth. 

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

alternative: Rider of Red (赤のライダー)

node.description:
Rider of "Red" is the Rider-class Servant of Cabik Pentel of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Shirou Kotomine assumes command over him before he even meets his Master, and through his machinations he later officially becomes Rider's Master.

~!Rider's True Name is Achilles (アキレウス, Akireusu), one of the famous heroes in the Trojan Wars. Born from the sea goddess Thetis and the hero Peleus, Achilles was blessed by the gods from birth. His mother Thetis, having greatly loved her son, had warmed him within holy flames in order to try and make him immortal. But her husband Peleus had opposed it, saying “Then that would destroy Achilles as a human”, and in the end Achilles grew up while only a certain part of him remained human. Eventually, when war broke out between Troia and Achaea, Achilles was asked the following by his mother Thetis: "Do you wish to live a long and peaceful life without having your name recognized by the masses? Or do you wish to live the short life of a hero with brilliant achievements in battle?" Achilles choice went without saying. At the same time as his mother felt pride in his decision, she also felt heartbreakingly sad, because his fate had been predetermined since he was born. If he lived as a hero, he would have a short life, as if sprinting through it at full speed.!~
Master of [Mordred Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/55977/Pendragon-Mordred).

name.native: フラット・エスカルドス

node.description:
He is the Master of [Berserker](https://anilist.co/character/87321/Berserker) in the Holy Grail War in Snowfield. 

A student at the Clock Tower, the greatest school backed by the Magic Association, he is overcome by a great desire to go see the Holy Grail in Snowfield. While he is talented, he lacks the proper disposition to be a Magus. His teacher is [Lord El-Melloi II](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Velvet-Waver).

Siegfried is the hero portrayed as the main character of the German Nibelungenlied epic. Prince of the Netherlands, he wields the precious sword Balmung which he received from the Nibelungen family and has fought in many campaigns and adventures. His most well-known feat is killing the evil dragon Fafnir. He then bathed in the blood of the dragon and has obtained an invincible body. 

In Fate/Apocrypha
~!He is the Servant of Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War. He killed himself and gave his heart to Sieg so that he would be able to live a full life. Sieg named himself this to honor Siegfried's sacrifice.    !~  (Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

__Height:__ 196 cm  


In Fate/Zero
~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners.  Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist humans into contraptions for his Master's entertainment, such as turning a girl into a pipe organ. 
In his past life, he was a French nobleman who was once a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne of Arc. He first introduces himself to his Master as Bluebeard, which is the name of a fictional character based on Gille himself.!~

Caster of Red is the Caster-class Servant of Jean Rum of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Placing the importance of the Story above all else, he lies and cheats and by any means conduct himself that he might witness the unfolding of a grand tale, beautiful beyond compare. Consequently, he tends to distance himself from mentality of the "participant," taking instead the perspective of an abstract, "Authorial" third person. His regard for others differs by individual, dependent on their qualification as a special existence, or "protagonist." He interacts with "normal humans" only in a shallow, dismissive manner, and expresses an extreme interest in "protagonists." In slight narcissism, he frequently drops such self-authored quotes as, "Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill." He's taken a liking to certain terminology from modern fiction, such as "Death-Flagging." With short and effective words, he brings to light that what humans usually keep hidden. This is like suddenly being poked by rambling, incongruous words, so one would probably feel shocked.

As the world is the greatest story ever told to him, or so it ought to be in his eyes, he willingly employs deception, provocation, or anything else for the sake of spinning the story. He greatly loves those who are out of the ordinary from the bottom of his heart, perusing the tales they spin. With greatly exaggerated outbursts of emotion, he acts as he wishes, gracefully admitting that it is suitable to call him a trickster.

~!Caster's true name is William Shakespeare (ウィリアム・シェイクスピア), a poet and playwright from the Elizabethan England.
His father was an affluent man in Stratford, but it is uncertain if Shakespeare received a higher education. Half of his life is shrouded in mystery and there are many mysteries in his career, such as an undocumented gap of seven years. In his early days as a playwright, his productions revolved around comedy, then historical drama, before he changed his style for magnificent tragedy. At the same time, he also played as an actor in the underground, and he was the target of slander and derision from influential people. In any case, he just had to write a few works and his reputation didn't know where to stop. Considering how he was belittled by a senior playwright as a "upstart Crow" at the time, it seems that he was quite envied.
He is the only playwright whose fame has reached around the world, he is representative of authors of the western world. His name shines brilliantly on the history of English literature, his popularity as a great man from England is the highest possible. Still having a large influence over modern literature, it can be said that those with no knowledge of his works are to be disparaged as ignorant. It is also said that those looking to trace the source of any piece of modern literature will always find a Shakespearean creation. Having written too many masterpieces to list, his four greatest tragedies rising above all others are "Othello," "Macbeth," "Hamlet" and "King Lear."!~

(Source: Type Moon Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Astolfo
sampleCharacters.description: **Height:** 164 cm Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne. ~!In the Charlemagne Legend, he is the son of an English king, and one of [Charlemagne](https://anilist.co/character/259823/Charlemagne)'s twelve faithful Paladins. He is beautiful beyond all compare, but he is also a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on until those involved lose all rationality. His conversations, through no ill intent on his part, have a way of meandering toward maximum social awkwardness. His hobby of adventuring gets himself mixed up in an assorted amount of mischief due to him constantly popping up everywhere. He states that his hair ornaments, which seem like something a princess would wear, are an "irresistible proof of friendship" that he uses to restore peace to his depressively mad boon ally, [Orlando](https://anilist.co/character/286219/Roland).!~

sampleCharacters.name: Jeanne  d'Arc
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3) Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants. Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

sampleCharacters.name: Mordred Pendragon
sampleCharacters.description: Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. [Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot. __In Fate/Apocrypha:__ ~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Merlin
sampleCharacters.description: Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance. Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

sampleCharacters.name: Karna
sampleCharacters.description: Lancer of Red is the Lancer-class Servant of Shirou Kotomine of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Originally summoned by one of the five puppet Masters of the Red Faction, he later becomes one of the Servants of Shirou. ~!Lancer's identity is Karna, Son of the Sun God, the invulnerable hero of the Indian epic Mahabharata. Karna was born between a human mother Kunti and the Sun God Surya. As proof of being the son of Surya, he was given a golden armor that granted invulnerability. Karna was born to become a great hero. However, Kunti abandoned Karna and became the queen of King Kuru. Not knowing who his mother was, Karna grew up with a low social status. However, he soon made his existence known to the world by becoming the honored guest of the Royal House Kauravas, who were hostile to King Kuru. Karna participated in the wars around the borders and fought on an equal footing with Arjuna, son of Kunti and Thunder God Indra. Karna eventually fell in battle after being robbed of his golden armor by Indra, suffering many curses, and losing all of his allies. He died in the hands of his half-brother Arjuna. However, he did not hate anyone and accepted his death.!~ (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Semiramis
sampleCharacters.description: Servant of Shirou as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Assassin's identity is Semiramis, Wise Queen of Assyria (アッシリアの賢女王), a legendary queen who reigned over the empire of Assyria. Since her childhood, she has studied a wide range of disciplines such as cosmetics, hairdressing, dancing, clothing, music, astronomy, and her beautiful face has captivated many men. A very enthusiastic person, she indulges in luxury and decadence. Her passion has led her to start a war to possess a single man, and to poison her husband, the king, for politics. But her abilities as a queen are indisputable, as she has led many expeditions, as seen on walls and the Ishtar Gate. She uses poison as her weapon. (Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

sampleCharacters.name: Atalanta
sampleCharacters.description: Archer of "Red" is the Archer-class Servant of [Rottweil Berzinsky](https://anilist.co/character/232918/Berzinsky-Rottweil) of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. [Shirou Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/35603/Amakusa--Shirou-Tokisada) assumes command over her before she even meets her Master, and through his machinations, he later officially becomes Archer's Master. Archer's True Name is Atalanta, a famous huntress known as the Chaste Huntress that appears in Greek Mythology. She is a huntress who is famous for her swift feet in Ancient Greek legend. She became famous after being the first one to drive an arrow into the Calydonian Boar during its extermination. Also, she is included as a member of the Argonauts, which assembled brave heroes from all over Greece. She has the tragic past of being born as the daughter of a king of a certain country and yet being abandoned in the mountains by her father. ~!Atalanta was born as the daughter of King Iasus of Arcadia. However, although she was born in and as the princess of the natural paradise, Atalanta ended up being abandoned in the forests and on the mountains immediately she was born as she was shunned by her father - who desired a son. But she survived thanks to the divine protection from Artemis, a virgin goddess who felt pity for her. Artemis sent and made a female bear, a sacred beast of the goddess, nurture the girl by giving her milk and raising her up. In gratitude, Atalanta is a fervent follower of Artemis!~ ~!During the final battle in Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha, Atalanta faces [Ruler](https://anilist.co/character/67769/dArc-Jeanne) who she still blames for the death of the children that make up [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/55951/Jack-the-Ripper). She activates her personal Noble Phantasm, Agrius Metamorphosis, which not only transforms her into a monstrous version of herself, but increases her physical abilities. Ruler expresses pure disgust at Atalanta for discarding her heroic side and reducing herself to a rabid monster.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Morgan le Fay
sampleCharacters.native: モルガン・ル・フェイ
sampleCharacters.description: Morgan le Fay is the sister of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497) and mother of [Gawain](https://anilist.co/character/138357), [Agravain](https://anilist.co/character/220186), [Gaheris](https://anilist.co/character/302881), [Gareth](https://anilist.co/character/239525) and [Mordred](https://anilist.co/character/55977). Morgan was the daughter of Tintagel, the fae child conceived by Igraine, the progeny of the British Isles... and later, Artoria's stepsister, as Morgan's mother Igraine wed King Uther. __In Fate/Apocrypha:__ ~![Kairi Sisigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397) has dreams of Mordred's past showing how Morgan encouraged her to join the Knights of the Round Table, and later revealed to Mordred that she was King Arthur's son and encouraged her to turn against Arthur.!~ __In Fate/Grand Order Cosmos in the Lostbelt:__ ~!She established an authoritarian monarchy in the Lostbelt Britain and has made the fairies suffer under her oppressive rule for 2000 years. As the highest-ranking fairy, she is a genius sorcerer who has mastered Rhongomyniad, the Lance that Shines to the Ends of the World, as a form of Magecraft.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Frankenstein
sampleCharacters.native: フランケンシュタイン
sampleCharacters.description: Berserker is Frankenstein, Frankenstein's monster, the homunculus created by Victor Frankenstein appearing in Mary Shelley's novel. Into the Great Holy Grail War Berserker is summoned by Caules Forvedge Yggdmillennia with Victor Frankenstein's plans for a "perfect human" as a catalyst ~!Berserker's True Name is Frankenstein (フランケンシュタイン, Furankenshutain), the Frankenstein's monster (フランケンシュタインの怪物, Furankenshutain no Kaibutsu). Based upon the artificial life created by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's novel "Frankenstein: or the Modern Prometheus". Victor sought to recreate the original couple described in the bible -- Adam and Eve. Due to the limitations of man, he first built Eve, intending for her to give birth to the counterpart. What started as a patchwork of lifeless flesh was given life by the energy harnessed from lightning. Unfortunately, what awoke was not the ideal woman that Victor envisioned, but an abomination with the mind of an infant. Having no developed capacity for expression, her sense of morality was completely absent. After presenting the entrails of a slain dog as a gift for the master, she was branded a failure and disassembled, before being abandoned completely.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Jack the Ripper
sampleCharacters.native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
sampleCharacters.description: Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha. She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

sampleCharacters.name: Shirou Tokisada Amakusa
sampleCharacters.description: The Master of [Assasin of Red](https://anilist.co/character/35596/Semiramis), Shirou was dispatched by the Church as one of the Masters of the Red Faction. ~!He is actually a Ruler-class Servant of the [Einzbern Master](https://anilist.co/character/286211/Einzbern-Master)‎‎ in the Third Holy Grail War. He was later materialized due to having come into contact with the Greater Grail and managing to receive flesh.!~ He wants to make use of the Holy Grail War to fulfill his own wish. He has no connection to [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) of the [Fate/stay night](https://anilist.co/manga/30715/Fatestay-night/) timeline.

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer ~!(currently character team leader)!~ for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo.

Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. 

Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting or messaging, often using emoticons in chat. She secretly enjoys cosplay and owns a pet hedgehog named [Sojiro](https://anilist.co/character/158503/Sojiro).

Some trivia about Hifumi:
- Her favorite colors are Blue and Pink
- Her favorite clothing style is "Sweet Lolita"

__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 149 cm

A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

__Birth Place:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 164 cm

The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

__Birth Place:__ Okinawa Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 162 cm

A programmer who often gets annoyed when she has to fix errors and is embarrassed by her surname. She is a military fan and has several airsoft weapons in her workspace.

node.description:
She describes herself as "responsible and mature." Chtholly is a Leprechaun Fairy Soldier who lives at the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68. She is the oldest fairy of her generation and she is also the wielder of the strongest sword of the Emnetwiht race, Seniorious. As the oldest fairy of the warehouse, she tries to be a good example for the little ones, she even avoids eating sweets in front of the little ones because she thought it was childish to do so.

She's not very honest with herself.

Originally an orphan, he started training with a weapon at 11 in order to become a Brave. A jack of all trades, he exceeded in a myriad of techniques - earning him the title of  "strongest" Quasi Brave. After an hard fight, several curses caused by his techniques hit back, resulting in his 16 year old body being petrified in a frozen lake for 525 years.

When the events take place, he has been freed from the ice for two years with a deeply broken body caused by the petrification.

By the help of his boggard friend [Grick](https://anilist.co/character/163065/Graycrack-Grick), he becomes the caretaker over a military base run jointly by the Guarding Wings Military and the Orlandry Merchant Guild, where they keep special weapons - the Leprechauns.

node.description:
Nephren is a quiet Leprechaun, who almost never shows her emotions. Despite this, she cares a lot about her friends, and tries to support them as best as she can, especially Willem. Nephren cares a lot for Willem because she thinks he is the same as her. While she was having a conversation with Nygglatho, she described her feeling for Willem as: "I don’t want him to break down. So I’ll try my best to stay by his side and support him."

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name.native: アイセア・マイゼ・ヴァルガリス

node.description:
Ithea is a Leprechaun that has her hair styled like cat ears. She has a happy-go-lucky personalty, and often jokes that Willem only likes girls of her age. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka. 

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

Race: Troll
Position: Fairy Warehouse Caretaker from Orlandri

Trolls, close in relation to Ogres, prey on the other races, especially the Emnetwiht (human). She met Willem during a scavenger mission while he was in his petrified state. Nygglatho often jokingly asks Willem if she can eat him.


Despite her young age, she has already accomplished much. She is the mother figure in the facility, and treats all the fairies in the facility as her own. She shows her weak side from time to time, and usually goes to the forest to hunt bears when depressed.

~!She holds a high opinion about Willem and asks Willem to consider her to be his partner.!~

~!After Chtholly's death, she cut her hair short, a Troll custom.!~

~!Her father is on the 11th Island and runs an inn. Willem and Elq stayed there for awhile.!~

name.native: ティアット・シバ・イグナレオ

node.description:
Tiat Siba Ignareo is a young fairy who lives at the Fairy Warehouse. She is a supporting character in Suka Suka and becomes a main character in Suka Moka.

__In Suka Suka__
~!Tiat is cheerful young Leprechaun who loves and idolizes her big sister, Chtholly Nota Seniorious and who aims to become a splendid Fairy Soldier like her. She is delighted by the arrival of Willem Kmetsch and supported his romance with Chtholly. But later on, she becomes broken by Chtholly's death. After a little while, Tiat achieves her aim of becoming a Fairy Soldier when she becomes turned with the Dug Weapon, 'Ignareo.' However, she then becomes heartbroken when she is forced to fight and help kill Willem Kmetsch whom she considers to be a father figure and who has turned into a Beast.!~

__In Suka Moka__
~!Tiat is 5 years older and is still Fairy Soldier, however, has developed a much more depressing outlook on life. Still admiring Chtholly, she aims to become a tragic figure like her, however, is disheartened when she realizes that her skills are average and that she will never be like her. At the start of Suka Moka, she has resigned herself to death that is until she meets a young 4th Grade Officer named Feodor Jessman. From there, her story begins.!~

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

node.description:
Lillia Asplay was a female Emnetwiht who existed over 500 years ago. 

Known as the mightiest Brave, Lillia was the leader of her own team which consisted of Willem Kmetsch, Souwong Kandel, Navrutri Teigozak, Emissa Hodvin, Hilgram Moto and Kaya Cultrun.

~!She was once a princess who was born into the royal family of a small country. Since birth, Lillia was constantly taught to be pure, meaning that she had to be kind, selfless and constantly place others before herself. Despite this, she was happy and loved by everyone around her. When she was 10 years old, her kingdom was attacked by Gloom Elves and her family was killed.

Before Lillia could be killed, she was rescued by one of the people who were loyal to her family and managed to escape through a secret passageway. She was then taken to the Imperial Capital, and after that, she was taken in by Nils Didek Foreigner, who trained her to become a Regal Brave, alongside Willem Kmetsch and Souwong Kandel.

Despite surviving this tragic event, this experience also forced her into a darker fate, as those around and those that heard her tale started to treat her as a tragic heroine. Eventually, her fate was cemented when upon completion of her training, she was chosen by the Holy Sword, Seniorious, a sword that chooses only those who can never meet happiness in their lives. 

During the final battle with the Visitors, Lillia chose to take down the Visitor Elq herself while Willem was busy fighting Ebon Candle. This was because she knew if Willem found out what she was planning, he would've come and do it himself, which would've resulted in his dying. Fighting her way into Elq's sanctuary, Lillia's body and mind took a beating trying to find the Visitor.

Eventually, Lillia did find her, and after great pains, she managed to force her way through the barrier with Seniorious and land in Elq's sanctuary. Seeing the strange battered girl and her sword, Elq naturally inquired as to who she was and why she was there. But each time she spoke, Elq was inadvertently causing damage to Lillia. Eventually, the girl answered that her name was Lillia Aspray and that she was the Brave who was going to kill her and save the world. Elq replied that it seemed like a pain to do that, and in pain, Lillia replied that it is. 

In response, Elq then asked why she would even want to save the world, and as Lillia spurted blood from her mouth, she replied that she was doing it for the sake of her love. Surprised by that concept, Elq was stunned and asked why out of love, inadvertently sending out a telepathic shockwave that ripped through Lillia's mind. Barely conscious, Lillia replied that it was out of love that she came here to slay a god. Elq became awestruck by Lillia in that moment. Seeing Elq's reaction, Lillia continued explaining that she knows it's a fool's errand, but she doesn't have a choice because the one she loves is an idiot and that she had to act on these idiotic feelings before he could act on them himself. Lillia then states the man's name as Willem and she describes him as a "complete and utter moron."

Picking up Seniorious, Lillia tells Elq to rest in peace right before stabbing Elq straight through the chest. After that, she activated Seniorious' curse and turned Elq into a corpse, before dying herself unaware that Willem had already had been petrified. As a result, Lillia fulfilled the prophecy of Seniorious: she died not knowing that Willem loved her and was unable to achieve her happiness in her life.

After the final battle was over, Lillia's body was retrieved by Navrutri Teigozak and taken by to the Imperial Capital to recover. However, her mind had already been torn apart by Elq Hrqstn and she was left brain dead. Ironically, despite sacrificing so much of herself, Lillia's desperate attempt to save the world ended in failure as one year later the entirety of humanity turned back into Beasts in the course of a night. What happened to her body after the fight is left unknown.!~

She is the most mature of the younger fairies and is very perceptive of others as she is aware that Chtholly and Nygglatho both have feelings for Willem.

She sees Willem as a loving father figure and Chtholly as a big sister.

__Height:__ 183 cm 

He is the king of Sindria and the leader of the Alliance of the Seven Seas. He was 14 years old when he first captured a dungeon, the first dungeon "Bael". Since then, he had sailed the seven seas and captured seven dungeons. He is known as the "Legendary Dungeon Capturer" being the master of seven djinn. He is also commonly known as "High King of Seven Seas". His nickname is Sin. His name is based on "Sinbad the Sailor".

He met [Aladdin](https://anilist.co/character/41949/Aladdin) and his friends when he was in Balbadd, trying to reopen trade.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

(first appearance), 23 (now)
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Magi, Magician, Oracle
__Affiliation:__ Al-Thamen (former), Kou Empire (now)

Judar is one of the four Magi in the current era and a Magician who specializes in Ice Magic. He is the former Oracle of Al-Thamen and the Kou Empire after siding with Hakuryuu to aid him in taking over Kou Empire. According to Hakuryuu Ren, the name "Judar" was given by Al-Thamen, and his real name is unknown. He is the one of the main antagonist of the series. "Judar" in arabic means argument, debate, controversy.  

(Source: Magi Wikia)

__Height:__ 172 cm  
__Likes:__ Working  
__Weakness:__ Easily angered 
__Birthplace:__ Unknown 
__Special skill__: Assassination   

One of the eight generals, he uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Sei." His loyalty towards [Sinbad](https://anilist.co/character/42528/Sinbad) is so high that he'll approach anyone who insults him with murderous intent. When Sinbad does things as he pleases, Ja'far worries endlessly and sometimes even feels faint.

Ja'far usually only wears official clothing as he only has one set of normal clothing he received from Sinbad when he was 14 years old.

His name is based on the "Harun al-Rashid's" Persian vizier "Ja'far ibn Yahya" also known as "Ja'far al-Barmaki" which is one of the real people (not a fictional character) in "One Thousand and One Nights" stories. He appears in many stories in the "One Thousand and One Nights" series.

Height: 195cm  
Likes: naps  
Weakness: children  
Birth place: Dark Continent   

One of the eight generals. He uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Kauza." He is also a "Fanalis," like Morgiana. He does not speak a lot usually and is seen as emotionless and unfriendly. However, he is really kindhearted—he just doesn't show it often. His senior, Sharrkan often picks fight with him. However, he only listens to what Sinbad says.

Yunan is one of the four Magi in the current era. It is revealed that he is the one who raised the first dungeon, Baal, 14 years before the start of the story.   His name is based from the King Yunan, a fictional king of one of the ancient Persian cities, in the province of Zuman, now modern Azerbaijan who appears in The "tale of the vizier and the Sage Duban", one of the "One Thousand and One Nights" stories.  (Source: Wikipedia)

node.description:
Mira is the Queen of Artemyra, one of the countries that forms the Seven Seas Alliance. Mira is the owner of the Djinn Cerberus. She is a Dungeon Capturer, capturing one Dungeon, and a King Vessel. She is Pisti's mother.

Mira is a very slim and youthful woman, despite being nearly 40-years-old and the mother of several children. She has straight blonde hair down to her ankles and long, dark eyelashes. She wears a kind of crown-like helmet with tall spikes pointing upwards, and there is a tattoo on her right cheek. She wears a simple dress with a feather collar, befitting the fashion of Artemyra. She also wears a metallic necklace and leg protectors with wing-shaped protrusions. She goes barefoot and carries a spear, which is her Metal Vessel.

One of the Eight Generals of Sindria, from the Sasan Kingdom. He is the younger brother of Mystras Leoxses, and youngest son of Darius Leoxses.
Father of Sinbad.

Esra was the mother of Sinbad and wife of Badr.

Esra was a woman of average height with long black hair tied in a braid, light brown eyes and thick eyebrows. She wore normal Parthevian clothes and hoop-shaped earrings. When she became ill, her appearance worsened; she lost weight and her hair was disheveled.

Vittel was a part of the Assassin's Guild from the Parthevia Empire and later became an ally to Sinbad. 
He has light pinkish-purple hair and dark red eyes. He also has a scar on his face across his nose which cause is unknown.
Dragul's brother.

Falan is a Magician from Alma Torran. She was a part of Solomon's resistance to overthrow the Orthodox government and the wielder of one of the 72 Divine Staves. Falan is now a Magician Counselor of the Parthevia Empire but also a member of Al-Thamen.
Barkak is the right general of the Imperial Army of Balbadd. Barkak is the person who taught Alibaba royal swordplay.
