sampleCharacters.name: Tione Hiryute
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Amazoness __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Berserk • Backdraft __Magic:__ List Iorum __Weapon:__ Zolas • Filuka • Halberd Rolan Tione Hiryute is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. She is the older twin of the Hiryute Sisters. Tione and Tiona were born in Telskyura and were forced to join the Kali Familia from the moment they were born. Both sisters didn't know who their parents were, but knew that they were sisters. She reached Level 2 on her fifth birthday after she unknowingly killed Seldas, a person that she had viewed as a mother and an older sister, in a daily fight to the death, resulting in her resentment of Telskyura. Soon after, both sisters became students to Argana and Bache. The day before Tione's seventh birthday, Tiona asked Kali to let them leave the country, which she granted a couple of days later, much to their surprise. The sisters traveled across the land, temporarily joining different Familia for a year, during which both sisters reached Level 3. They arrived at Orario years later when they were 12 years old. After agreeing to join the Familia of the adventurer that defeated them, they proceeded to defeat everyone that challenged them, only to lose to Finn and Gareth when they were challenged by the Loki Familia. Upon her defeat, Tione fell in love with Finn, and desperately tried to make herself into a woman he would like. Following a dungeon expedition they went on shortly after joining, both sisters reached Level 4. Tione is in love with Finn Deimne and gets angry when other women try to flirt with him. She used to use dirty language, but cleaned it up after meeting Finn. However, her language returns to normal whenever she gets angry.

sampleCharacters.name: Bete Loga
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Werewolf __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Úlfheðinn • Fenris Wolf • Solmani __Magic:__ Hati __Weapon:__ Flosvirt • Dual Rolan Bete Loga is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. He was the former captain of the Vidar Familia until they left the city. Bete was born to the leader of a clan of Werewolves and had a sister named Luna along with a childhood friend named Rene, who he later got in a relationship with. However, his whole clan was killed by a monster when he was 12, and he traveled to Orario where he eventually became the captain of the Vidar Familia. When he was 16, he temporarily left the city as a Level 3 to kill the monster that killed his clan, succeeding in doing so after a day of fighting. Unfortunately, he discovered upon his return that his Familia had failed their recent dungeon expedition, resulting in the deaths of the vice-captain, who he used to be in a relationship with, along with several others while others that survived gained wounds fatal for an adventurer. The Vidar Familia subsequently left the city, though he stayed behind, and later joined the Loki Familia after an incident with Finn and Gareth at a pub. Bete has a rough personality and a slight superiority complex. He completely hates the weak, especially those that don't do anything about their weakness, and is not afraid to express his opinions about it. He can be an idiot who can't read the atmosphere. Furthermore, he is a bad drunk and has a tendency to spout things when intoxicated. He has, in several instances, displayed feats of heroism and still worries for the wellbeing of his weaker subordinates. He is also described as a tsundere, hiding a more forebearing exterior. He admires and has a crush on Ais.

sampleCharacters.name: Loki
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia Loki is the head of the Loki Familia. Loki acts in a very tomboyish manner. She very much enjoys living up to her nickname, trickster, and shows a lustful side toward females, namely Ais Wallenstein. She also has a breast complex and tends to get into fights with Hestia over breast size.

sampleCharacters.name: Asfi Al Andromeda
sampleCharacters.native: アスフィ・アル・アンドロメダ
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Hermes Familia __Level:__ 4 __Magic:__ Kalov Argol __Weapon:__ Canoval Dagger Asfi Al Andromeda is a member and the captain of the Hermes Familia. She is also one of the most famous item makers in Orario, known as Perseus. Asfi was the princess of an island nation that was stolen by a God. At some point, she was taken away by [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/142531/Hermes) and became an adventurer and a member of his Familia. Asfi is serious and will follow Hermes' orders. She is a hard worker that is often pushed around by Hermes. [Welf](https://anilist.co/character/138250/Crozzo-Welf) states that she may come from royalty somewhere due to her behavior, and in truth, she is the princess of a maritime nation.

sampleCharacters.name: Lefiya Viridis
sampleCharacters.native: レフィーヤ・ウィリディス
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Elf __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 4 __Skills:__ Fairy Canon • Double Canon __Magic:__ Arcs Ray • Fusillade Fallarica • Elf Ring __Weapon:__ Forest's Teardrop Lefiya Viridis is a second class adventurer and a member of the Loki Familia. She is a mage training to succeed Riveria Ljos Alf. She has a magic that allows her to use any Elf Magic, hence the alias Thousand Elf. Sometime in the past, Lefiya was an honor student at the School, leveling up after three years at eleven years of age. After graduating, she joined the Loki Familia at Level 2 and leveled up a year later. Lefiya is clumsy, but hard working. She occasionally zones out as her imagination runs rampant. She has a deep admiration for Ais and through her admiration, aims to become stronger so that she can stand next to Ais as an equal. She is often jealous of Bell due to his interactions with Ais. Lefiya maintains her elven pride, but is more open than normal Elves due to her own kind nature and growing up surrounded by people from other races. Lefiya struggled with her own worth as a member of the Loki Familia, having low confidence, self doubt, and other problems that began to get better once she befriended Filvis and learned concurrent chanting. Having a fear of being left completely alone due to her ineptitude, she highly valued her relationships, especially with Ais and Filvis. She can also mix between being kind and mean quickly, as she frequently switched between trying to harass Bell, being nice to him, holding a grudge against him, and also excusing him.

sampleCharacters.name: Riveria Ljos Alf
sampleCharacters.native: リヴェリア・リヨス・アールヴ
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ High Elf __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Fairy Anthem • Alf Regina __Magic:__ Rea Laevateinn • Wynn Fimbulvetr • Veil Breath • Via Shilheim • Vas Windheim • Liv Ilusio • Fil Eldis • Luna Aldis • Van Alheim • Flare Burn __Weapon:__ Magna Alfs Riveria Ljos Alf is the daughter of Larfal Ljos Alf and the vice-captain of the Loki Familia. Riveria was born in the Alf's Royal Forest as a member of the High Elf family. She lived there for 71 years until she grew tired of her father's negative attitude toward her interest in the outside world and decided to leave. She left the forest with her childhood friend and former personal chamberlain Aina with the help of Finn and Loki. She is also a friend of Njord, as he took care of them before the early Loki Familia entered Orario. Riveria has a serious personality. She is one of the only people that didn't laugh at Bell and condemned the others for laughing at him. She is also a strict mentor to the lower leveled members of her Familia, training Lefiya in her studies as a mage and Ais when she was a child. She is calm and collected during the heat of battle, dealing with unexpected events in a leader-like fashion, as shown in the event of the Loki Familia being attacked by large numbers of Virga on the 50th floor. Despite this, Riveria is kind to others, especially to her fellow Loki Familia members, earning her the nickname of mama from Loki. Riveria hates to be called an "old woman" as she punished a 7-year-old Ais, who called her so, by tying adamantite to her and throwing her in water, calling it "swimming training". This later became a traumatic experience for Ais.

sampleCharacters.name: Finn Deimne
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Pallum __Height:__ 119 cm (3'11") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Pallum • Spirit Noble Brave • Dia Fianna • Command Howl • Ail mac Midna __Magic:__ Hell Finegas • Tir na Nog __Weapon:__ Fortia Spear • Spear Rolan Finn Deimne is the captain of the Loki Familia. Finn was born in a village located in a mountainous area and had bad memories of his life ever since he was born. He hated his parents and other Pallum as he wondered why they didn't try to use their intellect rather than submit to people who were stronger than them. Unlike them, he began to gather knowledge, secretly reading books at the village chief's house, and when he was caught, he was described to be like a sage. When he was ten years old, monsters attacked his village in the middle of the night, causing him to try to help the village, though he would have died if his parents hadn't protected him with their lives. Despite this, the other Pallum abandoned them, making him see despair through them. Nevertheless, he also saw courage through his parent's actions. After the other villagers arrived to get rid of the monsters, he ran off to cry, coming back the next morning to bury his parents himself. By that time, he had a firm resolve to become the Pallum's light and renamed himself Finn, his thumb beginning to tingle in the process. Finn has a sharp mind, being able to memorize complex things, judge correctly, and take action without hesitation. He cares for his Familia members' safety. Finn also wants to bring hope to the Pallums through his efforts in the dungeon. To further his efforts, he wishes to have a Pallum heir. Finn came to Orario to bring hope to the Pallum race. The Pallum race believed in the Goddess Phiana, which was actually a group of knights that had been deified. When they realized that Phiana didn't exist, the Pallum race fell into a decline. He came to Orario to give hope and pride for the Pallum currently in the world and those who would be born in the future, by becoming one of the strongest adventurers in Orario.

sampleCharacters.name: Ganesha
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Affiliation:__ Ganesha Familia Ganesha Is the head of the Ganesha Familia. Ganesha appears to be very flamboyant, speaking in a loud voice and making poses. He even spent practically all of the Familia's money in making the Ganesha Familia home into huge shape of himself, also naming it after himself. When protecting the citizens, reputation and position means nothing to him; he will even get Gods and Goddesses involved, if he so desires. Ganesha also has a habit of repeatedly mentioning his name, such as "I am Ganesha". However, when the situation demands it, Ganesha has shown himself capable of adopting a more serious attitude and expressing concern for the well-being of others.

sampleCharacters.name: Fels
sampleCharacters.description: __Affiliation:__ Ouranos • Xenos __Previous Affiliation:__ Altena __Level:__ 4 __Status:__ • Mage: ? • Mystery: ? __Magic:__ Dia Panakeia • Dia Orpheus Fels is a mysterious mage that is affiliated with Ouranos. Fels works directly under Ouranos and will take any orders from him, although they will act on their own if necessary. They consider their experience creating the stone that granted immortality as their trauma.

sampleCharacters.name: Ottarl
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Boaz __Height:__ 210 cm (6'11") __Affiliation:__ Freya Familia __Level:__ 7 __Skills:__ Vana Arganture • Stortus Ottar __Magic:__ Hildis Vini __Weapon:__ Supreme Black Sword • Greataxe • Great Hammer Ottar is the captain of the Freya Familia and is currently the only Level 7 in Orario. When Ottar was a child, he was abandoned without even having known his own name. Freya found him dying in an alley somewhere and told him he was beautiful and took him into her Familia. She also gave him his name at this time. Due to her material support and emotional warmth, Freya would become everything to Ottar. Two years after joining her Familia, Ottar would become Level 2. Around this time, Mia joined the Freya Familia at the request of Freya in order to train Ottar. Ottar clashed a few times with the Zeus and Hera Familias before they were defeated by the One Eyed Black Dragon and were forced out of Orario. Each time ended in him being defeated. At some point in the past, Ottar half-killed a Balor, the Monster Rex of the 49th floor. Later, after learning about Ais defeating Udaeus by herself, he also defeated Udaeus by himself while managing to obtain the Udaeus' sword. He reached Level 6 fifteen years before his battle with Udaeus and Level 7 after defeating Zald seven years before the same battle. Ottar is extremely loyal to Freya and will follow her orders. He is shown to not feel any jealousy toward Freya's interest in Bell and does not allow anyone to insult Freya, becoming enraged if anyone does so. Despite being a member of the Freya Familia, he has been shown to help others, such as when he used an elixir on Mikoto after she used an Ignis Fatuus. Ottar believes the opposite of Eina, believing that adventurers would never break out their shell if they didn't adventure. He is also one of the few adventurers who are still active that has clashed with the Zeus and Hera Familias. His personality is greatly influenced by his experiences facing them.

sampleCharacters.name: Demeter
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") __Affiliation:__ Demeter Familia Demeter is the head of the Demeter Familia. Demeter is a good natured Goddess that acts mature when talking to others whether they may be Gods or their children. She apparently can get carried away as she asked [Lunoire](https://anilist.co/character/122203/Faust-Lunoire) not to praise her too much about her cooking. She is on good terms with other Gods like [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and enjoys teasing others as shown when she hugged [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) in front of her. She can be aware of the hidden motives of others, such as when she noticed [Dionysus](https://anilist.co/character/142547/Dionysus)' expression during the God's banquet. Demeter also cares for her children, as she used to worry about Lunoire when she was a bounty hunter, and suggested for her work with the other members in the fields once she finished her work.

sampleCharacters.name: Tsubaki Collbrande
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Half Dwarf__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Hephaestus Familia __Level:__ 5 __Achieved Floor:__ 59 __Status:__ • Blacksmith: ? Tsubaki Collbrande is the captain of the Hephaestus Familia as well as a master smith. Tsubaki has a very friendly personality, casually interacting with various people, and even asked Finn if she could hug him. Tsubaki is interested in Welf Crozzo and takes care of him, nevertheless, she laments the fact that he refuses to make magic swords, stating that it's a waste of talent.

sampleCharacters.name: Allen Fromel
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Cat People__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") __Affiliation:__ Freya Familia __Level:__ 6 __Weapon:__ Spear Allen Fromel is the vice captain of the Freya Familia. When Allen was four years old he lost his parents and home, being forced to wander through the ruins of a kingdom along with his sister Anya. During this time he protected her, having to fight monsters on some occasions and escape from them on others. So it was for two years until they met Freya, who offered them to go with her, which he accepted. Like the other members of the Freya Familia, Allen is extremely loyal to Freya, and is shown to be jealous of Bell Cranel because of the attention he receives from her. He is also poison tongued, telling Ais to go die during the Loki Familia expedition. According to Syr, his tongue is sensitive to hot food, mentioning that he secretly blows on hot drinks to cool them down before drinking them. Allen is siblings with Anya Fromel. However, they have both cut all ties with each other. Despite his attitude towards her, calling her even the person he hates the most in the world, Freya pointed out that Allen still loves her, which was demonstrated when he saw her while under the effects of Seale's curse, which made the opponent see their most loved one.

node.description: Popura is a short 17-year-old high school student who works at Wagnaria. Ironically, she was named after the poplar tree so that she would grow tall. She is a hard worker, but she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes in her job. She is very sensitive about her small appearance; many customers usually mistake her to be younger than she really is. She often fails to gain respect from [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), who is one year younger than her, as he usually regards her as an elementary school student. She is also unable to properly call him by his surname, saying "Katanashi" rather than "Takanashi", even when corrected.

Aoi is a mysterious, self-proclaimed 16-year-old girl who [Otoo](https://anilist.co/character/32294/Otoo-Hyougo) meets on his travels to find his missing wife. He brings her back to Wagnaria where she starts working as a waitress and living in Wagnaria’s attic.

While she has great confidence in herself, during work she is an unhelpful troublemaker who gets yelled at by other staff members, especially [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta). Since she is in training, her position among the staff is low, which she complains about. She is bad with dealing with Souta’s constant complaints about her, but she does write down some of his suggestions (along with idle complaints).

She yearns for the idea of having a family, especially towards Otoo whom she sees as an ideal father figure, and goes as far as to apply to be adopted by him.

Her favorite food is natto.

__Height:__ 166 cm

Inami is a timid girl who joins the rest of the employees at Wagnaria.

She has androphobia and is thus terrified of men; she punches any male that comes near her. This violent behavior arises from her belief that every man is ready to attack her, but instead, she is prone to violently attacking men at a moment's notice. This androphobia was caused by her father who did not want her to eventually wed due to jealousy and thus told her that males would attack her, which ended in her fearing men since then.

As she and [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta) usually share shifts, he takes the brunt of her attacks. However, she makes considerable progress with her fear of men by taking it out on Souta; she states that she can be about two meters close to guys without having the urge to hit them. Though this extends to only having fairly civil conversations (often ruined by Souta's rudeness) or if Inami launches an attack on him.

~!She wears a hairpin in her hair, which she changes every day due to Souta's compliment on it (according to [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/30686/Souma-Hiroomi)). At first, she begins to develop a crush, but later she falls in love with Souta when he confronts her father (as Kotori) about her androphobia.!~

A chef who works in the kitchen, Satou is a helpful but intimidating individual.

He is in love with [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo), but has problems expressing it. Of course, because she is so devoted to [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko), she fails to recognize any hints he attempts to make.

He likes to take out his anger on [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) by messing with her or bending the truth, to which Popura naively believes. When [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/30686/Souma-Hiroomi) tries to help with Satou's development with Yachiyo, Satou unrelentingly hits him with a pan, showing that he is sensitive about his feelings for Yachiyo.

~!In chapter 219, he confessed his feelings to Yachiyo and asked if he could bring her to see the outside world (AKA asking her out). Yachiyo gladly agreed. While the rest of the staff are happy, Kyouko isn't pleased. Thankfully, she gradually accepted their relationship.!~

Yachiyo is another employee at the restaurant. She usually carries around a katana which, according to her, was made by her parents who used to be blacksmiths. Yachiyo is unaware that some of the customers, and even [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), are intimidated by her blade.

She admires [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko) considerably. She gets angry if anyone offers Kyouko food or tries to take her away, although is willing to allow Satou to feed her because she considers him trustworthy, much to his chagrin.

A chef who works in the kitchen, he is a young man with an easygoing attitude.

He often blackmails other workers to do his job for him and pass it off as a form of modesty from the other employees. He can blackmail anyone except [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru), who punches him even before he manages to talk to her. He is terrified of Inami's urges and is thankful for [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s existence in the restaurant since Inami is taking out her urges all on Souta and not him.

Kyouko is the manager of Wagnaria.

She usually maintains a rather apathetic attitude about how the restaurant is run and almost never bothers to do any work herself. She is not beyond using violence to deal with unruly customers and firmly believes that employees come before the customers, as the employees are the ones doing all the work. She is 28 years old, but she becomes despondent whenever her age is mentioned.

Kyouko saved [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo) as a little girl from bullies, which is how they met.

__Height:__ 172 cm

Souta is a high school student recruited by [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) to become a new employee at the family restaurant Wagnaria.

He is enamored by cute things and thus favors Poplar over the other employees due to her cute appearance. He voices his thoughts out loud and occasionally offends his co-workers, often resulting in him getting punished by them. He usually finds his co-workers and the rules of the restaurant to be strange, but he still has an attachment to his job. He can adapt quickly to his job at the restaurant.

He has three older sisters and it is because of them that caused his dislike for older women as he had been tormented by them all his life. He received hand-me-downs from his sisters when he was young, giving him the appearance of a little girl. He also has a younger sister in elementary school who is almost as tall as he is.

~!Despite his problems, [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru) asks Souta to cross-dress, using the name Kotori, when her father comes to visit her at work.!~

__Height:__ 173 cm

Izumi, [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s second eldest sister, is an author who tends to stay in her room for long periods of time focusing on working while ignoring the cleanliness of herself and her surroundings.

__Height:__ 170 cm

Nazuna is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s younger sister. She is very mature for her age and is already almost as tall as Souta even though she is only in elementary school. While a genuinely kind and caring person, she will manipulate other people to get her way.

__Height:__ 174 cm 

Kozue is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s third eldest sister.

She's an alcoholic and appears to be drunk most of the time. She is a lonely girl who constantly faces rejection from other guys deep inside. She is also a very affectionate and physical girl who often hugs people around her.

__Height:__ 167 cm 

Maya is an 18-year-old glasses-wearing girl who works at Wagnaria. She professes that she is a "normal person" striving to be completely ordinary in work and life in general. She has a hard time understanding the other employees seeing how awkward all of them are and tries not to be too familiar with them. The irony is that because she tries too hard to be "normal", she ends up being pretty weird herself.
Kazue is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s eldest sister. She is a lawyer and has the tendency to hit Souta with a law book.
[Mahiru](https://anilist.co/character/24419/)'s mother.

Otoo is the top head of the restaurant. Most of the time he is away searching for his missing wife, but periodically returns to Wagnaria to check up on things and bring back souvenirs.

~!In episode 7 of season 3, he is reunited with his wife, [Haruna](https://anilist.co/character/50931/Otoo-Haruna).!~
[Mahiru](https://anilist.co/character/24419/)'s father.
Father of the Takanashi family.

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ ???

Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown.

Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her. Because of this, she has a cold demeanor and appears to remain calm and collected in most situations. Despite this, however, she can sometimes let her emotions get the best of her when she's especially upset. Though aloof and slow to trust others, Kyouko is adept at noticing things that the other students don't, which proves vital once bodies start turning up. She often advises [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/63851/Naegi-Makoto) on conducting investigations.

~!Her actual talent is the Super High School Level Detective, or the Ultimate Detective in the English localization.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Gal (超高校級のギャル)

node.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Gyaru

Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru, or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

~!It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the younger twin who she switched places with, was the mastermind behind Monokuma, as well as the Tragedy.!~

~!Junko's real personality and mannerisms are erratic and unstable, switching through several "personalities" at the drop of a hat, which she says is because she gets bored easily. Junko is incredibly manipulative and cunning, having orchestrated the Tragedy. She is obsessed with despair and finds it to be the most enjoyable emotion in the world.!~

~!It is eventually revealed that her true talent is that of Super High School Level Analytical Prowess. This ability allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with superhuman speed, detailed thinking, and memorization, giving her the ability to predict the future with near-perfect accuracy, as well as be able to learn and understand new skills by just seeing it once. This ability is also what gave Junko her "Ultimate Fashionista" title: because she's able to predict trends, she can predict what will become popular with society.!~

Super High School Level Good Luck

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Good Luck

Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.

Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

__Height:__ 75 cm (2'6") (DR1 & DRV3), 65 cm (2'2") (DR2)

A stuffed robotic bear and the self-proclaimed Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy who instigates the various killing games in the Danganronpa series. Monokuma is often described as easygoing and cheerful at first glance, but with a very sinister undertone.. He loves hysteria, violence, chaos, and most of all, despair.

Super High School Level Literary Girl

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm  (5'5")
__Talent:__ Literature

Touko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Literary Girl, or the Ultimate Writing Prodigy in the English localization.

Due to her severe persecution complex that originates from the bullying she suffered at a young age, Touko is highly suspicious of other people, frequently accusing them of thinking bad things about her. She has also caused others to give a bad first impression of her as she is known to blatantly insult others, even though it is the very first time they have met. Despite her young age, she has already won several awards for her writing, and her works are constantly on top of selling lists. She is also in love with [Byakuya Togami](https://anilist.co/character/65541/Togami-Byakuya), constantly swooning over him and acting extremely submissive towards him, although her affection is one-sided.

~!Touko actually has two different identities, the other being the infamous serial killer, Genocider Sho.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Ultimate ???

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. He doesn't remember his talent at the beginning of the Killing Game, so his title is the Ultimate ???.

Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or something at all. He tends to be quite serious, but he does joke around and often goes along with his classmates' eccentric hobbies anyway, and sometimes smiles awkwardly and sheepishly while his friends engage in some of their usual weird behavior. He is sometimes annoyed by some of his classmates and can be snarky towards them in his thoughts as well as blunt while speaking to them, though he's more frank than sarcastic or mean-spirited. Though sometimes a bit submissive (especially with bossy girls), he is not afraid to speak his mind, and he can be rude if annoyed enough (for example, after enduring [Hiyoko](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s attitude during her Free Time Events, he finally ends up stating "I don't even care anymore"). He can sometimes be short-tempered and snap at others, especially when he's tired or under pressure. He was also quite paranoid during the start of the game and didn't have much interest in friendship, but he later really wanted to believe in his classmates and felt bad about doubting them during the Class Trials, though he understood it was necessary.

~!It was revealed in Chapter 4 by Nagito Komaeda that Hajime was actually a reserve course student who had no talent whatsoever and is not an Ultimate himself.!~

However, he is a sensible student who holds a truthful, albeit cynical, outlook on the world. He is ruthlessly honest about his opinions and often hurts others with his blunt remarks. Despite his negative attitude, he does occasionally lend a hand to other characters.

Sayaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Idol (超高校級のアイドル), or the Ultimate Pop Sensation in the English localization.

She is the lead singer of an incredibly popular idol group. She and Makoto were classmates in middle school.

__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

The main protagonist of _Danganronpa Another Episode: Ultra Despair Girls_ and the younger sister of [Makoto Naegi](https://anilist.co/character/63851/Naegi-Makoto).

Komaru begins as a somewhat hypersensitive and cowardly person who often wavers between hope and despair. She doesn't want to have strong hope, because she believes it will be lost eventually, leading to worse despair. She has low self-esteem, considering herself boring, ordinary, and weak. She also shows some childish traits, such as being naive, reliant, and easily excitable. She also has an 'unusual' kind of pride, as she gets really worked up from the puzzles of the Monokuma Kids and brags towards the kids when she solves them. She is also very gullible and rather innocent as well, as doesn't seem to have much interest in romance nor sexual things. It's been stated that in the past some creepy guys have taken interest in her, supposedly because of her gullibility, and it's been shown that she isn't very good at noticing their intentions.

While a kind person, Komaru sometimes has a hard time relating to certain people and subjects, because she herself has lived a very ordinary life. However, she herself has a few very unusual traits as well, including her strange favorite foods and her apparent ability to sense ghosts, although she doesn't seem to think these traits are anything unusual. Despite sometimes giving up too easily, there are other times which Komaru shows how stubborn and determined she can be. She has a weakness in complicated subjects such as basic computer science, but she does have moments where she is intuitive.

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Pharmacist

A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. She is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 4 Director, responsible for the research and development of new medical techniques. She, along with the other directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Seiko has a reserved personality and a stilted way of speaking. Because she's conscious of how easy it it for people to guess what she's thinking through her facial expressions, she hides her face behind a mask. She's startled easily, often anxious, and has a very soft-hearted nature, being very loyal and forgiving towards people who are kind to her. In high school, Seiko often took requests from other students. She also loves animals, making concoctions specially for helping them. She's very meticulous when dealing with medicine.

As a pharmacist, Seiko has an extensive knowledge of medicine and drugs. She can create just about any kind, ranging from common ones like laxatives and cold medication to more ludicrous ones like strength enhancers that drastically change one's physical appearence. Seiko drew much attention within the pharmaceutical industry, as she had found new uses for pre-existing medicine. Vying for her talent, many companies reached out to her, but she only accepted minimum help with her research.

Usami  is a rabbit magical girl who features as the mascot character of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, appearing in the game as the lead teacher of the school trip. After being assaulted by Monokuma, Usami's appearance is forcibly changed to greater resemble him, with Monokuma renaming her Monomi as a result.

__Talent:__ Fortune Telling

Yasuhiro is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Fortune Teller, or Ultimate Clairvoyant in the English localization.

Yasuhiro is cheery, laid-back, and a bit of a conspiracy theorist. He isn't very well-liked by the other students, and Yasuhiro himself has admitted that he is quite cowardly, lazy, slow-witted, and has a habit to act selfishly. Notably, he is mentioned to be very clumsy with money and he has constant problems with massive debts.

__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Animator

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 77-B at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 10 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in reviving education and culture. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Ryota is a very timid, insecure, and rather asocial person. He holds anime in very high regard and is extremely passionate about it, considering it his savior during his harsh childhood. His life goal is to give others a similar sense of hope through his anime. However, this led him to shut himself in his room to work, frequently neglecting to eat or sleep as he wanted to spend all his time creating anime. Ryota suffers from extreme anxiety, worrying constantly, and lacks self-confidence, seeing himself as a burden who fails to protect everyone. He has a weak stomach and is easily startled. Though he's very hard on himself, he does his best when given a mission.

alternative: 超小学生級の学芸会の時間

node.description:
__Height:__ 134 cm (4'5")

One of the five members of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Fighter" class. Her title when she attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Drama (超小学生級の学芸会の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Arts Festival Period).

Kotoko is a hot-headed girl who loves "adorbs" things; she collects them and seems even slightly obsessed with the concept. She acts cheerful, polite, and happy, however she is also mentioned to have a bullying nature and she can be very mean and cruel. She's one of the more intelligent members of the group and has a strict, demanding personality, with a habit of curtsying and being rather dramatic, calling to her past as an actress. Kotoko seemingly loved her stage life, but she doesn't like to talk about it and considers it far behind her. It's heavily implied that most of her behavior is an act, and her "cutesy" personality is a front created as a coping mechanism.

__Her Past and Trauma:__
~!Kotoko was born and raised in Towa City. She was a child prodigy and famous child actor whose father was a dentist. However, when Kotoko was about 10 years old, her parents prostituted her to producers and it's implied that she was repeatedly raped by them. Her mother did it out of a twisted form of parental love and prostituted herself alongside Kotoko as a "mother and daughter set", claiming that this was in her daughter's best interests because it would help further her career. According to Kotoko, she endured it all without complaining because making her mother cry would've hurt her the most. Meanwhile, Kotoko's father didn't seem to care about his family at all, using the money they gained for his own benefit and cheating on his wife with his dental hygienist.

Due to the trauma caused by the abuse, Kotoko has a trigger for the word "gentle" (優しい yasashii), as the men who abused her had said they would be "gentle" with her. When she hears this word, she becomes neurotic, crying and screaming in fear and unable to calm herself down until when somebody tells her that they will not be gentle with her. Despite this, she can use the word herself without any problems.!~

__During the Tragedy:__ 
~!Around the time when the Tragedy was first starting, Kotoko was on the verge of committing suicide with the other Warriors of Hope when Junko Enoshima appeared and stopped them, convincing them that the adults are wrong and that they should create a paradise for children. Junko then took the five under her wing, and shortly afterward, Kotoko murdered her parents. She tells Komaru that she does not regret it, and that they should have died more times.!~

~!Supposedly because of Junko's teachings, Kotoko wants to make other "adorbs" girls suffer what she went through, exclusively the older ones she considers Demons. She is bitter because nobody helped her in the past and thus is very paranoid of adults, believing they're all pedophiles.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'9")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Blacksmith

A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 9 Director, responsible for the preparation, development, and management of armaments/weapons. He, along with the other directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Sonosuke is stated to be a "silent type" who avoids talking to others, the only exception being his romantic partner, Ruruka. Sonosuke is incredibly loyal and protective of her, drawing a weapon on anyone who gets close to her. He loves Ruruka's candy and she seems to feed him as a reward, him often resting his head on her lap as he eats and calling the sweets "dewicious". Once Sonosuke's trust is broken, it is very difficult to gain it back, as he believes "once a traitor, always a traitor".

As the Ultimate Blacksmith, Sonosuke is skilled at developing and using different weapons, and he stocks all kinds of hidden weapons inside his coat. His parents, who were also blacksmiths, taught him from a very young age. At the Academy, he opened his own shop to take requests from people to forge any weapons they requested. He created weapons for two purposes, practical and collection. He takes a special interest in weapons that would typically used by ninja. He is also shown to be able to create many kinds of traps, including explosives that can be triggered with a switch or pressure activated traps.

__Talent:__ Ultimate Talent Scout

During his time at Hope's Peak Academy, he was the original homeroom teacher of Class 77-B, being succeeded by [Chisa Yukizome](https://anilist.co/character/90003/Chisa-Yukizome), and a scout for talented students.

He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

He was once a former student of Hope's Peak Academy.

alternative: 超小学生級の社会の時間

node.description:
__Height:__ 137 cm (4'6")

The vice leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Sage" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Social Studies.

Nagisa is the most serious member of the Warriors. He is calm, intelligent and educated, yet also the most child-like. He has an aversion to things he considers childish and, though he refers to himself as a child, doesn't like to be underestimated on the basis of age.

Nagisa is incredibly loyal, humble, compassionate and protective over his friends and fellow children, truly caring about them even though they often annoy him a lot. He is willing to go to any lengths to ensure that they don't have to live in fear any longer.

He is later the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

He is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 9 Director, responsible for the preparation, development, and management of armaments/weapons. He, along with the other directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game. Sonosuke is stated to be a "silent type" who avoids talking to others, the only exception being his romantic partner, Ruruka. Sonosuke is incredibly loyal and protective of her, drawing a weapon on anyone who gets close to her. He loves Ruruka's candy and she seems to feed him as a reward, him often resting his head on her lap as he eats and calling the sweets "dewicious". Once Sonosuke's trust is broken, it is very difficult to gain it back, as he believes "once a traitor, always a traitor". As the Ultimate Blacksmith, Sonosuke is skilled at developing and using different weapons, and he stocks all kinds of hidden weapons inside his coat. His parents, who were also blacksmiths, taught him from a very young age. At the Academy, he opened his own shop to take requests from people to forge any weapons they requested. He created weapons for two purposes, practical and collection. He takes a special interest in weapons that would typically used by ninja. He is also shown to be able to create many kinds of traps, including explosives that can be triggered with a switch or pressure activated traps.

sampleCharacters.name: Kouichi Kizakura
sampleCharacters.description: __Talent:__ Ultimate Talent Scout During his time at Hope's Peak Academy, he was the original homeroom teacher of Class 77-B, being succeeded by [Chisa Yukizome](https://anilist.co/character/90003/Chisa-Yukizome), and a scout for talented students. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game. He was once a former student of Hope's Peak Academy.

sampleCharacters.name: Nagisa Shingetsu
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 137 cm (4'6") The vice leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Sage" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Social Studies. Nagisa is the most serious member of the Warriors. He is calm, intelligent and educated, yet also the most child-like. He has an aversion to things he considers childish and, though he refers to himself as a child, doesn't like to be underestimated on the basis of age. Nagisa is incredibly loyal, humble, compassionate and protective over his friends and fellow children, truly caring about them even though they often annoy him a lot. He is willing to go to any lengths to ensure that they don't have to live in fear any longer.

sampleCharacters.name: Kyousuke Munakata
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 186cm (6'1") __Talent:__ Ultimate Student Council President A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy, his title was the Ultimate Student Council President. He is later the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

sampleCharacters.name: Ruruka Andou
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") __Talent:__ Ultimate Confectioner During her time in Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. In Future Arc, she is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 8 Director. Her responsibility as the director is assistance in procuring stable food sources. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

node.description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who wields fire dragon slayer magic.

Natsu has a carefree and reckless nature and, despite his constant brawls with the other members of the guild, is a fiercely loyal and protective friend. He has a particularly close and competitive relationship with [Gray Fullbuster](https://anilist.co/character/4839/Fullbuster-Gray) and [Erza Scarlet](https://anilist.co/character/5189/Scarlet-Erza). With the former, he has had a constant rivalry from a young age and although they often denounce each other as not being friends, they regularly watch each others' back even when they are enraged with one another. He has had the same sort of relationship with Erza - the two both being scared of her since a young age - and they seemed to have a fairly good relationship in the past as, according to Erza, they used to shower together. He befriends people rather quickly too, considering [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186/Heartfilia-Lucy) a friend and willing to team up with her only after a few days of knowing her.

[Igneel](https://anilist.co/character/40157/Igneel), a dragon, found him in the forest and ended up taking care of him. He taught Natsu how to speak, read, and use magic. But one day Igneel disappeared without a trace. Because of this, Natsu's goal in life is to find him. 

~!Natsu is also among the five Dragon Slayers sent to the future from four hundred years past, having an additional purpose in the assistance of the defeat of [Acnologia](https://anilist.co/character/49003/Acnologia).!~

~!He is the younger brother of [Zeref Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/37720/Zeref), having originally died 400 years ago, being subsequently revived as his brother's most powerful Etherious: E.N.D.!~

name.native: ルーシィ・ハートフィリア

node.description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail guild who wields Celestial Spirit magic.

Lucy is cheerful, clever, and often gets swept along by her disruptive guildmates when they go overboard. Empathetic, caring, and more likely to write novels than wage battles, Lucy becomes most emboldened to challenge enemies when she needs to fight for her friends. She is said to be a noisy and somewhat fussy person, and there are times when she can be naive and too easily forgiving, greedy for validation as well as overly confident at inopportune moments. However, despite any failings and instances of self-doubt, she doesn't allow herself to feel down for too long - her optimism is boundless.

In July of Earth Land year X784, Lucy is a normal 17-year-old Fioran who wishes to join the infamous mage guild, Fairy Tail - although they have a reputation for being thoroughly destructive, she admires their strength and numbers. After a fateful meeting with two members of the guild in the town of Hargeon, [Natsu Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/5187/Dragneel-Natsu) and his flying blue cat, [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188/Happy), she travels with them back to Fairy Tail, located in Magnolia, to begin the adventure of a lifetime.

~!Lucy's surname is quickly revealed to be quite significant, for it distinguishes her as a member of the Heartfilia family, who head a powerful and wealthy organization called the Heartfilia Konzern. The Heartfilia's connection to Celestial Sprit Magic becomes a key point later on.!~

name.native: ミラジェーン・ストラウス

node.description:
__Title:__ The Demon
__Occupation:__ Mage
__Known relatives:__ [Elfman Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/5334); [Lisanna Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/30225).

She is a former S-class mage and the older sister of Elfman. When Mirajane was an S-class mage, she was known as "The Demon." However, due to a past incident involving the death of her younger sister, Lisanna, Mirajane somehow lost much of her magical ability and her will to fight. Given the recent event of Elfman regaining his lost abilities and Mirajane's increased confidence, Mirajane may someday regain her abilities and move forward with her life.

Mirajane plays a motherly role within the guild, and is often seen running the bar at the guild hall. She has rarely been shown to be in a bad mood, and can tolerate all of the guild's eccentricities. However, there have been a couple events that have disturbed Mirajane, including her discovery of the stealing of an S-Class job by [Natsu](https://anilist.co/character/5187), [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) and [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186), and her later disappointment with [Laxus](https://anilist.co/character/8294) following the destruction of the guild building.

__Height:__ 155cm 
__Magic:__ Solid Script Mage

Levy is a member of the Fairy Tail Guild's team Shadow Gear, along with Jet and Droy. She has a cheerful personality, being able to get along with many other guild members. Levy loves to read books, she and Lucy Heartfilia quickly became friends through their mutual love for books. Levy read the novel that Lucy is working on and is the only person who has done so by consent.
Levy's magic is called Solid Script. Which allows her to make words solid and then throw the words at her opponent. For instance, if the word fire were to be thrown at her opponent the victim would feel as if he were hit by a fireball.

Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new worlds across the cosmos.

name.native: レベッカ・ブルーガーデン

node.description:
Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat.

Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

The strange creature that [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/3749) discovered, Plue is the Rave Bearer, and is able to sense the presence of the other Rave Stones. Plue's nose also has the ability to destroy dark brings. Plue is quite fond of sweets - especially lollipops. Plue hates pudding. He has the ability to utilize the rave of conflict which powers him and Haru up.

Plue has since shown up in Fairy Tail as one of [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186)'s stellar spirits (Nicola, Canis Minor) and quickly named Plue and has been noted to only agree to be summoned on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

name.native: ワイズ・シュタイナー

node.description:
Weisz is a member of Edens Zero and a former thief from the Planet Norma. His power is Machina Maker, an Ether Gear that manipulates machines.

Weisz is a selfish, stubborn, and vain man with a perverted side. However, he does care for his friends, and shows concern for others in his own way. Weisz likes money and bunny girls, and dislikes studying. 

~!He is also the younger version of Professor Weisz from the year X442.!~

Sister Ivry is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Heal Atomizer, is a Healing Ether ability that allows her to mend wounds, undo negative status effects, and repair living machines. Sister is short tempered, enjoys teasing, and has a laid-back attitude, but she is also dutiful and can be friendly to her allies. She has a sadistic side and enjoys torture. She dislikes things that can't be healed.

Sister is shown to be someone who cannot accept death as a finality for machines, going as far to believe machines can be brought back by using the cloud's stored data.

name.native: リサーナ・ストラウス

node.description:
Lisanna is the younger sister of both [Elfman](https://anilist.co/character/5334) and [Mirajane](https://anilist.co/character/5190), and is also a member of Fairy Tail, like her siblings her magic is take over. Her member stamp was on her upper left shoulder and now is on Left Thigh.

~!It is also very possible that Lisanna, Elfman and Mirajane operated in a three man group similar to Shadow Gear. She lost her life while trying to revert Elfman after his full-body Take Over went awry. He quickly lost control of himself and went on a rampage. Lisana gave her life trying to calm him down and stop his rampage. How she actually was able to do this is unknown. The mental and emotional trauma that Elfman and Mirajane both experienced after Lisana's death crippled their powers considerably. Mirajane lost her S-class rank and has not fought since. Elfman suffered major emotional damage and was incapable to cast his full body takeover spell for some time. When he did try casting it, a flashback to Lisana caused him to lose concentration. When Lisanna was younger, she seemed to be very kind like Elfman and unlike Mirajane. She wanted to help [Natsu Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/5187) raise an unknown egg to see what comes out of it, being a little more knowledgeable in it then Natsu. After seeing a softer side of the usually flamboyant Natsu, she stated that he was a lot like her sister and joked that perhaps later she should become his bride which predictably freaked him out. It is shown that while the Earth Land version of Lisanna is deceased, the Edoras version of Lisanna is still alive. Like her Earth land counterpart, she seems just as friendly and caring, as seen when she scolds [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/40437) for bullying Natsu and tells Jet and Droy not to pick on [Elfman](https://anilist.co/character/51087). When Natsu and [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) see her they both shed tears and tried to hug her in joy, this freaked her out. She doesn't seem to have the massive crush her Earth Realm counterpart has on Natsu.!~

~!In chapter 199, it is told that the Earth Realm Lisanna was sucked into Edoras and didn't die. After she was taken back to the Earthland by the reverse anima. She was found by [PantherLily](https://anilist.co/character/33526) and taken to Natsu and the others. There she explained everything to them and go back to the Fairy Tail Guild!~

name.native: ウィッチ・リグレット

node.description:
Witch Regret is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. She is responsible for defending Edens Zero. Her power, Shield Ether, allows her to produce barriers made of Ether. 

Witch is very dutiful and holds a deep respect to Ziggy and his adoptive grandson Shiki. Although she is usually emotionless, Witch is capable of showing emotions. She finds it embarrassing to show her face to other people.

Angel is a mage who belongs to the Oración Seis guild, a Dark guild composed of highly powerful mages, as well as the only female within the group. She along with the others' goal is to find the power know as Nirvana, a very destructive power that was sealed away long ago. She a highly accomplished Celestial Spirit Mage however no better then Karen Lilica as she treats her spirit just as cruelly as the former Blue Pegasus member. Incidentally she was also the murderer of Karen herself.     She is also celestial spirit mage whose spirits are apparently fed up with her since meeting Lucy. She has the ability to summon two celestial spirits at the same time.    Gemini: Her formerly most used Celestial Spirit who is able to copy peoples' looks, memories and powers at will. Their names are Gemi and Mini. They have recently been transferred to Lucy's possession.    Scorpio: A man with a large, gun-like scorpion tail who refers to himself in the plural first person. He is Aquarius' boyfriend.    Aries: Karen's old Celestial Spirit used on Loke, acquired from Karen after Angel killed her. Her abilities are unknown.    Caelum: A spirit that can be wielded like a cannon as well as a sword.     (Source: Fairy Tail Wikia)

Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them.

~!Happy was a cat found by Rebecca when he was young. He instantly became friends with her due to them sharing common life events. He received his name "Happy" from Rebecca for making her happy by becoming her friend. Sometime later, an accident occurred where a drunk driver ran over Happy, which ended up killing him. Thanks to Professor Weisz, he was revived into a machine body and continued his friendship with Rebecca.!~

name.native: エルシー・クリムゾン

node.description: One of the Oración Seis Galáctica, the captain of the pirate ship Skull Fairy, and the leader of her own pirate crew, as well as a fleet of space pirates. An old friend of Ziggy's.

Pino is a miniature anti-bot machine who joins the crew of Edens Zero. She can emit bursts of electromagnetic pulses, also known as EMP, that short out electronics for a few seconds and cancel out Ether Gear when it's in use.

Her digital avatar resembles a young human girl with rabbit-like ears. She wears a necktie that is decorated with a single large heart.

Xiaomei is shown to have a calm and serious disposition as well as knowledgeable due to her precognition abilities.

Due to her precognition abilities not being able to tell a single outcome, it is shown that Xiaomei has an interest in watching people battle and this interest grows to the point where she becomes visibly excited and aroused.
An android that was once known as the "Demon King".  He raised Shiki and taught him the value of making friends.

name.native: ラビリア・クリスティ

node.description: Labilia Christy is an adventurer and B-Cuber who works at the Shooting Starlight guild.

Jinn is a cyborg who was in the team "Rogue Out". His power, Wind Rage, is a type of Ether Gear that uses wind similarly to a typhoon. Jinn likes his sister Kleene and dislikes any man that approaches her. ~!After Rogue Out, he works under Drakken Joe with his sister, Kleene.!~

Valkyrie had the figure of a slim woman with a dark skin tone, and long, red-colored hair tied in a ponytail. She was very tall, taller than all other Shining Stars. She wore a light-colored, form-fitting, and armored battle suit with green gauntlets, pauldrons, and a pair of winged boots with "E1" on her chest.
He is a member of the Interstellar Union Army. He is also the commander of the commando carrier Angel Feather and one of the Oración Seis Interestelar. His main goal is to capture Elsie Crimson.

Michael is a short machine with a very simple design. His head is maroon, large and ovular in shape; he has no visible eyes but two sunken holes in their place, and he has thin, rod-like neck and limbs. He wears a pointed hat and a green cloak with golden stripes and covers his hands with white fabric gloves.

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name.native: ココ・ヘクマティアル

node.description:
The series' protagonist. A young arms dealer and the daughter of Floyd Hekmatyar, a global shipping magnate. Belongs to HCLI's European and African Logistics Division.

She is physically attractive, with long silver-white hair, pale alabaster skin, striking blue eyes and her trademark smile, which is present even under dire circumstances. She is extremely charismatic and bold, which earned her great success in her business as well as the fierce loyalty of her subordinates. While generally behaving in a bubbly and slightly childish manner, Koko is actually rather ruthless and has been called a 'monster' by various characters.

She considers [Jonah](https://anilist.co/character/36566/Mar-Jonathan) a little brother and is very affectionate towards him. [Valmet](https://anilist.co/character/38954/Velmer-Sofia) has a crush on Koko, but whether Koko reciprocates the feelings is unknown.

name.native: ソフィア・ヴェルマー

node.description: An ex-mechanized jäger major of the Finnish Rapid Deployment Force who is skilled with knives. She is in love with [Koko](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko), but it is unknown whether Koko returns her feelings. Her real name is Sofia Velmer. Valmet comes from a military family and served as a UN peacekeeping officer in Africa. Her entire Finnish-led UN squad was annihilated by [Chen Guoming](https://anilist.co/character/65311/Guoming-Chen) and she herself lost an eye in that attack. Since then Valmet feels uneasy and even frightened whenever she sets foot on African soil.

A child soldier. His parents were killed by an airstrike by a F-22 Raptor. Picked up as a child soldier soon after this traumatic event. Despite his intense hatred of weapons, Jonah decides to work under the enigmatic arms dealer, [Koko Hekmatyar](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko). Though he is young, his skills on the battlefield are extraordinary and is frequently shown besting men much older than himself. Also, infrequently displays a childish nature. Is shown to dislike mathematics and science and excels at languages.

His primary weapon in season 1 is an FN FNC and in season 2 it is the Magpul Masada.
Kasper's ruthless head of security and Lehm's ex-wife. Both Chiquita and Lehm used to serve as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguards. She can be considered the best bodyguard in HCLI.

A CIA asset in South Africa assigned to work with Scarecrow. She's more sympathetic to Koko and secretly works as Koko's informant.  

 (Source: Wikipedia)

The oldest member of Koko's crew and the second in command. A former Delta Force operator who used to be active in Somalia during the 1990s, he is a veteran mercenary with strong leadership skills. He acted as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguard together with Chiquita, his ex-wife, before joining Koko's squad. Lehm also does sniper work either alone or together with Lutz.  His surname "Brick" was reveled in ep7 of season 2.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: ウィリアム・ネルソン（ワイリ）

node.description:
An Afro-American explosive expert and ex-lieutenant of the 20th Engineer Brigade of the XVIII Airborne Corps in the US Army. Graduated from University of Virginia School of Architecture. Wiley met Lehm and Echo in the first Gulf War when he was assigned to blow up a chemical factory. After several years, Wiley paid Lehm a visit and met Koko. His real name is William Nelson. He is put in charge of giving Jonah English lessons. He is the only person on the team aside from Koko to be blacklisted by the FBI.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: 天田 南 / Dr.マイアミ

node.description:
She is a Japanese expert in robotics, working for Koko and other companies (though she wanted to use her knowledge to make toys at first). She is also a butterfly fanatic and spend most of her time hunting them. She and Koko have a secret plan going on codenamed "Jormungand".  

(Source: ami)

A former police sniper who was once part of the counter-terrorist unit, until he becomes one of Koko's mercenaries.   

(Source: ANN)

name.native: キャスパー・ヘクマティアル

node.description: Koko's older brother. He is the one who sold the weapons responsible for the death of Jonah's parents, and also the reason Jonah joined up with Koko. He always has his bodyguard Chiquita with him.

She is an assassin from orchestra.   It is reveled that she came from a well off family, until one day when she and her family were attending a play in an opera house, Orchestra barge in to not only kill his intended target but also mercilessly massacred everyone else in the play, she is the only one who survived, though she did tried to avenge the dead of her family, she only manages to wound him. Orchestra didn't kill her, instead he abducts her and trains her to be his protégé in which she developed Stockholm syndrome and she becomes as proficient and ruthless as Orchestra.  "Commando Girl" is a pun given to her by this anime/manga fan-base due the fact that she doesn't wear panties.    (Source: ANN and misc. blogs/forums)   ~! She was sniped by Lehm for drawing (Pointing) a gun at KoKo !~

One of Curry's bodyguard. She has a obsessive crush with Valmet, who she admires as a fellow warrior. Mildo is a knife-trained mercenary and as such, prefers using combat knives and machetes as her main weapon.

A former lieutenant in the People's Liberation Army. Officially she is Chen's secretary but actually,​ she serves as his bodyguard as well as the commander of his soldiers. She tries to avenge Chen after his death but is injured by Jonah. Homeless in South Africa, she is later recruited by Minami Amada and becomes her assistant.

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Lucky Student

Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork. However, he doesn't care for "ordinary, untalented people" such as himself and is extremely self-deprecating; he sees himself as "worthless trash" whose life has no value, something he brings up often. Nagito is also highly intelligent, usually solving the murders long before anyone else, though he doesn't share his findings easily.

Nagito has an extreme, twisted obsession with hope. He believes that hope is an absolute good that will always win in the end, and that anything done in the name of hope, even murder, is virtuous. He sees Ultimates as the embodiments of hope that are chosen at birth, and thinks they can strengthen that hope by facing and overcoming despair. He doesn't consider himself to be a "real" Ultimate, and instead wishes to sacrifice himself so that they can shine.

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and references, and has a habit of ending her sentences with an uncertain note, such as with "...I think", or "Maybe...". [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) has told her that he wishes she had a more positive catchphrase.

Chiaki is very calm, and she once mentioned that she has never screamed. She often helps Hajime Hinata during the Class Trials and provides important points. She can be stern and bluntly honest, even at times forgetting to take other people's feelings into consideration. However, Chiaki truly does care about and wants to protect everyone. She dislikes killing more than anything and she gets very serious about the topic. She is the nicest towards [Monomi](https://anilist.co/character/73237/Monomi) and she is very understanding towards [Nagito Komaeda](https://anilist.co/character/73227/Komaeda-Nagito), even though his actions frustrate her.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

~!It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the younger twin who she switched places with, was the mastermind behind Monokuma, as well as the Tragedy.!~

~!Junko's real personality and mannerisms are erratic and unstable, switching through several "personalities" at the drop of a hat, which she says is because she gets bored easily. Junko is incredibly manipulative and cunning, having orchestrated the Tragedy. She is obsessed with despair and finds it to be the most enjoyable emotion in the world.!~

~!It is eventually revealed that her true talent is that of Super High School Level Analytical Prowess. This ability allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with superhuman speed, detailed thinking, and memorization, giving her the ability to predict the future with near-perfect accuracy, as well as be able to learn and understand new skills by just seeing it once. This ability is also what gave Junko her "Ultimate Fashionista" title: because she's able to predict trends, she can predict what will become popular with society.!~

Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or something at all. He tends to be quite serious, but he does joke around and often goes along with his classmates' eccentric hobbies anyway, and sometimes smiles awkwardly and sheepishly while his friends engage in some of their usual weird behavior. He was also quite paranoid during the start of the game and didn't have much interest in friendship, but he later really wanted to believe in his classmates and felt bad about doubting them during the Class Trials, though he understood it was necessary.

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. He is almost always seen with his extremely well-trained hamsters, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction: San-D (orange and white), Jum-P (grey and white), Maga-Z (tan fur with peach underbelly, chipped ear), and Cham-P (fat, orange). 

Gundham is an eccentric chuunibyou who claims that he has been blessed with the evil powers of the underworld, referring to everyone else as "pathetic human beings" and often rambling about the dark arts, alchemy, and astral levels. He is often lost in his own world, paying more attention to himself and his hamsters than the things going on around him. Because of this, Gundham initially comes off as self-centered and aloof, however he seems to have serious problems with socializing and physical contact. He has been strict about not wanting to touch nor be touched by others since childhood, going as far as to avoid sports and playing with other children. In his typical manner, Gundham claims that his flesh is "poisoned" to disguise his fear of intimacy. He tells [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) that he can only be touched by very specific persons with astral levels that match his own.

Though he may be awkward around other people, Gundham deeply cares about animals (despite how he refers to them as his evil minions to stay in line with his overlord persona). He claims that anything that can talk "will eventually betray you" and prefers to trust animals for their loyalty and sincere nature. He has an informational website about breeding which he maintains carefully. He also gets offended when anyone looks down on the Devas or refers to them as simply average hamsters, as he claims that hamsters are merely their "temporary form".

Kazuichi is a highly emotional character, though he tries to play it smooth and acts carefree at first. He is a very jumpy person, easily scared and often screaming in fear. People tend to note his intimidating appearance does not match his compulsive and cowardly personality. Naturally, he has a great fear of dying on the island during the Killing School Trip, which causes a lot of stress and panic for him. He also often blurts things out without thinking, seems to be a very bad liar, and tends to be slow-witted. Alongside [Mikan Tsumiki](https://anilist.co/character/90008/Tsumiki-Mikan), Kazuichi often ends up being the butt of [Monokuma](https://anilist.co/character/73235/Monokuma) and [Hiyoko Saionji](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s jokes.

Kazuichi tends to carry around a wrench and he gets anxious if he cannot tinker with something. He has a great love for machinery, especially fast ones like rockets and bikes, which is ironic, since he suffers from awful motion sickness. He also likes girls a lot, though in a rather perverted and shallow way. He has taken a strong liking to [Sonia Nevermind](https://anilist.co/character/90015/Nevermind-Sonia), to an extent of being a pervert, and in constant jealousy of [Gundham Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/73213/Tanaka-Gundham). Sakura is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Martial Artist (超高校級の格闘家), or Ultimate Martial Artist in the English localization.

Contrary to what her appearance might suggest, Sakura is a kind and level-headed girl. She rarely loses her nerve and seems able to maintain clarity in almost any situation. During more rare moments, she can lose her temper completely and become extremely intense, particularly when her friends get hurt. She also gets impatient if she cannot properly train for a long period of time. She is known for her love of protein and enjoys exercising early in the morning before a large breakfast.

Due to her more old-fashioned upbringing, Sakura has a habit of talking in an old-fashioned, formal manner. Being raised as the sole heir to a dojo with a three-hundred-year history, she believes that being a martial artist is simply her destiny. Along with learning martial arts, she learned to respect nature and animals, being particularly fond of rabbits as they never seem to get frightened when she holds them.

Along with protecting her legacy as her sworn duty, Sakura wants to prove that a woman can be the Strongest Person Alive. She also believes that she must work harder than men to achieve this goal. As a result of striving to be strong, Sakura is embarrassed about her own softer feelings and being feminine, assuming that other people would laugh at her if they knew.
