sampleCharacters.name: Nagito Komaeda
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") __Talent:__ Ultimate Lucky Student Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork. However, he doesn't care for "ordinary, untalented people" such as himself and is extremely self-deprecating; he sees himself as "worthless trash" whose life has no value, something he brings up often. Nagito is also highly intelligent, usually solving the murders long before anyone else, though he doesn't share his findings easily. Nagito has an extreme, twisted obsession with hope. He believes that hope is an absolute good that will always win in the end, and that anything done in the name of hope, even murder, is virtuous. He sees Ultimates as the embodiments of hope that are chosen at birth, and thinks they can strengthen that hope by facing and overcoming despair. He doesn't consider himself to be a "real" Ultimate, and instead wishes to sacrifice himself so that they can shine.

sampleCharacters.name: Chiaki Nanami
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'2") __Talent:__ Ultimate Gamer A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and references, and has a habit of ending her sentences with an uncertain note, such as with "...I think", or "Maybe...". [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) has told her that he wishes she had a more positive catchphrase. Chiaki is very calm, and she once mentioned that she has never screamed. She often helps Hajime Hinata during the Class Trials and provides important points. She can be stern and bluntly honest, even at times forgetting to take other people's feelings into consideration. However, Chiaki truly does care about and wants to protect everyone. She dislikes killing more than anything and she gets very serious about the topic. She is the nicest towards [Monomi](https://anilist.co/character/73237/Monomi) and she is very understanding towards [Nagito Komaeda](https://anilist.co/character/73227/Komaeda-Nagito), even though his actions frustrate her. ~!Nanami is actually revealed to be an AI created by Alter Ego to be a mole for the Future Foundation.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Gundham Tanaka
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm (5'11") __Talent:__ Ultimate Animal Breeder A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. He is almost always seen with his extremely well-trained hamsters, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction: San-D (orange and white), Jum-P (grey and white), Maga-Z (tan fur with peach underbelly, chipped ear), and Cham-P (fat, orange). Gundham is an eccentric chuunibyou who claims that he has been blessed with the evil powers of the underworld, referring to everyone else as "pathetic human beings" and often rambling about the dark arts, alchemy, and astral levels. He is often lost in his own world, paying more attention to himself and his hamsters than the things going on around him. Because of this, Gundham initially comes off as self-centered and aloof, however he seems to have serious problems with socializing and physical contact. He has been strict about not wanting to touch nor be touched by others since childhood, going as far as to avoid sports and playing with other children. In his typical manner, Gundham claims that his flesh is "poisoned" to disguise his fear of intimacy. He tells [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) that he can only be touched by very specific persons with astral levels that match his own. Though he may be awkward around other people, Gundham deeply cares about animals (despite how he refers to them as his evil minions to stay in line with his overlord persona). He claims that anything that can talk "will eventually betray you" and prefers to trust animals for their loyalty and sincere nature. He has an informational website about breeding which he maintains carefully. He also gets offended when anyone looks down on the Devas or refers to them as simply average hamsters, as he claims that hamsters are merely their "temporary form".

sampleCharacters.name: Fuyuhiko Kuzuryuu
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") __Talent:__ Ultimate Yakuza A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. Fuyuhiko is initially incredibly stand-offish and rude to the other students. When he does interact with them, his attitude is combative and irritable. He was born as the heir of Kuzuryu Clan, but he thinks that his younger sister, [Natsumi](https://anilist.co/character/165731/Kuzuryuu-Natsumi), deserves the title instead. Fuyuhiko states that he wants to be strong on his own and not rely on his family's power to get ahead. His goal is to be strong enough to lead his family, rather than to be strong _because_ he leads his family. He takes duty very seriously, and if there's someone who he can trust, he will open his heart and cooperate with them. Despite being a yakuza, Fuyuhiko has a somewhat pure heart and is very strict to the rules, taking honor and moral codes seriously. He is also particularly sensitive about his "baby face" looks.

sampleCharacters.name: Kazuichi Souda
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'6") __Talent:__ Ultimate Mechanic A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. Kazuichi is a highly emotional character, though he tries to play it smooth and acts carefree at first. He is a very jumpy person, easily scared and often screaming in fear. People tend to note his intimidating appearance does not match his compulsive and cowardly personality. Naturally, he has a great fear of dying on the island during the Killing School Trip, which causes a lot of stress and panic for him. He also often blurts things out without thinking, seems to be a very bad liar, and tends to be slow-witted. Alongside [Mikan Tsumiki](https://anilist.co/character/90008/Tsumiki-Mikan), Kazuichi often ends up being the butt of [Monokuma](https://anilist.co/character/73235/Monokuma) and [Hiyoko Saionji](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s jokes. Kazuichi tends to carry around a wrench and he gets anxious if he cannot tinker with something. He has a great love for machinery, especially fast ones like rockets and bikes, which is ironic, since he suffers from awful motion sickness. He also likes girls a lot, though in a rather perverted and shallow way. He has taken a strong liking to [Sonia Nevermind](https://anilist.co/character/90015/Nevermind-Sonia), to an extent of being a pervert, and in constant jealousy of [Gundham Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/73213/Tanaka-Gundham). He claims that he's dreamed of a beautiful blonde girlfriend since he was a kid. Sonia dislikes this behavior and calls him a stalker.

sampleCharacters.name: Peko Pekoyama
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'6") __Talent:__ Ultimate Swordswoman A student of Hope's Peak Academy Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. Peko initially appears to be rather serious and intimidating, expressing little emotion. However, she isn't unsociable and doesn't mean to act cold. For a long time she didn't smile because she thought it was unnecessary, and she says she eventually forgot how to. Even though she doesn't believe it herself, she is a very kindhearted and selfless person who cares about her classmates, wishing nothing but good for them. She also loves animals, especially pandas, but most animals are scared of her and tend to run away.

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Height:__ 153 cm (5')

Yami no Yuugi is the spirit residing in the Milennium Puzzle. After a historic battle against Zorc Necrophadius, he had sealed his soul along with Zorc in order to save Egypt. However, he had lost his memory as a result.

3,000 (5,000 in the dub) years later, [Yuugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi), after trying to solve the puzzle for eight years, awakens Yami no Yuugi from his slumber, although Yugi does not realize this until much later in the story, more specifically, Duelist Kingdom.

At the end of Duelist Kingdom, he asks Yugi to help him recover his memories and Yugi agrees to help him.  

~!In Battle City, Atem discovers who he was in the past: He was a Pharaoh ruling in Ancient Egypt.!~

__Height:__ 186 cm

Seto Kaiba is the majority shareholder and President of his own multi-national company, KaibaCorp, who aims to become the world's greatest player of the Duel Monsters card game. To accomplish this goal, he must defeat his arch-rival, [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi).

He is largely considered an anti-hero, as his motives are usually ego-centric, but in several cases towards a good cause. Among one of the recurring plots in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters is Seto Kaiba being forced to deal with either people adversely affected by Gozaburo Kaiba's actions wanting to take their revenge on Seto Kaiba, or people from within KaibaCorp attempting to take over the corporation.

Jonouchi is [Yugi](https://anilist.co/character/1374)'s best friend. At the beginning Jonouchi used to bully Yugi but after being saved by Yugi from an even more of a dangerous thug, Jonouchi has been pals with Yugi ever since. Jonouchi likes to hang around with Yugi and learns a lot of new games. He's not always confident that he'll win his games but he always tries his best. He enters the Duelist Kingdom Tournament to get money for his sister, [Shizuka](https://anilist.co/character/5989), who is losing her eyesight. He wants to use the money for her surgery.

__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Yugi Mutou is the main protagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters. At the start of the series, he is a shy boy who is really short for his age, something he always gets teased about in school. For this reason, he was always alone. However, his grandfather gives him the Millennium Puzzle prior to the story's time line and Yugi is told that if he solved it, one wish of his could be granted. He manages to solve the Millennium Puzzle and he asks for friends and his wish is immediately granted. He also awakens the spirit residing in the Puzzle, but Yugi is not aware of this until much later in the story.  When Yugi does become aware, he and the spirit become very close, with him calling the spirit 'Mou Hitori No Boku' - The Other Me - and the spirit calling him 'Aibou' - Partner. Yugi then becomes a vessel for the spirit and he is told that his duty is to help the spirit find his lost memories. With the help of his friends, he helps the Pharaoh regain his memories while overcoming the most difficult of situations.  

Yugi is mostly seen living with his grandfather, since his parents are mostly on business trips. His mother, Ashita, makes a very brief appearance in the beginning of the second season, when Yugi argues with the spirit. Yugi is also very gifted as a duelist with the Duel Monsters card game, thanks to the expertise and upbringing of his grandfather.   Yugi's deck, throughout the series, was really his grandfather's, since his grandfather gave him his deck in episode 1 to battle [Seto Kaiba](https://anilist.co/character/1378/Kaiba-Seto). However, in the last season - Pharaoh's Memory - he uses his own deck, which contains magicians, spellcasters, and machines.  Yugi is also seen as a 'Ladies' Man' in the series, according to the KCGP filler. However, from the beginning, it has been obvious that he has a crush on [Anzu Mazaki](https://anilist.co/character/1379/Mazaki-Anzu), his childhood friend.   

__Yu-Gi-Oh! GX:__ Yugi Mutou makes several apperances in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX. He is first seen as a grown adult in the first episode, whom [Judai Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/1300/Yuki-Judai) runs into on his way to the entrance exam at Duel Academy. Yugi then hands him Winged Kuriboh and walks away. There are also several mentions of him throughout the series. ~!In the final episodes, 179 - 180, he appears again to Judai Yuki, telling him that he has come to help Judai regain what he had lost in the last couple of years, which was the ability to have fun while having a duel. The older Yugi then helps Judai Yuki reach a time period in between Battle City and Doma Arc. A completely different Yugi runs into him and he is challenged to a duel, which he readily accepts. Yugi then notices Judai's strong magical powers as does the spirit, so he lets the spirit take over the duel.!~ 

__Yu-Gi-Oh! The Movie - Bonds Beyond Time:__ Yugi is one the main characters in this 10th Anniversary special of Yu-Gi-Oh! He, along with Judai Yuki of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX and [Yusei Fudou](https://anilist.co/character/9700/Fudou-Yusei) of Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's, battle Paradox in order to save Duel Monsters and the existence of time itself. ~!In one of the 5D's openings, it is shown that Yugi had lost his grandfather's life during one of Paradox's assaults on his time frame and he is extremely distressed over the fact.!~

The strange dark spirit that lies inside the Millennium Ring. He searches for all the other Millennium items. Although the purpose is unknown, it's obvious that the intent is pure evil. When in full possession of Bakura's body, he is capable of invoking many magical powers of the Shadow Realm into this world. The spirit has linked itself through the Millennium Ring to Bakura and is able to return itself to Bakura even if discarded or lost.    He's the main arch enemy of Yami Yugi. He holds a 5,000 year old grudge with Yami Yugi which he never reveals.    Yami Bakura uses an occult deck focused around Fiends & Zombies to unleash powerful dark magics.

name.native: マリク・イシュタール

node.description: The holder of the Millennium Rod. Marik's family has guarded the tomb of the pharaoh for generations. He attempts to obtain the three God Cards through his secret organization, GHOULS, and become Pharaoh himself. Marik seeks to send the Pharaoh's soul into the darkness in which he had to spend his childhood.

Anzu is the childhood friend of [Yugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). She becomes a good friend to [Katsuya Jonouchi](https://anilist.co/character/1377/Jonouchi-Katsuya) and [Hiroto Honda](https://anilist.co/character/1380/Honda-Hiroto), though she is not fond of them at first. 

In the first series anime, Miho Nosaka is also one of Anzu's friends. Anzu does not usually play games with Yugi and his friends, though she is once shown beating Jonouchi. In the manga, especially in the beginning, Anzu has a spunky, tomboyish personality, and in the first chapter, frightens Honda and Jonouchi into leaving the room after they bully Yugi. Anzu possesses a very kind-hearted, strong-willed, and supportive personality. In the Duel Monsters anime, she and Honda, are basically cheerleaders for Yugi and Jonouchi whenever they duel, but she has proven herself adept at dueling as well, and usually keeps up with the going-ons of a duel. She is more feminine, polite, and has a stronger sense of faith and friendship for her group of friends, often serving as the mother/sister figure for the boys. She is known among fans of the Duel Monsters English anime for her "friendship speeches".  

Anzu is athletic and holds jobs to save money in order to attend a dance school in New York City. In the beginning of the series, she is revealed to be working at "Burger World". By Volume 4 in the manga, Anzu is fired from that job for punching a customer who had pinched her buttocks. She gets a job at KaibaCorp afterwards and encounters her friends at KaibaLand. In the Toei anime, Anzu, Honda, and Miho work at Burger World, with Miho and Honda working to support Anzu. Once Burger World closes, Honda and Miho work for a beef bowl restaurant. In the opening scenes of the 1999 film Yugi and his friends discover that she works at "Duel Monsters Center," a Duel Monsters parlor. She already knows Shōgo Aoyama, a regular of the parlor and Yugi's neighbor.  While responding to a fan mail asking him why Yugi and Anzu are not in a romantic relationship, Takahashi stated that the relationship between Anzu and both Yugis is "pretty much a love triangle." He added that Yugi and Anzu "always" act in a "very careful" manner in front of one another, so they cannot admit their feelings for one another. 

Anzu's first Deck is a Fairy Deck. It focuses on Light-Attribute Fairy monsters, and spells to enhance them. Her second Deck is a Spellcaster Deck. Almost all the cards are devoted to the Spellcaster theme, like Fire Sorcerer, Maha Vailo and the Dark Magician Girl because of her one-sided love with both Yugis. She duels once in the manga and three times during the course of the second anime series. During the Virtual World arc, she wields a deck that parallels Yugi's Spellcaster deck, albelit with a more feminine touch.

name.native: ペガサス・ジェイ・クロフォード

node.description: Pegasus is the American creator of the Duel Monsters game and an early antagonist. He possesses the Millennium Eye, and tries to take over the Kaiba Corporation so that he could use its Solid Vision technology to see his departed lover, Cyndia (Cecilia in the English)

__Height:__ 175cm

Mai Valentine, known as Mai Kujaku in the manga and Japanese anime, is a character in Yu-Gi-Oh! second series anime and Yu-Gi-Oh! manga    "Kujaku" means "peahen". Her name in the English anime is a pun of "My Valentine".     At the beginning of the series, Mai is a self-absorbed woman who is only set out for prize money, personal satisfaction and power.    Mai is extremely lonely and convinces herself she doesn't need friends at first. At one point she believed her "Harpie Lady" cards were the closest she would have to friends.    Mai's selfish attitude and outlook on life continues until she meets and finds meaning with Yugi Muto and his friends (of course, she also has a soft spot for Joey). After she meets them, she seems to start caring more for her friends and the deeper meanings of the game. Later on in the series, Mai's wins become empty and her feelings of loneliness return. However, as the series continues she appears to regain her self-esteem and pride as a true duelist.    In the Japanese version; Mai typically uses a quite informal manner of speech. She commonly omits honorifics when speaking with others, but addresses Anzu and Shizuka as "-chan." She uses the informal and potentially condescending "anta", a contraction of the more formal "anata" (similar to the English "hun" from "honey"). She uses the personal pronoun "atakushi", which tends to be a more elegant, if not older, form of self-reference.

Bakura Ryou is a classmate and friend of [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). Mana is a childhood friend of Atem and Mahad and studies magic under Mahad as his apprentice. She is a light-hearted, open, playful and caring girl, who shares a deep bond between her master and Atem.  Mana is a young magician in training at the Dawn of the Duel arc's beginning who serves the priest Mahad. In the Manga she first appeared before Mahad after hiding in the pots outside of the palace. Mahad sensed her there and told her to come out. After popping out of the pot, she exclaimed how she'd do her training later and Mahad responded by telling her she'd never become a sorcerer that way. After Mahad's death, she swears to become a great magician and eventually is able to summon her own Ka, the "Dark Magician Girl".  Later when Yugi's gang discovers her, Yugi explains about the card game back home commenting on her reference to Dark Magician Girl. Mana later helps them to defeat Zorc. She is one of the only two people in the Millennium world who could see Yugi and his friends.  A single panel in the manga shows that she inherited the Millennium Ring after Zorc was defeated.

Another one of Yugi's friends. Honda used to bully Yugi with Jounouchi. He never understood Yugi's fashination with games but he was able to understand the feelings of others. Honda always helps Jounouchi or Yugi when they are in need. He's a friend to the end.

Kaiba's little brother. Mokuba is always following Seto where ever he goes. He has a very strong bond with his brother and has all of his faith within Seto as well. Mokuba helps run Seto's company and will do what ever it takes to please his brother.

Sugoroku Mutou is the grandfather of Yugi Mutou, who gave him his famous Millennium Puzzle as a present, which he had recovered from the tomb of the Pharaoh Atem in his youth. He owns the Kame Game shop, where Yugi and his friends get several of the games they play, and he taught Katsuya Jonouchi how to play the Duel Monsters card game. His fondness for games is even evident in his name: "Sugoroku" is a Japanese game similar to Backgammon.

sampleCharacters.name: Anzu Mazaki
sampleCharacters.description: Anzu is the childhood friend of [Yugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). She becomes a good friend to [Katsuya Jonouchi](https://anilist.co/character/1377/Jonouchi-Katsuya) and [Hiroto Honda](https://anilist.co/character/1380/Honda-Hiroto), though she is not fond of them at first. In the first series anime, Miho Nosaka is also one of Anzu's friends. Anzu does not usually play games with Yugi and his friends, though she is once shown beating Jonouchi. In the manga, especially in the beginning, Anzu has a spunky, tomboyish personality, and in the first chapter, frightens Honda and Jonouchi into leaving the room after they bully Yugi. Anzu possesses a very kind-hearted, strong-willed, and supportive personality. In the Duel Monsters anime, she and Honda, are basically cheerleaders for Yugi and Jonouchi whenever they duel, but she has proven herself adept at dueling as well, and usually keeps up with the going-ons of a duel. She is more feminine, polite, and has a stronger sense of faith and friendship for her group of friends, often serving as the mother/sister figure for the boys. She is known among fans of the Duel Monsters English anime for her "friendship speeches". Anzu is athletic and holds jobs to save money in order to attend a dance school in New York City. In the beginning of the series, she is revealed to be working at "Burger World". By Volume 4 in the manga, Anzu is fired from that job for punching a customer who had pinched her buttocks. She gets a job at KaibaCorp afterwards and encounters her friends at KaibaLand. In the Toei anime, Anzu, Honda, and Miho work at Burger World, with Miho and Honda working to support Anzu. Once Burger World closes, Honda and Miho work for a beef bowl restaurant. In the opening scenes of the 1999 film Yugi and his friends discover that she works at "Duel Monsters Center," a Duel Monsters parlor. She already knows Shōgo Aoyama, a regular of the parlor and Yugi's neighbor. While responding to a fan mail asking him why Yugi and Anzu are not in a romantic relationship, Takahashi stated that the relationship between Anzu and both Yugis is "pretty much a love triangle." He added that Yugi and Anzu "always" act in a "very careful" manner in front of one another, so they cannot admit their feelings for one another. Anzu's first Deck is a Fairy Deck. It focuses on Light-Attribute Fairy monsters, and spells to enhance them. Her second Deck is a Spellcaster Deck. Almost all the cards are devoted to the Spellcaster theme, like Fire Sorcerer, Maha Vailo and the Dark Magician Girl because of her one-sided love with both Yugis. She duels once in the manga and three times during the course of the second anime series. During the Virtual World arc, she wields a deck that parallels Yugi's Spellcaster deck, albelit with a more feminine touch.

sampleCharacters.name: Pegasus Crawford
sampleCharacters.native: ペガサス・ジェイ・クロフォード
sampleCharacters.description: Pegasus is the American creator of the Duel Monsters game and an early antagonist. He possesses the Millennium Eye, and tries to take over the Kaiba Corporation so that he could use its Solid Vision technology to see his departed lover, Cyndia (Cecilia in the English)

sampleCharacters.name: Mai Kujaku
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 175cm Mai Valentine, known as Mai Kujaku in the manga and Japanese anime, is a character in Yu-Gi-Oh! second series anime and Yu-Gi-Oh! manga "Kujaku" means "peahen". Her name in the English anime is a pun of "My Valentine". At the beginning of the series, Mai is a self-absorbed woman who is only set out for prize money, personal satisfaction and power. Mai is extremely lonely and convinces herself she doesn't need friends at first. At one point she believed her "Harpie Lady" cards were the closest she would have to friends. Mai's selfish attitude and outlook on life continues until she meets and finds meaning with Yugi Muto and his friends (of course, she also has a soft spot for Joey). After she meets them, she seems to start caring more for her friends and the deeper meanings of the game. Later on in the series, Mai's wins become empty and her feelings of loneliness return. However, as the series continues she appears to regain her self-esteem and pride as a true duelist. In the Japanese version; Mai typically uses a quite informal manner of speech. She commonly omits honorifics when speaking with others, but addresses Anzu and Shizuka as "-chan." She uses the informal and potentially condescending "anta", a contraction of the more formal "anata" (similar to the English "hun" from "honey"). She uses the personal pronoun "atakushi", which tends to be a more elegant, if not older, form of self-reference.

node.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

__Height:__ 182 cm

Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. 

Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot.

His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059).

__In Fate/Zero:__
~!
Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. 

In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body and is reincarnated in the world. !~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Within the World of Fate/strange Fake, Servant Archer Gilgamesh was previously summoned in the Fourth Fuyuki Holy Grail War and participated in the Fifth Fuyuki Holy Grail War. But the Servant summoned in the False Holy Grail War is a new Servant without any memories of the Fuyuki Holy Grail Wars. 

He is the first Servant summoned in the True and False Holy Grail War as the "False" Archer-class Servant of [Thine Chelc](https://anilist.co/character/87307/).
!~

Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog".

Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal. 


__In Fate/Stay Night:__ 
~! 
Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !~

__In Fate/Grand Order -First Order:__
~! 
He is a Caster-class servant. Unlike the other Servants, he's not blackened and aids [Mash](https://anilist.co/character/120735/Kyrielight-Mash) and [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in their task !~

__In Fate/hollow Ataraxia:__ 

~!
[Caren Hortensia](https://anilist.co/character/46957/Hortensia-Caren) acts as his Master.!~

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__
~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone.
 
With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. 

Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~
 
__In Fate/stay night:__
~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Holy Grail War of Fate/stay night.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__
~!She only truly acts as [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s Servant when their connection is revealed in Heaven's Feel.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__
~!She is a Lancer-class Servant. Medusa is Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__
~!In this singularity Medusa manifests as two separate beings: 

One is Ana, a Lancer-class Servant without a Master. This incarnation represents the young Medusa, from a time when she wasn't known as the monster inhabiting the Shapless Ile. Though still wary of humans for casting her away, she is much closer to the perfect Goddess she was supposed to be.

The other one is Gorgon, an Avenger-class Servant. This incarnation represents Medusa as a man-eating monster. The burning hatred against the humans that exiled her and her sisters led her to become the very monster they accused her to be. Gorgon wields Tiamat's Authority which grants her the ability to generate Demonic Beasts.!~

name.native: マシュ・キリエライト

node.description:
Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul.

~!
In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's soul. Since she's not dissimilar to a Homunculus, her lifespan is limited.!~

~!
The Spirit possessing Mash is none other than [Galahad](https://anilist.co/character/136944/Galahad), Knight of the Round Table, the saint said to be the only one who obtained the Holy Grail only to return it to the Heavens. He was summoned using his shield as a catalyst, carved directly from the Round Table itself. Galahad tried to resist being forcefully bonded to Mash, attempting to destroy the Chaldean researchers and their equipment but was stopped by Mash's resistance. Weary that if he left completely the girl who was bound to him would die he chose to hibernate within Mash!~

name.native: ネロ・クラウディウス
alternative: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (ネロ・クラウディウス・カエサル・アウグストゥス・ゲルマニクス)

node.description:
Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor, had the reputation of a notorious tyrant whose rule was made up of schemes and poison as she oppressed all religious forces, especially Christians, and the Roman Senate during the period from 50 to 60 AD. She was regarded in the same light as the devil, for the assumed Hebrew pronunciation of her name as emperor, Nero Caesar pronounced as "NRVN QSR", equates with the "Number of the Beast". 

__In Fate/Extra:__
~!One of three Servants available to the protagonist of Fate/Extra. While she was notorious as a tyrannical emperor and for her arrogance as an artist with supremacy comparable to the gods, She is a kindhearted individual who wanted what was best for her subjects.!~

__Height:__ 159 cm

Ishtar is the goddess of beauty, good harvests, war, lust, discord, and fertility in Mesopotamian/Sumerian/Babylonian Mythology, and one among the many mother goddesses whose power is derived from the Earth Mother. Said to be the most pampered goddess of them all, her whimsical and egotistical personality tends to make her a nuisance for everybody around her. 

Among the Gods, she is one that presents many Authorities, the power of a Divine Spirit to change reality at will appealing to their status as Gods and their domain over certain aspects of the world. 

~!Due to their nature, Ishtar and [Ereshkigal](https://anilist.co/character/150759/Ereshkigal) are always summoned together and inhabit the same body. !~

__Height:__ 159 cm

Ereshkigal is the Goddess and ruler of the Netherworld in Sumerian Mythology. She and [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/135743/Ishtar) are sister goddesses, polar opposites representing life and death, thus holding a rival relationship.

She was assigned to oversee the Netherworld at birth and upheld her duty with utmost care but inevitably started envying the freedom and carefreeness of her counterpart Ishtar opposed to the utter solitude she was bound to endure. While her sister was revered and pampered Ereshkigal desired nothing more than for someone to see her as she truly is, to not be judged for being the avatar of death.

~!Due to their nature, Ishtar and Ereshkigal are always summoned together and inhabit the same body.!~

Enkidu is known to be [Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh)'s only true friend and much like him, they regard their friendship highly. 

While they may have the appearance of a human they're nothing more than a doll made of mud, shaped and given life by the Gods. Before assuming their current form and acquiring intellect and knowledge, they spent a long time roaming the forests and thus has a deep connection with nature.

The task given to them was to reprimand Gilgamesh tyrannical behavior and bring him back into the service of the Gods but the might of the two was equal and they developed a tight bond fighting together. 

__In Fate/Grand Order - Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia__
~!
Enkidu's corpse, which was buried in the graveyard of the underworld, was taken. Kingu is a chimera created from Enkidu's corpse, although the puppet itself does not find out until later on.
!~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Class name, False Lancer, is the "False" Lancer-class Servant summoned by the [Wolf](https://anilist.co/character/138619/) in the True and False Holy Grail Wars of Fate/strange Fake.
!~

name.native: ジャンヌ・ダルク・オルタ

node.description:
Also known as Jeanne Alter, she is the Alter version of [Jeanne d'Arc](https://anilist.co/character/67769/dArc-Jeanne). Although designated an Alter, it does not mean that she is a different aspect of Jeanne d'Arc. A Jeanne of vengeance that [Gilles de Rais](https://anilist.co/character/16024/de-Rais-Gilles), the French Army's marshal who grieved for Jeanne d'Arc's death, fabricated by means of the Holy Grail shortly after the execution of Jeanne in 1431. As a Heroic Spirit that is an exact opposite of the proper Jeanne, she is manifesting in the Avenger Class.

__In Fate/Samurai Remnant:__ 
~!Unlike the Jeanne Alter from Fate/Grand Order, Jeanne d'Arc herself transformed into an Altered state due to unique summoning circumstances that lead to her sacrificing her saintly purity.!~

Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. 

He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance.

Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

Ushiwakamaru, mainly known by her adult name Minamoto no Yoshitsune, is one of the most famous military figures of Japanese history with only the likes of [Oda Nobunaga](https://anilist.co/character/127210/Oda-Nobunaga) rivaling her fame.

Said to have been trained in the arts of war by a Tengu when in the care of Kurama Temple, she is a master of the combat arts but her peculiar upbringing and natural talent made her impervious to the worries of the average soldier. 

__In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__
~!Ushiwakamaru appears as a Rider-class Servant summoned by [Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh) to protect Uruk's Northern Wall. She is friendly and cheerful yet displays great ability and hardheadedness in battle. Ushiwaka is touched by knowing her legend and sacrifices managed to survive, instilling respect even in people far into the future like [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka). 

She acts as a bait in the battle against [Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/502/Medusa) in the city of Nippur, allowing her allies to retreat. Despite displaying incredible speed through her Noble Phantasm she is ultimately defeated and captured.!~

Lancer of Red is the Lancer-class Servant of Shirou Kotomine of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Originally summoned by one of the five puppet Masters of the Red Faction, he later becomes one of the Servants of Shirou.

~!Lancer's identity is Karna, Son of the Sun God, the invulnerable hero of the Indian epic Mahabharata. Karna was born between a human mother Kunti and the Sun God Surya. As proof of being the son of Surya, he was given a golden armor that granted invulnerability. Karna was born to become a great hero. However, Kunti abandoned Karna and became the queen of King Kuru. Not knowing who his mother was, Karna grew up with a low social status. However, he soon made his existence known to the world by becoming the honored guest of the Royal House Kauravas, who were hostile to King Kuru. Karna participated in the wars around the borders and fought on an equal footing with Arjuna, son of Kunti and Thunder God Indra. Karna eventually fell in battle after being robbed of his golden armor by Indra, suffering many curses, and losing all of his allies. He died in the hands of his half-brother Arjuna. However, he did not hate anyone and accepted his death.!~

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

A beautiful woman who served [Emperor Toba](https://anilist.co/character/394909/Toba-Tennou) said to be the disguised figure of the white-faced, nine-tailed fox. Her childhood name was Misukume. Working in the palace since she was 18 years old, she later became a court lady of Emperor Toba under the name of Tamamo-no-Mae. She was said to have gradually gained the favor of Emperor Toba with her beauty and extensive knowledge. 

In reality, she is a soul that branched off from [Amaterasu](https://anilist.co/character/394908/Amaterasu) and her true identity is not that of a nine-tailed fox, but rather is treated as one of the facets of said goddess. It is wrong to categorize her as a Heroic Spirit though she manifests as such because she wished to "become a good wife"

The Tamamo Nine are a group of nine Heroic Spirits consisting of Tamamo-no-Mae and eight Alter Egos of her. 

__In Fate/Extra__
~!She is a Caster-class Servant. It is revealed that she was once the Servant of the game's final antagonist [Twice H. Pieceman](https://anilist.co/character/189968/Pieceman-H-Twice) before he gained [Saver](https://anilist.co/character/189970/Buddha). Twice kept losing and respawning in the war and, eventually, lost Caster.!~

Quetzalcoatl is a Deity worshiped in many Mesoamerican cultures, with different names depending on the population, and depicted as a Feathered Serpent or with various degrees of anthropomorphic features. 
Worshiped as the god of Sun, wind, arts, crafts, and knowledge; he is said to have greatly contributed to human culture through gifts such as agriculture and fire. Often also associated with Venus as the Morning Star, from which derives a certain affinity for warfare. 

In the world of Fate, Quetzalcoatl manifests as a joyous woman with a strong passion for Lucha Libre. Despite that, she can be ruthless in attacking enemies.

__Height:__ 187 cm

Sir Bedivere was among the first Knights of the Round table, and he remained faithful to the [King](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) until the end. 

Although he was the one who closest guarded the King, he never saw her smile nor learned of her identity as a woman. After attending the King's death he found himself initially unable to return Excalibur to the [Lady of the Lake](https://anilist.co/character/333146/Vivian), for that would signal Artoria was truly gone. Though sad the hard work of his King was not properly rewarded, he understood her Fate could not be changed and finally returned the Sword, hoping she would find a peaceful slumber.

__In Fate/Grand Order Divine Realm of the Round Table:__

~!In this version of History he was unable to return Excalibur, making it impossible for Artoria to pass away and reach Avalon. He has been wandering the Earth for 1500 years, wrought with guilt, trying to finally complete the task the King assigned him!~

Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' 

He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II.
 
~!After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularities thus becoming the epitome of the everyday man tasked with saving the world!~

name.native: レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ

node.description:
Leonardo is an individual from the 15th-16th century, revered as one of the greatest geniuses of human history. 

Often called The Almighty for his vast knowledge and deep mastery of every craft, from Arts to Science. Despite not being from a long-running lineage of Magi, and not having any Magic Crests, DaVinci still excelled at Magecraft thanks to diligent study. 

DaVinci is the Third successful Summoning performed at Chaldea. Summoned when the system was still incomplete, she had limited time at her disposal, but curious about Chaldea's circumstances, and convinced by [Romani](https://anilist.co/character/137154/Archaman-Romani), she decided to stick around. To do so she created a duplicate puppet to act as her Master through a masqueraded contract. This is also the reason why she can't fight, she needs a real Master to actually become a full-fledged Heroic Spirit. 

Though normally male, when summoned he takes the appearance of Mona Lisa. He pursued ideal beauty in life so he is content in becoming the embodiment of ideal beauty in death.

__Height:__ 191 cm   
__Weight:__ 81 kg  

In Fate/Zero
    ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants.
Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight.  Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

Romani Archaman, nicknamed Dr. Roman, is the head of the medical department and later acting director of Chaldea Security Organization during the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.
~!
Romani's true identity is Solomon, the King of Magic. He was summoned by [Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Marisbury--Animusphere) and participated in Fuyuki's Holy Grail War, in 2004, emerging victorious. His wish to the Grail was "to become human" and he was thus reborn as a normal person.!~

Founder of the Hashshashin sect and the 1st to take the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain. 

Nothing is known of his original identity or his existence, not even to the other Hassan successors. 

King Hassan chose to serve as a Judge, observing the Hashshashin sect and its leaders, assuring they were always respecting the old doctrines. If the current leader strayed from the path or was too weak, in body and mind, King Hassan would come to reclaim their head, to ensure the Sect's survival. 
To adhere to the noble task of an Assassin of Assassins, he doesn't use hidden weapons but he's clad in armor and wields a greatsword, fighting the enemy head-on. 

As the wielder of the title of Grand Assassin and being the peak of this Class, King Hassan has become as one with Death itself. 

Azrael the Pale is King Hassan’s younger self from before he took up the role of Old man of the Mountain. As Azrael he dwells in Hell and has been appointed as Chaldea’s supervisor representing the Grand Servants.

name.native: オルガマリー・アニムスフィア

node.description:
Olga Marie Asmleit Animusphere, also known as Olgamally Animusphere, is the daughter of Marisbury Animusphere and heir to the Animusphere family of magi, one of the top 10 families in the Clock Tower. 

She joined Chaldea initially as a Master candidate though she had to step up and assume the control of the Grand Order operation after her father's death. Though severe, arrogant and uptight she still shows compassion and cares for her subordinates within the organization. She trusts and relies on Lev Lainur as a fellow researcher and for support in her duties. 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order__
~!
She is apparently Rayshifted to Singularity F together with Fujimaru and Mash but in reality, only her consciousness was shifted while her body died in the explosion that engulfed the laboratory. Returning back to the current era would mean her mind would die.

This truth is revealed to her by Lev himself, who comes out as the traitor who set the explosives in an attempt at killing all the Chaldean Masters and personnel. To smack her even more, Lainur uses the power of the Holy Grail to cast Olga within CHALDEAS. Since the machine is a miniature reproduction of the Planet comprised of potentially infinite data, being cast within is akin to being sucked into a black hole.!~

name.native: フランシス・ドレイク

node.description:
She was the renowned explorer who successfully became the second person alive who circumnavigated the globe, paving the way for England to become the dominant superpower of the Age of Discovery with its earnings. She also played a significant role in the defeat of the Spanish Invincible Armada and brought Spain - which was called "the Kingdom on which the sun never sets" - to the edge of collapse.   

In Fate/Extra 
~!She is a Rider class servant under the control Shinji Matou.!~

 (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Mash Kyrielight
sampleCharacters.native: マシュ・キリエライト
sampleCharacters.description: Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul. ~! In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's soul. Since she's not dissimilar to a Homunculus, her lifespan is limited.!~ ~! The Spirit possessing Mash is none other than [Galahad](https://anilist.co/character/136944/Galahad), Knight of the Round Table, the saint said to be the only one who obtained the Holy Grail only to return it to the Heavens. He was summoned using his shield as a catalyst, carved directly from the Round Table itself. Galahad tried to resist being forcefully bonded to Mash, attempting to destroy the Chaldean researchers and their equipment but was stopped by Mash's resistance. Weary that if he left completely the girl who was bound to him would die he chose to hibernate within Mash!~

node.description: The main character, the series follows his rapid development from living an average life to becoming an outstanding guitarist. Being a weak individual lacking an authoritative presence , he cannot help but let others push him around, a possible metaphoric stereotype on the very proper and manner conscious Japanese society. Recruited as the last member of BECK, he serves as the second guitarist and vocalist, and has a very beautiful voice that is mostly used for Beck's slower songs. He owns a Fender Telecaster.
Ryusuke's sister who is a talented singer with a strange relationship with Koyuki. At times she seems attracted to him, at others she brushes him off with little regard to his often ignored feelings.

A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar. The band's creator, Ryusuke is BECK's lead guitarist. A once-younger Ryusuke and Eddie Lee stole the Lucille from the trunk of Syke's vehicle.

Main vocalist for BECK, he is the key member that [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke) needed to bring [Taira](https://anilist.co/character/308/Taira-Yoshiyuki) into the band. His attitude, style, and appearance was based on Zack De La Rocha from Rage Against The Machine and compared to [Koyuki](https://anilist.co/character/676/Tanaka-Yukio), his voice is more punk and rock oriented, like the majority of the band's songs. He also named the band Beck after staring at [Ryusuke's dog](https://anilist.co/character/141894/Beck) for a few moments. He also tends to pick his nose.

The first recruited member of BECK, Taira is the bassist, and the most talented band member next to [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke). He plays Music Man StingRay bass. His attitude may sometimes come off as uncaring. He has been seen working as a traffic officer. As the story progresses, we learn that his father was a jazz musician that left him and his mother when he was young.

The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki. He is the drummer, inspired by his brother, and replaces the original drummer of BECK who followed Ryûsuke from his original band, Serial Mama.
Beck is Ryusuke's dog. Ryusuke's band was named 'BECK' by Chiba, in reference to Beck the dog.

Koyuki's guitar and swimming teacher, Saitou once swam in the Olympics but was unable to achieve his dream of winning so has turned his life to teaching others how to swim better. Saitou is loud and demanding in public, and especially strict when it comes to swimming. But when he is out of the water he is much more open, even turning to Koyuki for advice on his attractions to Momo. Saitou is a fan of British rock and his favorite band in the anime is the fictional Rocket Boys

Lead guitarist of Dying Breed, he was Ryusuke's close (and only) friend. It is while they are growing up (and carjacking) that Eddie helped him find Beck (the seemingly patchwork dog) and Lucille. He seems to resemble Kurt Cobain from Nirvana, he can be also based on Eddie Vedder of Pearl Jam or Geddy Lee of Rush.     ~!Just before he died, he entrusted Koyuki with part of his new song "Devil's Way", later Beck completed the song to perform it live in honor of Eddie!~

name.native: ジェイミー･ヴィッカーズ

node.description: Lead singer for Beck's American band "Dying Breed". Known as rock's craziest guy.    After letting Koyuki sing with them at the stage he became a fan of him and tries to push Koyuki to the top.

Koyuki's childhood friend, he eventually was left to choose between her and Maho, though by the time he reached his decision, the two girls also reached one of their own, luckily a similar conclusion.
Koyuki's music teacher at school, she gets to know Saitou through Koyuki and they start to develop a relationship through the series.

The lady who first gets Beck into Greatful Sound (chapter 23, page 10) (with some "help" from Leon Sykes" (chapter 24)) she is also the woman who gets the band into contact with their first label, the indie label "Lust For Life" (Beck: Mongolian chop Squad chapter 43, page 40-45).

Hiromi Masuoka is a student at the Ichieda Gakuen Private High School attended by Koyuki, Saku, and Chiba. She also worked for a period in a doughnut shop next to Koyuki's, the Seiryuu restaurant. She is a friend of Koyuki and Saku.
Rikiya Kitawaza is a thug attending Koyuki's middle school and a childhood friend of Hyodo.
Tanabe is a school friend of Koyuki. His hobbies include photography.

Masaru Hyodo is the chief instigator in a group who bully Koyuki during his middle school days. Hyodo is also a "technically" accomplished guitarist, but as Ryûsuke points out, doesn't have any real feeling or passion behind his playing. Hyodo's father is a famous musician, but his parents are divorced (Hyodo is his mother's maiden name).

Yoshito Morozumi is a school friend of Maho and a budding actor and model. He competes with Koyuki for Maho's affections, often subjecting him to ridicule. He later joins Belle Ame on stage at Greatful Sound.

Originally in Ryusuke's first band, Serial Mama, he turned into his rival, and his new band, Belle Ame, formed as BECK's competition was mainly succeeding through appeal for the band member's looks and not sound. Getting all the big breaks, Belle Ame seemed destined for greatness, until BECK destroyed their ride to fame, at the cost of being blacklisted in the music industry.
Manabu Miyazawa is the vocalist for Eiji's group Belle Ame. Before joining Belle Ame, he was in a band called Cloud.

sampleCharacters.name: Ryuusuke Minami
sampleCharacters.description: A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar. The band's creator, Ryusuke is BECK's lead guitarist. A once-younger Ryusuke and Eddie Lee stole the Lucille from the trunk of Syke's vehicle.

sampleCharacters.name: Yuuji Sakurai
sampleCharacters.description: The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki. He is the drummer, inspired by his brother, and replaces the original drummer of BECK who followed Ryûsuke from his original band, Serial Mama.

sampleCharacters.name: Beck
sampleCharacters.description: Beck is Ryusuke's dog. Ryusuke's band was named 'BECK' by Chiba, in reference to Beck the dog.

sampleCharacters.name: Kenichi Saitou
sampleCharacters.description: Koyuki's guitar and swimming teacher, Saitou once swam in the Olympics but was unable to achieve his dream of winning so has turned his life to teaching others how to swim better. Saitou is loud and demanding in public, and especially strict when it comes to swimming. But when he is out of the water he is much more open, even turning to Koyuki for advice on his attractions to Momo. Saitou is a fan of British rock and his favorite band in the anime is the fictional Rocket Boys
