name.native: ブラック★ロックシューター
alternative: ブラックロックシューター

node.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm  

Black★Rock Shooter is the titular character and main protagonist of many projects, including the anime OVA Black★Rock Shooter, the RPG of the same name, the anime series and the manga Black★Rock Shooter ~Innocent Soul~. She was an original concept created by huke who participated in the release of the song "Black★Rock Shooter" by [supercell](https://anilist.co/staff/103913/supercell). She is voiced by Kana Hanazawa in the OVA and anime and by Maaya Sakamoto in the PSP game.  

Her weapons consist of a black-hilted katana later named as Black Blade and a large gun called ★rock Cannon. 

Black★Rock Shooter is given a personality in the OVA: she is depicted as a calm and collected girl, not speaking at all until her confrontation with [Mato](https://anilist.co/character/63557/Kuroi-Mato). She also does not focus on anything except the most important thing she has to do at the moment. She is shown to be very skilled in fighting.

Black★Rock Shooter in the anime seems to be more brutal than any other B★RS incarnation.

__Height__: 167 cm  

Dead Master has black hair and straight bangs, and neon green eyes. Her clothes consist of a simple Gothic lolita costume. She wears a black dress and a black bolero; her dress extends down to her thighs and is accented with a white ribbon attached to her waist. Dead Master also wears a pair of leggings and a pair of black pumps. She wears a pair of black gauntlets on each hand. On her head is a pair of long horns which resemble a pair of vertebrae with each tip made out of three tips joined at the end. Also has a pair of wings which sit low on her back. She fights with Dead Scythe, and she can also use chains.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Mato takes an interest in and speaks to a girl she sees the first day, [Yomi Takanashi](https://anilist.co/character/63565/Takanashi-Yomi). They became best friends.

__Black★Rock Shooter (OVA):__ Mato is an innocent and naive first year student in middle school. Outwardly, she is outgoing and excitable, but she is very awkward around people she does not know. Internally, she is sensitive and meek, but eventually learns to gain courage.

__Black★Rock Shooter (Anime):__ Mato retains most of her appearance from the OVA, aside from wearing a different, non-seifuku school uniform. The patch of bandage on her right knee is gone, though she now has a bandaid on her right thigh. She is fond of philosophical musings, and often will vaguely say something that she sees (for instance, remarking "blooming" when seeing a patch of flowers) to no one in particular. Saya also describes her as the kind of person who has, until now, never hated anyone or have anyone hate her. Her favorite food is said to be curry.

She is very fond of the book Li'l Bird Li'l Bird Colorful Colors and reads it repeatedly.

__Height:__ 158 cm  

Strength is Yuu's darken persona in the other world. She wears long black boots similar to Black Rock Shooter's, black spandex and a white flamed embroidered hooded scarf. She has a vertebra like tail with white hair. Her main weapons are her two large black "Ogre Fists" that she wears over her arms and are as big as she is.

In the TV series, she gained emotions when she established a connection with Yuu just as she was about to die following a fight with Black Rock Shooter. When Yuu preferred to live in her world than reality, Strength was forced to switch bodies with Yuu, although she doesn't cast a shadow. She inserted false memories of herself into Mato to make it seem like they've been friends for a long time, though she eventually came to like Mato herself. She has the ability to put herself or others into a comatose state, sending their mind into the body of their darken persona. At the series conclusion, she disappears into the wind, returning Yuu to her original body, although she revives later on to continue fighting.

__Height__: 160 cm  

Yomi is a gentle, good-natured girl who speaks politely and calmly; she is very mature for her age. Her name literally means "No hawks, where little birds play." She is supposedly a member of a well-to-do family, staying for some time in Germany before moving to Mato's neighborhood. She also revealed that her frequent moving from one place to another has caused her to develop a sort of distant attitude towards others. However, she is prone to having very dark feelings of loneliness and jealousy; she tends to keep these to herself.   In the 2012 anime, Yomi's personality is somewhat different in that while she is still calm, reserved, and polite, she is also extremely aloof to the point where she is unwilling to make friends. Part of this is her attachment to Kagari Izuriha, both due to the fact that she blames herself for Kagari's injury and because catering to all of Kagari's demands was initially easier than coping with the mental trauma.  Unlike her OVA incarnation, she is more interested in things like art and bracelet making. Like Mato, she likes the book Li'l Bird Colorful Colors.

name.native: ブラック★ゴールドソー

node.description:
__Original Concept__
Black Gold Saw is a girl with red eyes and long black hair. A red flame shoots out from her right eye. She has a pair of curved black horns whose color turns to red as it reaches the tip. Like Dead Master, Black Gold Saw also has skeletal claws. Her outfit is similar to Black★Rock Shooter's except for the design of her jacket and her bikini top; her jacket extends into a worn-out cape which is dyed red at the end.  Her weapon of choice is a large sword with golden blade and a black saw-edge on its reverse side. It has a long handle with a skull-like object on top and a hilt shaped like a crescent; its name is King Saw. 

__Black★Rock Shooter (OVA)__
In the OVA, her jacket is shorter, and she also wears armoured boots with pointed crescent designs. Like all of the "other selves," her eyes have a circular pattern in them. Notably, Black Gold Saw's red flame is not present at all during her appearance.  

__Black★Rock Shooter (Anime)__
Her jacket seems to bear a little bit of resemblance to MEFE's clothing. Her sleeve have a red belt attached to it along with two white line running across just above the belt's line. Her jacket is tied together with a white ribbon. Her shorts is a little bit longer and had more details to it. Her belt is also different. Unlike the OVA design, she had no black thigh-high socks although her grieves are pretty much the same, except for some changes, notably at the base of the foot. Her claws are very much the same as that of BRSB now, but, it's still more skeletal. Her King Saw has a new look as well, with a very much shorter blade and a sawblade on the hilt.  

__Abilities__
Black Gold Saw has demonstrated many abilities in the 2012 anime, more than she ever did in the OVA. She may have some time or reality-altering abilities in terms of the Otherworld, as she managed to stop the destruction of Chariot's world as if she had stopped its time and had seemingly cut reality itself when driving Dead Master into the ground. She also has the ability to create beings, as she creates the strange hooded figures from a watering can. This watering can is also able to sprinkle a mirror-like surface on the ground that shows Saya's memories. She is also able to see things far away using her giant eyes as shown in Episode 1 and Episode 4. She can also summon a massive King Saw out of the ground.

She is the "other self" of Kagari Izuriha. Chariot is a pale skinned female wearing a dress with black and white tones. She wears a large spiked crown on her head, as well as claw-like gloves. Most notable is her choice of footwear: she wears black, metallic thighhighs with black and yellow wheels that can be used as cutting weapons.  Like all of the "other selves" in the anime, her yellow eyes have a circular pattern in them.  Her weapons of choice are a Sword and Shield. Chariot has been shown capable of using the wheels attached to her legs as a weapon against Black★Rock Shooter, as well as a giant spider monster to ride on.  She is said to have a cold gaze, as it feels as if she is piercing into your heart. Chariot is shown to be rather brutal to Black★Rock Shooter when she enters her area in the Otherworld, and when she tries to save Dead Master from Chariot. Chariot also shows some sadistic joy in brutally beating Black★Rock Shooter, which may reflect on how Kagari hates Mato for trying to be friends with Yomi in the real world. (Source: Black★Rock Shooter Wikia)

[Yomi](https://anilist.co/character/63565/Yomi-Takanashi)'s agoraphobic childhood friend, often out of touch with people around her due to years of living as a shut-in following a car accident that left her paraplegic and wheelchair-bound. She's also quite eccentric, often expressing her emotions through her doll Mary and seemingly having a higher tolerance for morbid topics, visuals and events than most. Additionally, she exhibits a penchant for theatrics, expressing her initial distaste towards [Mato](https://anilist.co/character/63557)'s presence by making her play the role of a fat and dirty doll, as well as giving her macaroons in "dirty" colors meant to represent things she finds unpleasant, like chaos or asphalt.

Her counterpart in the other world appears to be [Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/53165).

 Black★Rock Shooter (OVA) Yuu has choppy tawny hair and hazel eyes. She is also very short in stature, much more so than Mato or Yomi. She wears the same school uniform as the former and latter. She is fond of skipping classes in favor of drinking coffee at the consultation room. Mato notes that she is trying to be mature for some reason, and indeed she takes concern over Mato's well-being. A student counsellor at Mato and Yomi's school. She is usually seen preparing, drinking and serving different brands of coffee to her guests. After befriending Yuu in high school, Saya comes to learn of the other world from her, learning of her link to Black Gold Saw. The unrivaled captain of the basketball club at Mato's school, who ends up scouting her for the starting lineup in an upcoming tournament. She has a crush on a boy from her class and ends up giving him a love letter.

Mato and Hiro's mother. Although caring, she doesn't always understand her daughter's problems. She's also worried that Mato's pushing herself too hard, noting that she never complains about her father leaving for an overseas business trip and often seems to hide her true emotions.

Due to the part their departure played in Kagari's condition worsening, she's been blaming herself for it to some extent, believing that without the help of her daughter, Kagari is helpless. Due to this fact weighing on her conscience, she struggles to notice her own daughter's problems.

sampleCharacters.name: Mato Kuroi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Mato takes an interest in and speaks to a girl she sees the first day, [Yomi Takanashi](https://anilist.co/character/63565/Takanashi-Yomi). They became best friends. __Black★Rock Shooter (OVA):__ Mato is an innocent and naive first year student in middle school. Outwardly, she is outgoing and excitable, but she is very awkward around people she does not know. Internally, she is sensitive and meek, but eventually learns to gain courage. __Black★Rock Shooter (Anime):__ Mato retains most of her appearance from the OVA, aside from wearing a different, non-seifuku school uniform. The patch of bandage on her right knee is gone, though she now has a bandaid on her right thigh. She is fond of philosophical musings, and often will vaguely say something that she sees (for instance, remarking "blooming" when seeing a patch of flowers) to no one in particular. Saya also describes her as the kind of person who has, until now, never hated anyone or have anyone hate her. Her favorite food is said to be curry. She is very fond of the book Li'l Bird Li'l Bird Colorful Colors and reads it repeatedly.

sampleCharacters.name: Strength
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Strength is Yuu's darken persona in the other world. She wears long black boots similar to Black Rock Shooter's, black spandex and a white flamed embroidered hooded scarf. She has a vertebra like tail with white hair. Her main weapons are her two large black "Ogre Fists" that she wears over her arms and are as big as she is. In the TV series, she gained emotions when she established a connection with Yuu just as she was about to die following a fight with Black Rock Shooter. When Yuu preferred to live in her world than reality, Strength was forced to switch bodies with Yuu, although she doesn't cast a shadow. She inserted false memories of herself into Mato to make it seem like they've been friends for a long time, though she eventually came to like Mato herself. She has the ability to put herself or others into a comatose state, sending their mind into the body of their darken persona. At the series conclusion, she disappears into the wind, returning Yuu to her original body, although she revives later on to continue fighting.

sampleCharacters.name: Yomi Takanashi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height__: 160 cm Yomi is a gentle, good-natured girl who speaks politely and calmly; she is very mature for her age. Her name literally means "No hawks, where little birds play." She is supposedly a member of a well-to-do family, staying for some time in Germany before moving to Mato's neighborhood. She also revealed that her frequent moving from one place to another has caused her to develop a sort of distant attitude towards others. However, she is prone to having very dark feelings of loneliness and jealousy; she tends to keep these to herself. In the 2012 anime, Yomi's personality is somewhat different in that while she is still calm, reserved, and polite, she is also extremely aloof to the point where she is unwilling to make friends. Part of this is her attachment to Kagari Izuriha, both due to the fact that she blames herself for Kagari's injury and because catering to all of Kagari's demands was initially easier than coping with the mental trauma. Unlike her OVA incarnation, she is more interested in things like art and bracelet making. Like Mato, she likes the book Li'l Bird Colorful Colors.

sampleCharacters.name: Black★Gold Saw
sampleCharacters.native: ブラック★ゴールドソー
sampleCharacters.description: __Original Concept__ Black Gold Saw is a girl with red eyes and long black hair. A red flame shoots out from her right eye. She has a pair of curved black horns whose color turns to red as it reaches the tip. Like Dead Master, Black Gold Saw also has skeletal claws. Her outfit is similar to Black★Rock Shooter's except for the design of her jacket and her bikini top; her jacket extends into a worn-out cape which is dyed red at the end. Her weapon of choice is a large sword with golden blade and a black saw-edge on its reverse side. It has a long handle with a skull-like object on top and a hilt shaped like a crescent; its name is King Saw. __Black★Rock Shooter (OVA)__ In the OVA, her jacket is shorter, and she also wears armoured boots with pointed crescent designs. Like all of the "other selves," her eyes have a circular pattern in them. Notably, Black Gold Saw's red flame is not present at all during her appearance. __Black★Rock Shooter (Anime)__ Her jacket seems to bear a little bit of resemblance to MEFE's clothing. Her sleeve have a red belt attached to it along with two white line running across just above the belt's line. Her jacket is tied together with a white ribbon. Her shorts is a little bit longer and had more details to it. Her belt is also different. Unlike the OVA design, she had no black thigh-high socks although her grieves are pretty much the same, except for some changes, notably at the base of the foot. Her claws are very much the same as that of BRSB now, but, it's still more skeletal. Her King Saw has a new look as well, with a very much shorter blade and a sawblade on the hilt. __Abilities__ Black Gold Saw has demonstrated many abilities in the 2012 anime, more than she ever did in the OVA. She may have some time or reality-altering abilities in terms of the Otherworld, as she managed to stop the destruction of Chariot's world as if she had stopped its time and had seemingly cut reality itself when driving Dead Master into the ground. She also has the ability to create beings, as she creates the strange hooded figures from a watering can. This watering can is also able to sprinkle a mirror-like surface on the ground that shows Saya's memories. She is also able to see things far away using her giant eyes as shown in Episode 1 and Episode 4. She can also summon a massive King Saw out of the ground.

sampleCharacters.name: Chariot
sampleCharacters.description: She is the "other self" of Kagari Izuriha. Chariot is a pale skinned female wearing a dress with black and white tones. She wears a large spiked crown on her head, as well as claw-like gloves. Most notable is her choice of footwear: she wears black, metallic thighhighs with black and yellow wheels that can be used as cutting weapons. Like all of the "other selves" in the anime, her yellow eyes have a circular pattern in them. Her weapons of choice are a Sword and Shield. Chariot has been shown capable of using the wheels attached to her legs as a weapon against Black★Rock Shooter, as well as a giant spider monster to ride on. She is said to have a cold gaze, as it feels as if she is piercing into your heart. Chariot is shown to be rather brutal to Black★Rock Shooter when she enters her area in the Otherworld, and when she tries to save Dead Master from Chariot. Chariot also shows some sadistic joy in brutally beating Black★Rock Shooter, which may reflect on how Kagari hates Mato for trying to be friends with Yomi in the real world. (Source: Black★Rock Shooter Wikia)

node.description:
__Height__: 155 cm 

Eucliwood, also called Eu or Yuu for short, is a necromancer who brought Ayumu back to life to be her guardian and has been living with him since. She wears an armor that suppresses her abilities and doesn't talk because her power can make every word spoken become reality. Instead, she communicates to others by using note pad, which usually pertains to her appetite. Although seemingly emotionless and mute, it is shown that she cares deeply about her friends and other people, even Ayumu though she considers him to be her servant. She does not like the word "death" taken lightly especially since her powers can instantly take a person's life. Ayumu often daydreams about her speaking in a cutesy manner.  

~!She resurrected The King of the Night as a zombie, but eventually killed him before the start of the series.!~  
~!It is revealed that when she was younger, she was able to speak without the consequences of magic.!~

__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")

He was murdered by a serial killer and and brought back to life as a zombie by Eucliwood Hellscythe, a Necromancer of the underworld. The Necromancer now resides with him, improving in his combat skills as he attempts to track down the killer who murdered him.

__Height__: 173 cm  

 Seraphim, "Sera" for short, is a well-endowed vampire ninja (吸血忍者, Kyūketsu-ninja) who combines her Tsubamegaeshi secret sword technique (秘剣 燕返し, Hiken Tsubamegaeshi?) and ninja reflexes with her vampire powers to fight her enemies. She is able to form a pair of bat wings and a katana out of several leaves.  As a vampire, she periodically requires blood to stay alive, and can anesthetize people with a kiss in order to numb the pain from neck bites. She does this with other girls, since kissing a boy would symbolize marriage in her cult's rules. She comes to Ayumu's house to serve Eucliwood, though when rejected, she ends up being Ayumu's servant in hopes she can change her mind. She is rather cold towards Ayumu, constantly calling him a "piece of shit" (クソ虫, kuso mushi?, lit. "dung beetle"), though has a healthy respect for his combat abilities.   

~!In later novels, she seems to be developing feelings for Ayumu, slowly becoming more of a tsundere than when they first met.!~

__Height__: 150 cm (4'11")

A "Masou" Shoujo (pun on the word mahou shoujo meaning magic equipment girl rather than magical girl) from a magic world. She lost her magical powers to Ayumu. She is now a freeloader at Aikawa house. She uses a pink chainsaw as her weapon.

__Height__: 168 cm

A vampire ninja from a different faction from Seraphim's who is also a student in Ayumu's high school. Maelstrom is able to use tonkotsu ramen soup to instantly defeat Megalos, though the explanation behind it is too advanced for even her to understand, and has a machine which sprays said soup over the city whenever a horde of Megalos attack. As a result of accidentally kissing Ayumu when he was pushed by Haruna, they are technically declared married by her faction's customs, and she constantly acts like a wife while at school, where she goes under the alias Yuki Yoshida. Because of how this name is written, she is nicknamed "Tomonori" by Orito.  

~!In Episode 9, when Ayumu risks his life to save Maelstrom from 'self-destructing', she seems to have developed feelings for him.!~

name.native: サラスバティ, 星川 輝羅々

node.description: ~!Sera's superior and vampire ninja idol. Also develops feelings for Ayumu. More specifically his butt.!~

One of Ayumu's classmates and Tomonori's and Kanami's friend. She is a quiet girl who is better at studying and cooking than sports. She has the highest grades in her year. She has trouble looking people in the eye and isn't very good at communicating. She loves shogi. She appears to have feelings for Ayumu.

__Height__: 160 cm
 
Kyoko is a girl who is confined in Furumachi Hospital due to being a victim of the mysterious serial killer. It appears that she was Ayumu's classmate in middle school and also takes a liking to Ayumu, as she often blushes when they speak to each other. In the series so far she is the only survivor of the mysterious serial killings and the only one to have seen the killer.    
~!In episode 5, it is revealed that she is the serial killer also responsible for killing Ayumu.  In episode 6, she is revealed to be possessed by the King of the Night.  In episode 8 of the second season, it is revealed that she fell in love with Ayumu and her sentence is everyone to have no memories of her. However Ayumu promises to remember her, and she promises to believe him as she is taken back to prison.!~

Haruna's teacher at her magical school, also known as Dai-sensei (大先生 lit. Great Teacher), who has an affinity for Kyoto-style tofu and sends Haruna to get her some due to her credit cards being overcharged. It is unknown what her true motives are.   ~! It is later revealed that she had planned to overthrow Lilia Lilith, the Queen of Villiers, a century before the events of the series, and appointed her top pupil, Chris, as the leader of the coup. It ultimately failed, and Chris and a few others involved took the fall; however, Ariel herself apparently managed to escape punishment. !~

Had a short cameo in episode 2.   ~!Takeshi Kurusu seems to be Ayumu's teacher, but in fact he is the strongest Masō-Shōjo, Chris. She used to be Ariel's top pupil but was turned into a plain middle-aged man by the Queen's curse because she was purported to be the leader of a coup that Ariel concocted a century before the events of the series. Since then, she has been plotting her revenge against Ariel for letting her take the fall along with some of the others involved in the coup. Due to her strength and her status as a villain, she can be considered the Masō-Shōjo that all Masō-Shōjos fear. She can turn back to a Masō-Shōjo while she is drunk thanks to her friend Naegleria's ability to cancel magic. She makes a cameo in episode 12 of the anime adaptation in her original form, indicating that she was under the influence at the time.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: ネグレリア・ネビロス

node.description: ~!Ayumu's first enconter with her is by bumping on her breast, and she didn't even get mad or happy. The strongest masou shoujo in Netherworld and also Yuu's acquaintance. She actually lives in Human world and busy with making doujin for winter Comiket. Actually, she doesn't have any offensive-type magic. Her ability is negating magic. It is also believed that she's also responsible to suppress Yuu's magic. Ayumu also saw Nene naked by barging into the bathroom and got his ass kicked. However, she forgives him because she can calmly under stand the situation.!~

Tomonori and Taeko's friend. She's on the basketball team. She's in Ayumu's class in the anime, but is in Tomonori's class in the novel. She has the air of an adult because of her high stature and very long hair. She is the mood maker of the group and loves cute stuffed animals.

Ayumu's classmate. He supposedly has data of all the female students, however, his luck with girls is really bad. Despite that, he continues to act like every single girl wants him.  He is a friend of Kyouko, who he actually sees as a little sister.

A student in Tomonori's class. He's friends with Taeko, Tomonori, and Kanami. He's on the basketball team. Because of his un-Japanese appearance, he's nicknamed "Anderson," a play on the reading of his name.    ~!He's actually from the Realm of the Dead, like Eu. He is as powerful as a D-rank megalo and can calculate exact times and distances, though he says it's only useful for things like knowing how long to leave the lid on a cup of instant ramen.   He has a horned owl that can understand human speech. It gets along well with Haruna despite being a megalo. It has the power to slow down the movement of objects within a certain range. !~

node.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm  

Third King, known as the Red King. Has an ability to control fire. Feared by people as the leader of the Red Clan, HOMRA. Mikoto is a quiet man who says very little, even to his own subordinates. He is very calm, rarely being irritated or annoyed, and even when his mood changes Mikoto still maintains his composure. Mikoto is an avid smoker, often holding a cigarette and a lighter in each hand.

**Height**: 169 cm

A joker who goes around asking for his schoolmates to share their lunch with him. Yashiro is soft-spoken but very charismatic. He is very friendly and well-liked. In addition, he is quite respectful towards anyone he meets, even robots.  He is also somewhat laid-back and happy-go-lucky. Yashiro carries also a red, Japanese-style parasol with him at all times.

~!His real name is Adolf K. Weissman and he's the Silver King. The Colorless King was once in control of "Yashiro's" body, but once he took control of Weissman's original body, their spirits switch. He had amnesia from episode one and regains them in the 11th episode, finally bringing light to the confusing situation.!~

__Height:__ 155 cm

Neko has a very joyful, carefree, and energetic personality. She is very playful, often participating or even starting chases with people. In addition, Neko seems to have no qualms or worries about being nude, especially in front of men, showing some immodesty. She even stated that she does not like wearing clothes, the reason being that "Clothes are too restricting". She is also a mysterious girl, who is also a cat. Neko also likes Shiro and even calls him "My Shiro".

~!Neko is a female Strain. By projecting her powers within a perimeter with herself at the center, she can interfere and manipulate the human senses and perceptions of those around her. However, her powers aren't limited to visual and auditory hallucinations. Her power to manipulate perception can even play with a person's memory. She can create false memories in people, and make people who've met for the first time believe they're old friends.!~

__Height:__ 167 cm  

One of HOMRA's raid captains who goes around riding a skateboard and acts as the group's vanguard. 

He's impulsive, but he also cares about his comrades very much. Yata is a brash teenager with high self-esteem. He is very brutal, showing no hesitation when bludgeoning his opponents, as well as vulgar and easily irritable, cursing openly towards people when things don't go as well as he'd planned. Nonetheless, he shows respect towards his fellow Homura members, especially [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/64597/Suoh-Mikoto); so he gets very shy around girls. 

He hates being called by his first name. He joined to HOMRA with [Saruhiko](https://anilist.co/character/64621/Fushimi-Saruhiko) when they were teenagers.

__Height:__ 178 cm 

A young man with an unyielding personality. He is also a skilled swordsman, martial artist, and housekeeper. Kuroh is a quiet, serious and composed individual that appears tough and completely no-nonsense on the surface. He is very determined to accomplish his goals, whatever they may be, but despite so Kuroh is willing to set them aside for the finer things in life, such as genuine companionship. Kuroh says that he follows a policy where, rather than judging a man by his appearance or words, their actions are what matters more.  In his younger years, Kuroh was trained by the 7th King, Miwa Ichigen. However, after unknown circumstances, Ichigen had passed away, leaving behind a will in Kuroh to defeat the "evil" King.

__Height:__ 178 cm

Third in Command of SCEPTER4 and a former member of HOMRA, having betrayed the latter Clan at some point in the past. Fushimi often displays himself as a cool-headed, though lazy and bored individual. He gives off a listless attitude and seems unmotivated, but is in fact very competent. He prefers not to participate in most of his Clan's activities. However, he will cooperate if necessary with little to no arguments. At the same time, he would often disregard his associates and act out on his own. While focused on an objective, Fushimi is willing to use any method possible to make his tasks quicker and easier, such as drugging innocent civilians. He would even attack several former allies without any hesitation just to accomplish his goal, displaying additional traits of ruthlessness.   A sociopath by nature, Fushimi's personality is far more twisted then he leads others to believe. He is cruel, bloodthirsty, and occasionally sadistic. During battle, Fushimi often sports a wide grin and a tendency to laugh giddily about the dangerous event. He also displays more evident signs of arrogance and superiority towards his opponents. Fushimi often boasts about his strength and speaks to his opponents in a more mocking tone. Nevertheless, Fushimi retains a carefree attitude during battle and likes to make rude, though somewhat personal jokes.  Misaki usually calls him "Saru" (Monkey).   ~!He used to be Misaki's partner back in HOMRA and personally burned the HOMRA mark off his own skin. He also displays the ability to use both blue and red flames from both clans.!~ (Source: ANN, Project K Wikia)

__Height:__ 140 cm 

A quiet, doll-like girl who serves as HOMRA's unofficial mascot. Anna is very quiet and shy compared to her louder, more eccentric HOMRA members. In addition, she rarely expresses much emotion nor does she actively participate in the gang-like activities of HOMRA, due to her young age and status as the sole female in the group; however, she is not unwilling to tag along and cooperate if necessary. She has the ability to locate things and people and read minds using her red marbles.

__Height:__ 185 cm

 The head of SCEPTER4 and the Blue King. Reishi is a sophisticated, observant and composed individual who is cautious in the battlefield. Though he is willing to use physical action in a fight, Reishi does attempt to win with victory through negotiation instead. He is a natural leader and generally puts the concern of innocent lives over his own. Though he possesses a general loathing towards Mikoto Suoh, Reishi still accepts him as a human being. He takes immediate notice when his vice-commander Awashima's displays apparent disregard for his civil rights. However, he remained indifferent to how the idea could effect the Red King, even stating that it was a good one. Reishi has a fondness for solving jigsaw puzzles during his spare time.  As a member of SCEPTER4, Reishi has power over lightning, imbibing himself in a blue color. When exerted, the aura has the defensive potential to protect Reishi and his subordinates against a direct attack from the flames of Mikoto Suoh, known as the king of HOMRA and an incredibly powerful combatant.

__Height:__ 188 cm

Izumo is a very composed individual, reacting calmly even in dangerous or extreme situations. He retains this trait even when in the midst of a battle. However, because of his nature, others often tend to be intimidated by him. Additionally, he is quite intelligent and knowledgeable of the people or things around him. Izumo has a fairly extensive knowledge of people's backgrounds. Izumo is an avid smoker, and speaks in the Kyoto dialect. Owner of the bar "HOMRA", and has known Suoh for a long time.

__Height:__ 170 cm

She acts as Munakata's right arm, coldly carrying out her missions. Seri appears to be somewhat passive, though seemingly indifferent about others' civil rights. She prefers to use different alternatives in dire situations rather than killing as a first option.  She's a regular at Izumo's bar and she likes her martinis with red bean paste.

__Height:__ 172 cm

One of the original members of HOMRA along with Suoh and Kusanagi. He can get along with anyone, so he often sets the mood in HOMRA. Totsuka has a calm, laid-back and very friendly personality. He often engages in conversations with people, even strangers, showing that he is charismatic and somewhat talkative. Totsuka has a habit of constantly recording things wherever he went; while he had stated that he does this during important events, he appears to do this in his free time as well, whether he was aware of it or not.

(Source: ANN, K Project Wikia)
Formerly a student of Ichigen Miwa and the senior of Kuroh Yatogami, he left the colorless clan and is now a J-Rank member of the Green Clan.

Nagare Hisui is the Fifth and Green King, and runs the Green Clan JUNGLE. He has the ability to channel himself through a green bird named Kotosaka, and use it as a medium for communication.

~!A survivor of the Kagutsu Crater incident where his heart was punctured by the debris. He was chosen as the Green King in this moment which helped preserve his life!~

A member of the Green Clan and a J-ranked (the highest rank) clansman. Gojou has an interest and enjoyment in Hisui's plan, and has a familiar, sibling-like relationship with Yukari Mishakuji, and quarrels with him in a brotherly fashion. Often, he idles about 's hideout playing games, and feels at ease with the Clan's atmosphere, but gets easily bored. Given his small size, he fights dynamically and nimbly.

He has a nasty personality towards his enemies, but is very much a typical child his age around his allies, expressing much impatience when he's initially kept from actively participating in the rising carnage surrounding the other Clans.

(Source: Official site)

__Height:__ 158 cm  

A member of the Ashinaka High School's Student Council. Kukuri is a friendly, kindhearted girl.

She appears to have an interest in her classmate, Yashiro. When she notices that he doesn't have any vegetables included in his lunch, she decides to share hers with him, even going as far as to run across their entire school campus before finally giving up. Kukuri adds that he seems to fade away when she's not looking at him, showing a wider range of perception around him. When Neko and Kuroh "transfer" into Ashinaka High School, she quickly befriends the two, as they are both Yashiro's friends. Kukuri and Kuroh seems to get along well as a result of previous encounters.

__Height:__ 185 cm  

A big man who is always hanging out with [Yata](https://anilist.co/character/64631/Yata-Misaki). He may be big, but so is his honor. Rikio is a serious individual, though he does like playing games and engaging in fights. Nonetheless, he is quite friendly especially towards his fellow Homura members; upon Shōhei's inauguration, Rikio is one of the first few to immediately accept him into their leagues. He also appears to be a gluttonous fellow; during important objectives, he would instead go out and buy food to eat at the moment.

~!Previously known as Seigo Ōtori, the king of the Grey clan, the sixth clan, which was completely annihilated in the Kagutsu Crater incident leaving him the only survivor. While searching for surviving clansman he finds Nagare Hisui who becomes the Green King in the rubble and helps to save his life. He now lives with Nagare in the Green Clan's headquarters and acts as the father of the group. Uses a gun to shoot his aura as powerful bullets!~

__Height:__ 177 cm 

Kuroh Yatogami's master, the former seventh king, the Colorless King. He was claimed to be able to see the future.
A member of JUNGLE, U-Rank.

__Height:__ 210 cm.

The "Golden King"—the Second King—who currently reigns as the strongest King and the ruler of the earthly realm. He is a man of advanced age and immense physical stature.

He is a figure who stands on equal footing with the First King, the "Silver King" Adolf K. Weismann.

He was the driving force behind transforming the defeated nation of Japan into a global economic and technological powerhouse following the war, and he effectively controls Japan's political and business worlds. Even the Prime Minister cannot defy him, and he holds a position of seniority over the Fourth King, the "Blue King" Reisi Munakata; he is addressed as "Gozen" (His Excellency/The Honorable One).

He resides within the Mihashira Tower in Shichikamado, the political heart of Tokyo in this world. His subordinates include an elite guard clad in old-fashioned attire and wearing rabbit masks, commonly known as "Rabbits."

Towards the end of World War II, while serving as a lieutenant in the Imperial Japanese Army, he was a comrade of Weismann; he witnessed the experimental research into the "Kings" and marveled at the prospect of creating the ultimate military force using the power of a King.

However, their paths diverged after Weismann's older sister, Claudia, lost her life in the 1945 bombing of Dresden.

title.english: Darker than Black: Gemini of the Meteor

synonyms: DARKER THAN BLACK ภาคที่ 2

node.description: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered. He lives in the Umitsuki apartments and is always working a new part-time job.He has a huge appetite, not unlike most anime characters.  Hei's other life is of a Contractor called BK-201 and also the Black Reaper, mostly by other Contractors. Before becoming a contractor Hei was an assassin which earned him his nickname. Hei is usually seen on the job in a mask and a dark bullet proof coat.  Hei has the ability to manipulate electrons and can also disturb matter on a quantum level.

A member of [Hei](https://anilist.co/character/2160/)'s team, an emotionless spirit medium known as a "Doll." Her power lies in tracking and observation through direct contact with water. [Huang](https://anilist.co/character/2164/) mentions that her "program" is a minimal one, incapable of showing emotion or even allowing her to make decisions for herself; however, she later debunks this by making the decision to keep working with Hei and the others when given the choice of leaving, a possible sign of her recovering her humanity.

~! Yin is of Finnish origin and her real name is Kirsi. She was once a student of a famed Finnish pianist named [Eelis Kastinen](https://anilist.co/character/23856/), who slowly started developing a love interest in her mother. Yin's father died in a plane crash. !~

His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432. His brain is directly connected to a wireless network which enables him to send and receive information at any time, as well as subduing the natural instincts of the animals he possesses. Mao usually creates diversions for Hei in battle. Mao's ability is to possess the bodies of other animals. While he lost his remuneration along with his body, he must connect periodically with the wireless network or run the risk of having the animal's natural instincts take over.    ~!Near the end of the series, his wireless connection is cut off, eliminating his human consciousness and resulting in his 'death.' However, he had a backup network under the control of an unknown organization and he manages to reunite with Hei. It is likely that "Mao" is his codename; like Hei, his real name was never stated. He is also in hiding with Hei, residing in the body of Suou's pet squirrel Petya.!~  Mao hates the Spring season as most cats would find a partner and try to have kittens.

name.native: 蘇芳・パブリチェンコ

node.description: The main female protagonist. A girl who lives in Vladivostok, Russia. In the Gemini of the Meteor story arc, Suou becomes involved in the war and machinations between the various groups and Contractors, and her life is forever changed when she meets Hei. She is Eurasian, with a Japanese mother and Russian father. She also has a twin brother, Shion, who uses a wheelchair. She is later revealed to have some form of contractor ability when she goes into mental shock, which awakens her latent powers. Her exact Contractor ability is not explicitly known, but with it, she is able to manifest an PTRD-41 from the meteor fragment she wears. Suou wields the rifle with ease and skill, though whether this is also part of her Contractor ability or not is unknown. Her remuneration involves folding paper into origami, though it is not known if her remuneration is folding origami.~!It is later revealed that Suou was a copy that was made from her brother's ability. The real Suou had died when she was 5 years old at the University her parents were at.!~~!She also develops feelings for Hei later on.!~

The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition. Kirihara became a policewoman in order to protect the weak, has a distaste for smokers due to their smell, and is sensitive about the exposure of her body. She likes eating greasy food but claims to stay fit due to constantly moving around everyday as part of her job. Her father is Superintendent Supervisor Naoyasu Kirihara of the National Police Agency.   (Source: Wikipedia)     ~!It is hinted that she may have romantic feelings for Li Shun Sheng(Hei).  It was later revealed in the later part of special episode 26, that Hei's identity was revealed to her accidentally in a situation. In that particular episode, her subordinate,Yusuke Saito, has feelings for her and confessed it accidentally during a situation. Their memories of that incident however, was erased due to a however soon after verbalizing them his memory along with Kirihara's is erased due to a memory erasing substance accidentally released by Mao.!~

The first confirmed Contractor, with her star's Messier code UB-001. She was originally a spy for MI6 with the codename February but later defected and joined the Syndicate, adopting "Amber" as her new name. She worked together with Hei and Bai in South America during the "Heaven's War", and founded and leader of her own organization, the Evening Primrose at that time. She went missing together with Bai and millions of other people when the Heaven's Gate disappeared, only to reappear later to fight the Syndicate with the rest of the strenghtened Evening Primrose.   Amber's ability is chronal manipulation, which includes temporal freezing of time and rewinding of events to an unknown degree. Elaborate usage of her power enables her to gain knowledge of future events, and then respond to them accordingly. Once time has been frozen around her, she can also pull other people out of the frozen time stream, while those still under her ability's effect will no longer detect her presence or movement. Her remuneration is aging backwards, making her appear frequently younger. Amber loves Hei, in spite of him believing her to be a traitor, and has stated that she has only seen him truly smile once and she would do anything to see that smile again. Amber's feelings for Hei often result in her making decisions that compromise the mission objectives of the Evening Primrose and at times she goes as far as to order her subordinates to avoid fighting Hei.   ~! Her overall objective is to destroy the Hell's Gate in a way that doesn't erase every Contractor from existence. She maintains the mysterious Meteor Fragment retrieved from PANDORA's Gate Research Facility in her care in a pouch slung across her shoulder. After showing him all that he would have if he used his power to close off the gate (her, his friends, and his sister), she reveals the true extent of her feelings for him by sacrificing herself so that Hei may pursue, instead, the option of shutting down the particle accelerator that would destroy the gate instead of sacrificing Japan or all Contractors. !~

A young child most often seen being led around by April. He is a Doll whose observation powers rely on glass as a medium. He considers November and April to be his friends, a fact that initially astonishes Misaki and November as dolls are not supposed to think outside of their programming. April and July frequent November 11's roadside site of death with offers of a bouquet or cigarettes and a beer or two. In the third episode of the 2nd season, July assists Suou by helping her direct her new-found powers against the FSB and the MIAC, and later joins up with Hei's group, although his motivations for joining them remains unclear.    

~!However, it is implied later on that he has fallen in love with Suou. After he and Suou are killed by Izanami, they are both seen in the alternate world Shion created, with July being a normal boy instead of a doll. !~ 

(Source: Wikipedia)

Kiko is Kurasawa Gai's secretary/assistant. Usually referred to as "flat-chested" by Gai, she's an upbeat, energetic girl who loves anime and cosplaying.  In fact, she prioritizes her two hobbies over her job responsibilities.

Kurasawa Gai is Japan's number one detective.  Formerly known as Matsukichi Gai, he was a police officer who quit the force to start his own detective agency.  He uses unorthodox methods to solve mysteries and crimes, afraid of cats, has horrible body odor and athlete's foot, and is struggling financially.  A lot of Gai's actions cannot be taken seriously, but he is quite amusing.      Other Info:      ~!Importance: Medium  Status: Alive  Episode(s)*: 7, 8, 13, 14    *Still to be revised!~

Mina works with Genma and Youko for Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications. Her power is the ability to turn things into a weapon which she can use as a sword. Mina's remuneration is to kiss a man, which goes against her preference.

A woman who supports November 11. Her power creates hurricanes which result in downpours, coating everything in water so that November 11 can freeze it. Her remuneration is to drink beer. In contrast to November 11, she very much enjoys her remuneration due to her love for alcohol. (Source: Wikipedia)   ~!In Ryuusei no Gemini, Hei kills April when she attempts to suffocate him with water.!~

August 7 is a Contractor and agent for MI6 who acts as a contact for April and July. He is also known as the Magician due to his love for magic tricks and his manner of dress: a long red cape and a top hat. Although his ability resembles real magic, it is suggested that August 7's real power is the manipulation and distortion of space, allowing him to do things such as turn bullets around in mid-air or store large weapons in his pockets. His renumeration is revealing the secrets of magic tricks, much to his displeasure.

A known underworld information broker and specialist for having vast information and knowledge on a number of subjects, she recruits Hei to take down the Section 3 convoy before he cuts off all contact with her. She is also known to the CIA, having met with one of their agents named Mr. Smith to locate Hei after he went rogue again.   ~!It is revealed that she had a relationship with Mao sometime in that past, and calls Mao by the name Ricardo.!~   source: Wikipedia.   ~!It is eventually revealed that as part of Shion's plan Oreille and Doctor Pavlichenko has built a super computer that has all the records of the world, observed by the Doll Network and all memories of mankind gathered by the ME Network.!~

A subordinate of Kirihara's. Traditionally wears a business suit. Despite being an officer, he seems to have little common sense as he infiltrated a gang operation undercover using his real name. He has admitted to finding Kirihara scary. However, Saitō is loyal to Kirihara and protects her from harm, even when he thinks she's frightening. It is revealed in the OVA that Saito has feelings for Kirihara, however soon after verbalizing them his memory along with Kirihara's is erased due to a memory erasing substance accidentally released by Mao.  (Wikipedia)

An innocent and shy girl who is introduced in the beginning as Suou's friend. She mysteriously transforms into a contractor shortly after, changing her into a cold, emotionless person. Her power is radiation; her remuneration is pulling out her hair.
A staff member of the MIAC team with Genma and Mina. She usually performs support duties such as driving them around or tapping radio communications.    (Source: Wikipedia)
A Doll that travels with Madam Oreille throughout the anime.    Has a twin sister named Bernice (also a Doll)    (Source: Wikia)

name.native: 紫苑・パブリチェンコ

node.description: Suou's twin brother. He loses his right eye due to an accident with a falling meteor core fragment, however this incident turns him into a Contractor. His power is telepathy and his remuneration is to use a wheelchair.  (Wikipedia)   ~!In the later episodes, it was revealed that his contractor powers were to create a copy of any objects, be it a living being or an inanimate object (He was born a contractor, later revealed in the series). It is somehow unclear what his actual remuneration is.!~
Kirihara's friend since high school. She works under the the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan  (Source: Wikipedia)

He is a contractor who works for Ministry of Community and Affairs of Japan. His contractor power is the ability to manipulate materials around him into large protective armored  suits. Materials such as steel and concrete are used.

An agent of Section 3. She was formerly a housewife to a local restaurant owner named Lebanon, who left him and their son Norio after turning to a Contractor by unknown means. She can manipulate a water source as a weapon.

An agent working in the FSB, Goran is a Contractor who is able to move at super speed in short distances. His remuneration is to eat hamburgers, and always has them handy for consumption whenever he is out on field work.   ~!He is later killed by April!~
Nikolay Lobanov is a boy one grade higher than, and in the same photography club, as Suou and the boyfriend of Tanya.

Her remuneration involves folding paper into origami, though it is not known if her remuneration is folding origami.~!It is later revealed that Suou was a copy that was made from her brother's ability. The real Suou had died when she was 5 years old at the University her parents were at.!~~!She also develops feelings for Hei later on.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Mina Hazuki
sampleCharacters.description: Mina works with Genma and Youko for Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications. Her power is the ability to turn things into a weapon which she can use as a sword. Mina's remuneration is to kiss a man, which goes against her preference.

sampleCharacters.name: August 7
sampleCharacters.description: August 7 is a Contractor and agent for MI6 who acts as a contact for April and July. He is also known as the Magician due to his love for magic tricks and his manner of dress: a long red cape and a top hat. Although his ability resembles real magic, it is suggested that August 7's real power is the manipulation and distortion of space, allowing him to do things such as turn bullets around in mid-air or store large weapons in his pockets. His renumeration is revealing the secrets of magic tricks, much to his displeasure.

sampleCharacters.name: Oreille
sampleCharacters.description: A known underworld information broker and specialist for having vast information and knowledge on a number of subjects, she recruits Hei to take down the Section 3 convoy before he cuts off all contact with her. She is also known to the CIA, having met with one of their agents named Mr. Smith to locate Hei after he went rogue again. ~!It is revealed that she had a relationship with Mao sometime in that past, and calls Mao by the name Ricardo.!~ source: Wikipedia. ~!It is eventually revealed that as part of Shion's plan Oreille and Doctor Pavlichenko has built a super computer that has all the records of the world, observed by the Doll Network and all memories of mankind gathered by the ME Network.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Tanya Akurou
sampleCharacters.description: An innocent and shy girl who is introduced in the beginning as Suou's friend. She mysteriously transforms into a contractor shortly after, changing her into a cold, emotionless person. Her power is radiation; her remuneration is pulling out her hair.

sampleCharacters.name: Youko Sawasaki
sampleCharacters.description: A staff member of the MIAC team with Genma and Mina. She usually performs support duties such as driving them around or tapping radio communications. (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Ariel
sampleCharacters.description: A Doll that travels with Madam Oreille throughout the anime. Has a twin sister named Bernice (also a Doll) (Source: Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Shion Pavlichenko
sampleCharacters.native: 紫苑・パブリチェンコ
sampleCharacters.description: Suou's twin brother. He loses his right eye due to an accident with a falling meteor core fragment, however this incident turns him into a Contractor. His power is telepathy and his remuneration is to use a wheelchair. (Wikipedia) ~!In the later episodes, it was revealed that his contractor powers were to create a copy of any objects, be it a living being or an inanimate object (He was born a contractor, later revealed in the series). It is somehow unclear what his actual remuneration is.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Kanami Ishizaki
sampleCharacters.description: Kirihara's friend since high school. She works under the the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Genma Shizume
sampleCharacters.description: He is a contractor who works for Ministry of Community and Affairs of Japan. His contractor power is the ability to manipulate materials around him into large protective armored suits. Materials such as steel and concrete are used.

sampleCharacters.name: Michiru
sampleCharacters.description: An agent of Section 3. She was formerly a housewife to a local restaurant owner named Lebanon, who left him and their son Norio after turning to a Contractor by unknown means. She can manipulate a water source as a weapon.

sampleCharacters.name: Goran
sampleCharacters.description: An agent working in the FSB, Goran is a Contractor who is able to move at super speed in short distances. His remuneration is to eat hamburgers, and always has them handy for consumption whenever he is out on field work. ~!He is later killed by April!~

sampleCharacters.name: Nikolay Lobanov
sampleCharacters.description: Nikolay Lobanov is a boy one grade higher than, and in the same photography club, as Suou and the boyfriend of Tanya.

title.native: アルドノア・ゼロ 第2クール

synonyms: ALDNOAH.ZERO: Let Justice Be Done, Though The Heavens Fall.

node.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Inaho is a young boy of average height and short tousled black hair. His eyes hold a burgundy color and he has a blank gaze. He is seen in his high school standard uniform which consists of a white shirt, red tie and white sweater, along with a light brown blazer on the outside and black pants. His backpack is dark blue.

Inaho is a calm, intelligent boy. Even at times of great distress, he calmly thinks of a way out. He is intuitive and not afraid to go on many different tactics to analyze the opponents and figure out the suitable strategy.

Inaho's parents died sometime prior to the war and he lived alone with his sister. Waking up, cooking breakfast for his sister, he leaves for his school in Shinawara. He, along with his friends, attended the parade where the princess was killed by a missile attack. Shortly after, the Orbital Knights declared war on the Terrans and invaded Earth. Inaho's daily life was shattered because of the attack.

name.native: スレイン・トロイヤード

node.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

He is the son of Dr. Troyard, a brilliant scientist researching Aldnoah, and was launched to Mars by his father as a means to protect him. He was found by [Princess Asselyum Vers Allusia](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia) who took him in and later on became her tutor. After several years of living on Mars, [Count Cruhteo](https://anilist.co/character/88435/Cruhteo) takes custody over Slaine.

Slaine is very friendly and loyal towards Princess Asselyum as she was the one who saved him and the first person he met on Mars. He wishes to support her in any way possible and is willing to put his own life at risk in order to protect Princess Asselyum. Towards others however, he acts coldly and does not seem to trust anyone other than the Princess, often distancing himself from both Martians and Terrans. He is always seen with a serious look on his face.

Slaine proves himself to be a very capable pilot, able to quickly maneuver around in a Kataphrakt and face [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Kaizuka-Inaho) by himself.

~![Count Saazbaum](https://anilist.co/character/88437/Saazbaum) eventually names Slaine as his son.!~

name.native: アセイラム・ヴァース・アリューシア

node.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

The Princess of the Vers Empire. She is very close to [Slaine](https://anilist.co/character/88174/Troyard-Slaine). She went to Earth on a goodwill visit, but her motorcade was attacked and she was presumed to have died. This assassination was used by the orbiting Martians as a casus belli for their invasion. However, the princess was ill that day and the person who died was a body double. Asseylum now travels with Inaho's group under a false identity until they can get a message back to her grandfather in hopes of stopping the rekindled war.

Asseylum is an idealist and pacifist. She believes in peaceful solutions and she sees the people of the Earth in a good light. Unlike many of the Martians shown so far, she seems to treat the people of Earth as equal humans. Asseylum appears to be regretful of the actions that led to the Second Earth-Mars War between the Martians and the people of Earth, yet she feels that she has the responsibility to help stop the war.

Asseylum is kind, caring, and compassionate, however she is also naive, believing that if her grandfather found out that she were still alive, that the war would end. Asseylum later realizes her naivety, and that certain people of VERS were only using her as an excuse to start a war with Earth.

Asseylum seems to also have a bold and decisive side, she is not particularly guarded around others being quickly open and friendly. Asseylum seems to prioritize the safety of others over herself, and takes her position as the Princess of VERS seriously.

name.native: ライエ・アリアーシュ

node.description:
**Height:** 158 cm

A Martian pilot and soldier fighting for the UFE. Rayet is a member of a group of Martians that were ordered to stay behind on Earth, alongside her father Wolf Areash, after the first Earth-Mars War in order to assassinate Princess [Asseylum Vers Allusia](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia). After the operation however, all members of the group except Rayet were killed by [Sir Trillram](https://anilist.co/character/88438/Trillram) in order to hide all evidence. Rayet being the only survivor and orphan, Sir Trillram tries to kill Rayet to fully tie all loose ends until she finds refuge with [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Inaho-Kaizuka) and his friends who are unaware of Rayet's background. She has a strong hatred towards the Vers Empire and seeks revenge for her father's death.

Rayet is a cold individual who stays cool in stressful situations and acts in a very calm manner. She doesn't seem to express many emotions even after witnessing the death of her father and comrades. Prior to her father's death, Rayet was a cheerful and energetic girl who deeply loved her father, the exact opposite of her present personality. Although born a Martian, she considers all Martians her enemies and wonders how Princess Asselyum is able to live alongside humans.

Although having the age and appearance of a young girl, she has a lot of knowledge about  Martian and Earth machinery/weaponry. She shows that she is also able to drive vehicles, properly use firearms, and pilot a Kataphrakt.

__Height:__ 168 cm

A warrant officer of the UFE (United Forces of Earth) and a pilot for the Mustang Platoon. She is a woman of average height with straight black hair that reaches her back and side bangs that ends right above her hazel eyes. She is mostly seen with her soldier's uniform which consists of a plain white dress shirt, a blue tie, and a navy blue pencil skirt.

Not much is known about her past except that her parents passed away when she was at a young age and her brother, [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Inaho-Kaizuka), was only a baby. The two of them grew up at a government foster facility and later on began living together in an apartment. Unfortunately for Yuki, she was not prepared to raise her younger brother as a parental figure resulting in Inaho taking care of her instead. Currently, she is an instructor at Shinawara high school and is the pilot of the KG-7 Areion Terran Kataphrakt.

Being an easy-going and carefree woman, she often relies on her younger brother, Inaho, to take care of her who often has to wake her up and cook for her.  However, she shows that she is able to be serious and focused on her goal when needed. Yuki is also a very caring person, often worrying about others and putting their safety above herself, especially when it comes to Inaho. She greatly cares for her younger brother and often worries about him. 

Yuki shows that she is a skilled pilot when piloting the KG-7 Areion during the second Earth-Mars War.
Inaho's childhood friend and fellow high school classmate. She is a member of the Student Council Committee.

name.native: ダルザナ・マグバレッジ

node.description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'7")

The captain of the 4th Fleet Escort Force's Amphibious Assault Ship UES Wadatsumi. Her birth name is actually Darzana Humeray but her family name was later changed to Magbaredge after being adopted by the Magbaredge family. This was why during the first Earth-Mars war, Lt. Koichiro was not able to make the connection that she is John Humeray's younger sister. During the second Earth-Mars war, she became the captain of the Amphibious Assault Ship UES Wadatsumi and later went on the become the captain of the UFE (United Forces of Earth).

Being the captain of her ship, she has a strong sense of responsibility and always prioritizes the safety of her crew on the ship before anything else. She tends to act strictly but not overly strict to others, showing how she is always focused and serious at all times. She does not seem to have any negative thoughts or prejudice against the Martians and Mars itself.

__Height:__ 134 cm

 [Princess Asselyum Vers Allusia](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia)'s personal maid. Being born on Mars, she holds negative thoughts about Earth and it's people, especially [Slaine](https://anilist.co/character/88174/Slaine-Troyard) as he was born on Earth but is associated with the Vers Empire and Mars. However, after returning to her homeland, her views on Slaine begin to gradually improve as she reveals to him the identity of the orange Kataphrakt's pilot. Although being underage, she is a very skilled driver and even claims to be able to pilot a Kataphrakt. 

Eddelrittuo is a childish and proud girl for her age. Due to her small figure and young age, she often does not get the respect she deserves causing her to quickly become frustrated and scold those who do so. Being very close acquaintances with the Princess Asselyum, she highly respects her and will even risk her own well being to ensure her safety. She only wishes the best for her, often seen being concerned about her, and wishes to support her as her maid.

__Height:__ 183 cm

A human soldier and lieutenant in charge of the Clydesdale Platoon. During the first Earth-Mars War, his platoon consisting of many tanks were no match for the Martian's weaponry and Kataphrakts. He was forced to shoot his own best friend, [John Humery](https://anilist.co/character/88444/John-Humeray), that was trapped inside a burning tank after being frozen in fear. As a result, he developed PTSD after the first war. After experiencing the devastating defeat, he claims that the weaponry and machinery on Earth are no match for Martian technology but no one believes him. He becomes an instructor at Shin-awara High School during the second Earth-Mars war.

Kouichirou is a stubborn and carefree adult who often takes his work seriously. He is often seen slacking, drinking or being sarcastic towards his students. Due to his PTSD, he greatly regrets being unable to save his best friend and traumatizes over the past as he is not able to forgive himself. 

Although he does not look like a reliable person, he is very skilled when it comes to piloting Kataphrakts.

name.native: レムリナ・ヴァース・エンヴァース

node.description:
Asseylum Vers Allusia's half-sister. The two princesses share the same paternal lineage, but have different mothers. She hates her royal heritage and even though she knows she's only a tool to activate the Aldnoah Drive, she continues with her mission since it makes her feel useful, befriending Slaine. She also pretends to be Asseylum in a message that urges to continue the war, with only Inaho suspecting she's an impostor.

Lemrina is a shrewd girl and is familiar of how Vers Empire's politics works. She is a good actress and manipulator, and keenly aware of her social standing and usefulness only as a tool to activate Aldnoah. She rarely shows her true nature to others.

Mazuurek holds the title of Count as a member of the Orbital Knights. He pilots the Martian Kataphrakt Sirenum.

Though he holds no contempt over the people of Earth, Mazuurek merely wants its resources and prefers not to fight. He apparently became interested in Earth because his name sounded similar to a Polish folk dance, Mazurka (pol. Mazurek), which is why he has come and wants to learn more about Earth.

__Height:__ 190 cm

A Count and a member of the Orbital Knights. He is a middle aged man with medium length brown hair and eyes. He wears the traditional Orbital Knights uniform which consists of a burgundy coat and trousers, a white dress shirt underneath, and knee high black boots.  During the first Earth-Mars War, he was sent to Tanegashima in his Kataphrakt, the Dioscuria, along side his fiancé to fight. However, when Heaven's Fall occurred, Saazbaum barely managed to escape alive with the help of Dr. Troyard at the cost of his fiancé's life. After this tragedy, Saazbaum blames everything on the Royal Family of Vers which ignited him to take part in the assassination attempt on [Princess Asseylum](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia).

Count Saazbaum appears to be a blood thirsty and violent man who seeks the destruction of all Terrans and Earth. However, he has another objective which is to seek vengeance on the Royal Family of Vers after causing the incident that killed his fiancé. Count Saazbaum adopts Slaine and treats him respectfully as his father was the one who saved his life. He holds a great amount of trust towards him, going as far to tell him his own goals and vengeance towards the Royal Family of Vers.

He is the pilot of the Martian Kataphrakt Dioscuria and it's successor, the Dioscuria II.

~!Count Saazbaum is later on killed by Slaine. He was hit by a high speed debris cluster that was meant to kill Inaho.!~

Inko's best friend who is also in Inaho's class. She comes from the same country as Calm that was severely affected by Heaven's Fall. Nina is usually a cheerful girl, who seems to be relatively simple. She likes wearing pretty clothes, even exchanging her school uniform for Princess Asseylum's dress.

Born as a third class Martian, the efforts of his hard-working parents gave him the opportunity to work for the Orbital Knights.

He serves Slaine and holds extreme respect for him.

Klancain is the son of Count Cruhteo and inherits the title of Count upon his father's death.

~!Klancain was sent by Vers to investigate the situation around Earth, and to bring Princess Asseylum back to Mars. He successfully completes his mission. On their way back to Mars, Asseylum decides that she must take action, following a message from Slaine. Klancain takes her to Count Mazuurek's Landing Castle, where Asseylum announces to the Orbital Knights that she is the new Empress of Vers, and that she is taking Klancain as her husband.

In the epilogue, Klancain and Asseylum are shown together, suggesting that Asseylum went through with her declaration.
When referred to as "Count Cruhteo," Klancain requests to be called "Klancain," claiming that he is not yet used to the change. This suggests that he is not as prideful as his peers among the Orbital Knights.!~

name.native: カーム・クラフトマン
